raw.title: Senior Partnership Manager
raw.excerpt: A bit about the role and what you’ll deliver...  We’re looking for a Senior Partner Manager – OEM Partnerships to build and strengthen our relationships with key OEM partners across the Asia-Pacific region.
raw.description:
A bit about the role and what you’ll deliver...

We’re looking for a Senior Partner Manager – OEM Partnerships to build and strengthen our relationships with key OEM partners across the Asia-Pacific region. This is a great opportunity to work at the heart of the mobile technology ecosystem, bringing people together, unlocking opportunities and helping drive our global partnership strategy forward.

Reporting to our SVP Strategic Partnerships, you’ll be the key point of contact for OEM partners across APAC, building trusted relationships and working closely with teams across the business to deliver successful partnerships. You’ll balance strategic relationship management with hands-on commercial and operational support, helping turn shared ambitions into meaningful results.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Build lasting partnerships – develop and maintain strong relationships with key OEM partners, becoming a trusted point of contact who understands their priorities and helps them succeed.

  • Unlock growth opportunities – identify opportunities to strengthen partnerships, support business development and contribute to Trustonic’s growth across the region.

  • Bring people together – work collaboratively with our product, delivery, legal and commercial teams to make sure partner needs are understood and partnership commitments are delivered.

  • Support commercial negotiations – help navigate commercial agreements, influence outcomes and resolve challenges or escalations constructively.

  • Keep things moving – coordinate actions, communicate progress and ensure stakeholders have clarity on priorities, next steps and decisions.

  • Drive consistency – work within our global OEM operational frameworks and processes, helping ensure a joined-up approach across regions.

  • Represent Trustonic – build our presence and strengthen relationships through industry events, partner meetings and wider engagement across the APAC mobile technology landscape.

Who you are...

  • A natural relationship-builder who enjoys developing trust and credibility with people at all levels.

  • A confident communicator and influencer who can bring different perspectives together and navigate complex stakeholder environments.

  • Commercially minded, with an eye for opportunities and a genuine interest in helping partnerships grow.

  • A collaborative problem-solver who can mediate challenges, manage escalations and keep relationships constructive.

  • Organised and proactive, comfortable managing multiple priorities while keeping track of the detail.

  • Resilient and tenacious, able to work through challenges and find practical ways forward.

  • Culturally aware and adaptable, able to build relationships across different markets, business cultures and time zones.

  • Comfortable working autonomously while staying connected to a wider, global team.

What makes you, you...

You’re likely to have:

  • Experience in partnership management, business development or account management, ideally within the mobile, telecommunications or technology sector.

  • A track record of managing relationships with large mobile OEMs or other major technology partners.

  • Experience supporting commercial negotiations, agreements and the resolution of partner issues or escalations.

  • An understanding of the mobile telecoms ecosystem, including the OEM landscape and business culture across APAC.

  • The ability to work effectively across commercial and technical teams, connecting different priorities to achieve shared outcomes.

  • Strong stakeholder management, influencing and negotiation skills, with the confidence to navigate complex organisations.

  • A good understanding of mobile technology, device security and the wider industry landscape, including relevant trends and regulatory considerations across APAC.

  • Strong organisational skills and confidence using Microsoft Office and project management tools to manage activity and keep stakeholders aligned.

  • Excellent English communication skills. Mandarin language skills would be an advantage.

An undergraduate degree, or equivalent practical experience, skills and knowledge.

What we can provide you in return for your investment...

Competitive compensation

  • A base salary that reflects your expertise and impact.
  • Bonus scheme to share in our success.

Financial security & wellbeing

  • Private medical insurance for you and your family from day one.

Flexibility & work-life balance

  • Remote working arrangements to support your lifestyle.
  • An open holiday policy with no upper limit—take the time you need, when you need it.
  • Support for volunteering and causes that matter to you.

Growth & development

  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression.
  • Exposure and interaction with global teams.

Inclusive, supportive culture

  • A commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion.
  • A collaborative environment where your voice is valued and your wellbeing is prioritised.

Impact & purpose

  • The chance to work on technology that drives global economic inclusion and makes a real difference in people’s lives.

Trustonic is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on any grounds. We empower, engage, enable and valuedifferences between people,including; different races, ethnicities, genders, ages, religions, disabilities and sexual orientations, with differences in education, backgrounds, skill sets, experiences and knowledge.

Who we are...

At Trustonic, we make smartphones affordable for the many, enabling global access to devices and digital finance through the world’s most secure smartphone locking technology. We partner with mobile carriers, retailers, and financiers across 30+ countries, powering device financing solutions that drive economic inclusion, profitability, and growth.

We pride ourselves on living by the Trustonic culture code, a blueprint for our journey that recognises that great working environments don’t guarantee success, but bad ones almost always ensure failure.

Working here, you’ll find a company that celebrates its diversity and is looking to do the right thing: for each other, the community and the planet. We believe in equal opportunities and take to heart the old African proverb ’If you only want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together’.

We work flexibly when and where we’re at our best, but regardless of how you choose to work, we’ll make sure you feel like one of the team.

Click here if you would like to find out more about Trustonic's culture code.

If you would like to work in a fast-moving global technology company, with great ambition, then we’d love to hear from you!

description: Who we areAt Domino, we build software that helps the largest, AI-driven organizations build and operate advanced data science and AI solutions at scale.

raw.title: Staff Software Engineer, Identity and Authorization
raw.excerpt: Who we areAt Domino, we build software that helps the largest, AI-driven organizations build and operate advanced data science and AI solutions at scale.
raw.description:
Who we are

At Domino, we build software that helps the largest, AI-driven organizations build and operate advanced data science and AI solutions at scale. Our platform integrates a streamlined model development environment, MLOps capabilities, and novel features for collaboration, reuse, and reproducibility — all of which make data science teams more productive, reduce time to value, and ensure compliance. Our customers — like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy — are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. Especially in the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented — and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit www.domino.ai

What we are building

Domino’s Identity and Access platform (IDSM) is the foundation for how customers in some of the world’s most regulated industries manage who can see and do what. We’re evolving it into a centralized, relationship-based authorization framework built on SpiceDB, and you’d be the technical anchor for its next phase.

  • A unified authorization model. Extend a centralized, fine-grained, relationship-based model across the platform, replacing feature-specific permission checks with consistent, reusable primitives.
  • Production-grade operations. Harden the authorization layer for the scale, reliability, and security that enterprise and public-sector customers expect.
  • A thoughtful migration path. Make the sequencing and design calls that let us retire legacy access checks without disrupting customers along the way.
  • Groups and organizations that mirror real customers. Rethink how we model groups and organizational hierarchies so large enterprises can represent their teams the way they actually work.
  • Cloud-native identity. Deepen integration with cloud workload identity, starting with AWS IRSA and extending to Azure and GCP equivalents.
  • Foundations other teams build on. Design core identity and access capabilities, with clean interfaces and flexible abstractions, that engineers across the company can adopt with confidence.
  • A stronger way of building. Set the patterns for how the team uses AI-assisted development to ship high-quality features faster, without compromising security or code quality.

What your impact will be

  • Set the architectural direction. Design identity and access solutions that meet customer demands for managing user and group access, and are secure, scalable, and built on primitives teams can reuse.
  • Bring clarity to complex decisions. Articulate the architecture clearly enough that the rest of Engineering can rally around it.
  • Be the go-to authority. Engineers and teams building on IDSM will bring their auth questions to you, and your technical judgment will carry real influence.
  • Raise the engineering bar. Lead design reviews, unblock engineers facing ambiguity, and champion flexible abstractions and well-thought-out interfaces.
  • Increase velocity and reduce maintenance. Improve our architecture, including removing tech debt, so the team ships faster with less ongoing maintenance.
  • Shape how we build with AI. Establish patterns for using AI-assisted development to deliver high-quality features faster without compromising security or rigor.
  • Foster ownership and urgency. Help the team know what to build and value both quality and speed of iteration and contribute to experiences that make identity and user management easier for the enterprises we serve.

What we look for in this role

  • A track record of evolving an enterprise-grade authorization system under real production traffic, with strong opinions about the architecture of these systems
  • Experience designing a new auth system and migrating to it from a legacy approach (a plus)
  • Experience on a platform team supporting other services within a larger engineering organization
  • A background at a company that builds authentication or authorization products (a plus)
  • A concrete example of an auth system you helped build that solved a recurring class of customer challenges
  • A history of helping teams become better engineers by improving designs, velocity, and quality
  • Authorization systems: Hands-on experience with relationship-based or fine-grained authorization, including schema design (relations, permissions, caveats) and the tradeoffs versus traditional RBAC
  • Identity protocols: Solid grounding in OIDC and SAML, and ideally experience with an IdP such as Keycloak, Auth0, Okta, or ForgeRock
  • Cloud identity: Practical experience with workload identity patterns such as AWS IRSA, Azure Workload Identity, or GCP Workload Identity Federation
  • Secrets management: Familiarity with a credential management system such as Vault
  • Backend engineering: Strong Go, Java, or a comparable language, comfort running services on Kubernetes, and API design instincts from owning a platform others build on
  • System architecture: Experience architecting auth frameworks that scale to enterprise customers
  • AI-assisted development: Considered, real-world experience using AI coding tools while maintaining code quality and security rigor

What We Value

  • We value a growth mindset. High-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and see the opportunities for success
  • We believe in individuals who seek truth and speak the truth and can be their whole selves at work
  • We value all of you that believe improving is always possible At Domino Everything is a work in progress – we can do better at everything
  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company
  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply

raw.description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a forward-thinking software development company dedicated to building innovative solutions that help businesses automate and optimize their operations. We leverage cutting-edge technologies to create scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a skilled Backend Application Engineer to join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission of transforming business processes through technology.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Backend Application Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: In-house Bright Vision Technologies SOW engagement (no third-party client or vendor)
Salary: $120K - $175K
Experience: 6+ years

Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.

We do not engage in C2C, 1099, or third-party arrangements for this role.
Candidates must be willing to work directly as a full-time W2 employee of Bright Vision Technologies and contribute to our in-house SOW deliverables.

No new H1B sponsorship is available for this role.
However, candidates who are currently on a valid H1B visa and require a transfer are welcome to apply. We will support H1B transfers for qualified candidates.

For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Backend Application Engineer focused on high-throughput platform development to design, build, and operate the foundational platforms and shared services that other engineering teams rely on to deliver their products. This role focuses on building backend platform capabilities — request routing, traffic management, data fan-out, caching layers, asynchronous job execution, and durable event processing — that must handle very high traffic volumes with predictable latency and minimal operational toil. The ideal candidate combines deep distributed systems expertise with strong platform-engineering instincts, values internal developer experience as a first-class concern, and has a track record of leading multi-quarter platform initiatives that meaningfully raise the engineering bar for the organizations they support.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and build internal platform services and shared infrastructure that hundreds of engineers depend on every day, with explicit focus on developer experience and operational ergonomics.
  • Architect high-throughput, latency-sensitive backend platforms capable of sustaining very high request volumes with predictable, well-bounded tail latency.
  • Build durable, replayable event-processing pipelines and asynchronous job execution platforms that other product teams compose to ship features faster.
  • Design and operate caching, rate-limiting, and request-shaping layers that protect upstream systems and enable safe scaling under bursty workloads.
  • Develop platform abstractions, SDKs, and paved-road libraries that codify best practices and let product teams consume capabilities without re-implementing them.
  • Establish robust observability, SLOs, and capacity-planning practices for platform services, raising the operational bar across the organization.
  • Drive multi-region, fault-tolerant, and geo-distributed designs with rigorous attention to availability, durability, and graceful degradation under failure.
  • Lead incident response for high-impact platform issues, conduct blameless post-mortems, and drive durable engineering improvements that prevent recurrence.
  • Define and enforce platform-wide standards around API design, schema evolution, deployment, and backward-compatibility guarantees.
  • Optimize platform performance through careful profiling, data-driven tuning, and algorithmic improvements that move the needle on throughput and cost.
  • Partner with infrastructure, security, and SRE teams to ensure platform services meet enterprise reliability, compliance, and security obligations.
  • Mentor mid-level engineers and lead architectural discussions across teams, helping the broader organization grow in distributed-systems maturity.
  • Produce clear technical design documents, decision records, and operational runbooks that make the platform legible to future maintainers.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging platform technologies, open-source projects, and architectural patterns for strategic adoption.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Six or more years of professional backend or platform engineering experience.
  • Demonstrated track record building and operating internal platforms or shared services consumed by multiple engineering teams.
  • Strong, hands-on expertise designing distributed systems with rigorous attention to consistency, availability, latency, and failure-mode behavior.
  • Advanced proficiency in at least one major backend language such as Java, Go, Scala, Rust, or modern C++.
  • Deep understanding of high-throughput messaging, streaming, and event-driven architectures using technologies such as Kafka, Pulsar, or NATS.
  • Strong working knowledge of data storage systems across relational, key-value, document, and search workloads.
  • Proven experience leading multi-quarter platform initiatives across teams, including stakeholder management and technical decision-making.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including ability to author crisp technical design documents and present trade-offs clearly.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and shape engineering culture through code review, design review, and onboarding contributions.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience operating Kubernetes-based platforms or contributing to internal developer-platform initiatives at scale.
  • Contributions to widely-used open-source platform or infrastructure projects.
  • Familiarity with control-plane / data-plane patterns, service mesh internals, or workflow-orchestration engines.
  • Experience designing platform APIs with strong backward-compatibility and versioning guarantees.
  • Public technical writing, conference talks, or other community contributions on platform engineering topics.

raw.excerpt: As a Security Operations Analyst, you will play a critical role in enhancing our security posture and elevating customer confidence in Rapid7 products and services.
raw.description:
As a Security Operations Analyst, you will play a critical role in enhancing our security posture and elevating customer confidence in Rapid7 products and services. Operating within a highly engaged, collaborative environment, you will build and implement complex, cross-functional initiatives that secure our business, employees, and customers.


About the Team

Our Information Security team leads the effective delivery of business outcomes and program maturation through standardization and iterative improvement.


About the Role

As a Security Operations Analyst, your primary responsibility will be to review alert data to pinpoint malicious activity within the Rapid7 environment. Specifically, your focus will be to:

  • Lead and drive investigations spanning evidence collection, analysis, intrusion vector determination, and malicious activity identification.
  • Create detailed Incident Reports documenting technical analysis, findings, and recommended remediation steps.
  • Conduct rotational threat hunting activities to proactively uncover unknown threats.
  • Assist in Incident Response engagements by analyzing forensic artifacts to track threat actor movements.
  • Provide high-quality threat detection services to secure the organization.
  • Research current attack methodologies to enhance threat detection capabilities.
  • Offer continuous technical feedback to Rapid7 product development teams.

The skills and qualities you'll bring include

  • Bring strong problem-solving ability, critical thinking skills, and technical ingenuity to drive efficient incident investigations.
  • Demonstrate required familiarity with Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems.
  • Apply essential hands-on experience using SIEM tools, such as the Rapid7 command platform or Splunk.
  • Leverage experience in core Security Operations Center functions, including incident response, threat hunting, and forensic investigations.
  • Identify areas for process improvement and successfully execute sustainable solutions.
  • Execute decision-making by making efficient choices during investigations that resolve security challenges and enable momentum.
  • Demonstrate accountability by taking full ownership of incident analyses, findings, and remediation tracking.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration by partnering across security teams and product developers to elevate security capabilities.

raw.excerpt: Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten.
raw.description:
Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten. Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns.

Über uns
ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut.

Über die Rolle
Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst.
Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten.
Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr.

Woran du arbeiten wirst

  • Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen.

  • Harness Engineering: Der Agent hat über 100 Tools. Aber er muss eine Anfrage so verstehen, wie ein Hausverwalter sie versteht, und nicht so, wie die Begriffe außerhalb der Branche klingen. Was gehört in den System Prompt, was in Skills?

  • Knowledge Base: Unsere Plattform hat eine eigene Knowledge Base, ähnlich wie Notion. Komplett selbst gebaut und gedacht als kollektives Gehirn des Unternehmens. Aber sollte die KI auch von selbst „lernen"? Und wenn ja, wann? Und wie machen wir die Suche in der Knowledge Base besser — über bessere Tools, System Prompts oder Skills?

  • Voice-Agents: Dieselben Agenten, nur am Telefon — auf LiveKit gebaut, die Anrufe genauso abwickeln wie unsere Text-Agenten Tickets.

  • LLM Infrastructure. Das richtige Modell für die jeweilige Aufgabe wählen, per Caching und Streaming die Latenz drücken, bei Provider-Ausfällen sauber neu versuchen, Context kompakt halten, die RAG-Suche optimieren, Usage über alle Provider tracken, Kosten senken und mit Evals prüfen, was wirklich besser ist.

Unser minimalistischer Tech Stack
Alles ist TypeScript. Vom Datenbankschema bis ins Frontend.
Backend: Convex (Datenbank & Serverless Functions)
Frontend: , React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui
Technologien, die dir begegnen werden: Vercel AI SDK, Convex Agent Component

Gehalt

5000 – 6000 Euro brutto, mit Raum für Wachstum und Beförderungen in den kommenden Monaten und Jahren

Benefits

  • 100 % remote

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • So viele KI-Tokens, wie du brauchst

  • Wir sind eigenfinanziert und profitabel (und verbrennen kein VC-Geld, um zu überleben)

  • Kleines Team, echte Verantwortung — was du baust, geht auch wirklich live

  • Schnelle Entscheidungen, keine sinnlosen Meetings und keine Freigabeschleifen, durch die du dich kämpfen musst

Unsere Werte

  • Dinge fertig machen, jeder Tag zählt

  • Transparenz und Ehrlichkeit, gerade wenn es unangenehm wird

  • Nach Großem streben – dich und andere ständig fordern

Wenn du genauer sehen willst, was wir bauen: Schau auf unserem YouTube-Kanal vorbei — kleiner Hinweis, der ist auf Deutsch.

Requirements

Du bist

  • fließend in Englisch und Deutsch

  • ein erfahrener Entwickler mit mehr als 2 Jahren Erfahrung im Bauen von Agenten für den Produktivbetrieb

  • AI-native. Du hast agentische Features ausgeliefert, auf die sich echte Nutzer verlassen, und du hast eine Meinung zu Retrieval, Evals, Tool-Design und dazu, wo die heutigen Spitzenmodelle an ihre Grenzen kommen.

  • in erster Linie Builder. Du bringst lieber heute eine grobe v1 raus, als drei Wochen lang die perfekte zu planen.

  • auf dem neuesten Stand bei neuen KI-Modellen und der Forschung

  • jemand, der fast seinen gesamten Code mit KI schreibt

  • es gewohnt, autonom zu arbeiten und volle Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben zu übernehmen

  • unter Leistungsdruck sogar noch besser

  • schnell darin, Neues zu lernen, und siehst dich als Generalist, nicht als Spezialist

Dein Techstack:

Ist nicht wichtig, da bei uns KI deinen Code schreiben wird.

Position Overview

The Chief Sustainability Officer (CSO) is responsible for leading the organization's environmental, social, and governance (ESG) strategy and sustainability initiatives. The CSO drives the integration of sustainable business practices into corporate strategy, operations, risk management, and stakeholder engagement. This role ensures the organization meets regulatory requirements, sustainability goals, and long-term ESG commitments while enhancing corporate reputation and business resilience.

Key Responsibilities

ESG & Sustainability Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's ESG and sustainability strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Establish sustainability goals, targets, and long-term roadmaps.
  • Integrate ESG principles into business operations, investments, and decision-making processes.

Environmental Sustainability Initiatives

  • Lead initiatives focused on carbon reduction, energy efficiency, waste management, and climate resilience.
  • Develop strategies to reduce environmental impact and support net-zero objectives.
  • Monitor environmental performance metrics and sustainability benchmarks.

Social Impact & Corporate Responsibility

  • Drive diversity, equity, inclusion (DEI), employee well-being, and community engagement initiatives.
  • Oversee corporate social responsibility (CSR) programs and social impact strategies.
  • Promote ethical business practices and stakeholder trust.

Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with ESG-related regulations, reporting standards, and frameworks.
  • Establish governance policies and sustainability reporting structures.
  • Collaborate with legal, risk, compliance, and audit teams on ESG governance.

ESG Reporting & Analytics

  • Oversee ESG disclosures, sustainability reporting, and impact measurement.
  • Ensure alignment with recognized frameworks such as GRI, SASB, TCFD, and ISSB where applicable.
  • Develop dashboards and KPIs to measure ESG performance and progress.

Stakeholder & Investor Engagement

  • Engage with investors, regulators, clients, and external stakeholders on sustainability matters.
  • Communicate ESG initiatives, progress, and impact transparently.
  • Represent the organization in sustainability forums and industry discussions.

Sustainable Business Transformation

  • Collaborate with business units to embed sustainability into operations, products, and services.
  • Support sustainable finance, green initiatives, and responsible investment strategies.
  • Identify opportunities for innovation and sustainable growth.

Risk Management & Resilience

  • Assess environmental and social risks impacting business operations and investments.
  • Develop climate risk and sustainability risk management frameworks.
  • Support enterprise resilience and long-term sustainability planning.

Leadership & Culture Development

  • Promote a sustainability-focused culture across the organization.
  • Lead and mentor ESG, sustainability, and CSR teams.
  • Drive employee awareness and engagement in sustainability initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Business Administration, Finance, or related field; Master's degree preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of experience in sustainability, ESG, corporate responsibility, or related leadership roles.
  • Strong understanding of ESG frameworks, sustainability reporting, and regulatory requirements.
  • Proven track record of implementing enterprise-wide sustainability initiatives.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong strategic and sustainability leadership capabilities.
  • Expertise in ESG frameworks and sustainability reporting.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.

Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

raw.title: Senior Engineer - DevOps
raw.excerpt: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world.
raw.description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We’re building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

What’s the position?

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our growing Product & Technology organization at Hard Rock Digital. In this role, you will help build and scale the internal developer platform that powers our gaming and entertainment products—making it faster and safer for every engineering team to ship.

This is a platform engineering–focused role: rather than only maintaining infrastructure, you’ll design and build self-service workflows, golden paths, and developer tooling on top of Backstage, our internal developer platform (IDP) of choice. You’ll partner with product engineering teams to understand their pain points and turn them into paved-road, self-serve capabilities—provisioning, CI/CD, environments, observability, and more—so teams can move independently without sacrificing security or compliance.

You’ll also model what it means to operate at the pace of AI-enabled engineering: fluently using AI coding assistants, agentic tooling, and LLM-powered workflows to design platform capabilities faster, automate toil, and raise the bar for the entire team.

What will you do?

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineering, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate our internal developer platform on Backstage, including software catalog, templates, plugins, and scorecards that give engineers a consistent, self-service experience across the stack.

  • Create golden-path templates and self-service workflows (Backstage Software Templates, Terraform/Terragrunt modules, CI/CD scaffolding) that let product teams provision infrastructure, services, and environments without filing a ticket.

  • Architect and implement scalable AWS and hybrid-cloud infrastructure using Terraform/Terragrunt and related Infrastructure as Code tools, exposed to engineering teams through self-service platform interfaces.

  • Design, build, and optimize highly available containerized environments leveraging EKS, Kubernetes, and Docker, and surface them as consumable platform primitives.

  • Lead the automation strategy for CI/CD pipelines (TeamCity, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, and similar), building reusable, self-service pipeline patterns that scale across teams.

  • Champion security and compliance by design, embedding guardrails, identity/access controls, and policy-as-code directly into the self-service platform so "paved road" is always the secure road.

  • Partner with product engineering, SRE, QA, security, and operations teams to identify friction points and convert them into platform capabilities that improve developer experience and velocity.

  • Define and track developer experience (DevEx) and platform adoption metrics (lead time, self-service usage, ticket deflection) to demonstrate platform impact.

  • Leverage AI tools fluently as a core part of your daily workflow—using AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex), agentic automation, and LLM-powered tooling to accelerate platform delivery, generate and review Backstage plugins/templates, and help the broader team adopt AI-enabled ways of working.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

We’re seeking an experienced engineer who is genuinely energized by platform engineering—building tools and paved roads that make other engineers more productive, not just running infrastructure. You should be comfortable owning architecture and implementation decisions for internal developer platforms while helping elevate the DevOps discipline across the organization. Critically, you’re someone who has embraced AI tooling not as a novelty but as a genuine force multiplier—and who can help others do the same.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles, with at least 2 years in a senior or lead capacity.

  • Hands-on experience building or operating an internal developer platform (IDP)—Backstage strongly preferred—including catalog design, software templates, and custom plugin development.

  • A track record of designing self-service workflows and golden paths that reduce toil and ticket volume for product engineering teams.

  • Expert-level knowledge of AWS services and cloud-native architectures (multi-account setups, VPC design, IAM policies, networking).

  • Strong experience with Kubernetes (EKS preferred), Docker, and Helm for container orchestration and management.

  • Advanced Infrastructure as Code (IaC) expertise using Terraform/Terragrunt, with deep understanding of modular design and reusability suitable for self-service consumption.

  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, TypeScript/ (useful for Backstage plugin development), or other relevant languages.

  • Experience leading CI/CD initiatives and designing scalable, self-service delivery pipelines with GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, or comparable tools.

  • Strong understanding of observability practices and performance monitoring frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog, etc.), ideally surfaced through platform tooling.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of networking, security hardening, and compliance in regulated industries, and experience embedding these as automated guardrails.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction in cross-functional teams.

  • AWS Professional Certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or SysOps Administrator) strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated fluency with AI development tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar), including practical experience integrating AI assistants into infrastructure workflows, platform tooling, code review, incident response, or documentation. The ability to operate at AI-enabled development velocity is a core expectation of this role, not a nice-to-have.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • A hybrid / remote working environment

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

Tenchi is a Cyber Security company building innovative technology focused on Third-Party Cyber Risk Management for businesses. Founded by serial entrepreneurs and supported by solid institutional investors, we are driven to disrupt this fast-growing industry.

Tenchi was created to tackle a real challenge: companies often face security risks because their third-parties don’t maintain the same level of cyber protection. This gap leaves even the largest organizations potentially vulnerable to incidents they can’t directly control. That’s exactly where we step in.

Our TPCRM SaaS solution, Zanshin, is the only global TPCRM solution that offers both inside-out and outside-in visibility - combining external attack surface monitoring with automated, continuous, and non-intrusive assessments of cloud infrastructure (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and security controls.

Our People and Culture

At Tenchi, we build innovative technology to help companies secure their ecosystems with transparency and peace of mind. We are ambitious and purpose-driven. Our culture is rooted in intentionality, transparency, and action. We move fast, communicate openly, and invest in people who want to make an impact.

As a 100% remote company with team members across Brazil, the US, Canada, Argentina, and Spain, we embrace flexibility while solving meaningful challenges together.

raw.title: Engineering Engagement Lead (S&P 500 Customer) - LATAM
raw.excerpt: Space Inch is looking for an Engineering Engagement Lead to look after our engineers within a long-standing partnership with one of the largest investment managers in the U.
raw.description:
Space Inch is looking for an Engineering Engagement Lead to look after our engineers within a long-standing partnership with one of the largest investment managers in the U.S, who is a S&P 500 company. Our engineers work embedded in the client’s teams, and the client directs their day-to-day work. Your job is everything around that work: making sure each engineer meets Space Inch’s standards, understanding what they’re building and why it matters to the client’s business, helping them grow, and keeping communication clear between our people and the client.

This is a people, communication, and account role, which means that you won’t assign tasks, run sprints, or make architecture decisions. An engineering background is a preference, but it’s not a disqualifying criteria. What really matters is an engineer’s mindset: you can sit down with an engineer or a client’s engineering manager, understand what’s being built, and have a real conversation about it.

Our mission, vision, and values

At Space Inch, we prioritize alignment with our clients and team, ensuring a deep understanding of their needs. We are committed to delivering exceptional work while supporting the personal and professional growth of our team members.

Working at Space Inch

  • Our remote-first team of around 80+ people is based across the EU (mostly Croatia), the US, and Latin America, with a growing presence in Brazil.
  • Occasional travel for client visits and company retreats.
  • This role is embedded within a single long-standing client partnership, though you'll draw on Space Inch's broader engineering community and practices.
  • We support work/life balance for our team.

Requirements

  • Experience: 10+ years in engineering and people leadership, engagement or account management, or technical project/product management in an agency, consultancy, nearshore, or client-embedded environment; preferably coming from an engineering background, but not a must.
  • An engineer’s mindset: you understand modern software development (SDLC, common architectures and stacks) well enough to follow what engineers are building, hold your own with client engineering and product managers, and notice when something is off. You don’t need to write code.
  • Real curiosity about the client’s business: you invest the time to learn the domain, why each application matters, and what workflow it replaces, so client stakeholders see you as someone who adds value.
  • A clear system for evaluating people: you can explain how you know someone is doing a great job, using standards, evidence, and feedback from several sources, and how you turn that into specific, actionable coaching.
  • Exceptional communicator and mediator who handles sensitive topics (compensation, retention, disengagement, underperformance) directly and with care, across written, async, live, and cross-cultural communication.
  • Proven track record of growing engineers: you’ve guided engineers along their career paths, from junior to senior and from individual contributor toward leadership, built development plans that led to real promotions, and can point to people who grew under your leadership.
  • Experience managing senior client stakeholders: gathering honest feedback, managing expectations, and showing the value our people bring.
  • Practical fluency with AI as a working tool: you can assess whether engineers are using AI well against defined practices and push them to improve.
  • Experience leading distributed or remote people, including those who work mostly on their own.

Key responsibilities

  • Evaluation against our standards: Regularly assess every engineer and project against Space Inch’s project success standards, and whether we’re meeting both the client’s needs and our team members’ needs.
  • Client feedback loop: Work with the client’s engineering and product managers to gather feedback on each engineer, including quality of work, taking into account how each client team operates.
  • Coaching and growth: Run regular 1:1s, give candid feedback, and build development plans that help engineers level up. Work with Engineering Leads, who coach informally, to round out evaluations.
  • Retention and connection: Keep engineers engaged and connected to Space Inch, especially those working alone on client projects. Spot retention risks early and resolve them.
  • Coaching and career growth: Run regular 1:1s, give candid feedback, and build development plans tied to Space Inch’s career paths. Identify engineers who are ready for the next level, build their promotion cases, and support those moving toward leadership roles. Work with Engineering Leads, who coach informally, to round out evaluations.
  • Account management: Act as Space Inch’s senior point of contact with the client on how our people are doing; manage expectations and help tell the story of the impact of our work.
  • Facilitating communication: Help engineers navigate shifting priorities, unclear ownership, and unrealistic timelines, and bridge communication gaps between our team and the client.
  • AI practice: Check that engineers follow the AI practices we define, help them improve, and share what works across the team.

Typical challenges you’ll be solving

  • Understanding a wide range of client applications well enough that client managers take your input seriously.
  • Keeping engineers who work individually within client teams motivated and connected to Space Inch.
  • Helping engineers handle a fast-changing client environment: shifting priorities, unclear ownership, and tight deadlines.
  • Growing engineers’ careers when the client directs their daily work, and making their progress visible enough to support promotions.
  • Turning feedback from engineers, Engineering Leads, and client managers into fair, specific evaluations and coaching.
  • Raising the bar on how the team uses AI, measured by outcomes rather than adoption for its own sake.

Qualities for success

  • Strong people instincts: engineers trust your guidance, feel supported in 1:1s, and are honest with you about what isn’t working.
  • Adapts communication style across coaching, difficult conversations, and client discussions.
  • A systems thinker who builds repeatable ways to evaluate and grow people, and spots broken communication loops before they escalate.
  • Comfortable making decisions and owning the outcome, even when the first attempt fails.
  • Calm under client pressure, and doesn’t pass that pressure to the team.

The role is right for you if

  • You lead through trust, conversation, and presence, and you enjoy helping people get better at what they do.
  • You like learning how a business works and connecting people’s work to what the client actually needs.
  • You enjoy building a clear system for evaluating and developing people, and refining it over time.
  • You find it rewarding when someone you’ve coached takes the next step in their career.
  • You’re comfortable in a setup where the client directs the day-to-day work and your impact comes through people and relationships.

The role is not right for you if

  • You want to run delivery, assign work, or own a product roadmap.
  • You want a primarily hands-on engineering role.
  • You aren’t interested in learning the client’s business in depth.
  • You’d rather wait for direction than propose a way forward.

What’s in it for you

  • Work closely with leadership on one of Space Inch’s most important client partnerships.
  • Shape how Space Inch evaluates, develops, and supports engineers in client-embedded work.
  • Leadership team that values people-first thinking and technical excellence.
  • Remote-friendly, collaborative, pragmatic culture.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Monthly salary: 6,500.00–9,000.00 USD for a full-time B2B collaboration, based on experience and skills
  • Remote-first setup
  • Health & Wellbeing: PTO + 100% paid sick leave + annual health checkup budget
  • Stay active: Wellness subsidy
  • Continuous Growth: An education budget specifically designed to fuel your learning and help you expand your knowledge base.

This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination. Space Inch believes in treating all employees and applicants with respect and dignity, fostering a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to succeed.

raw.excerpt: Powering the world’s payments ecosystem ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI.
raw.description:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem

ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.

As a Senior Principal New Business Developer in the UK, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem!

Are you a strategic commercial leader who believes in enabling payments transformation across Account to Account, Card processing and Digital Assets? ACI is redefining the sales experience by building trust, fostering relationships, and delivering solutions that truly align with our clients' needs.

We are hiring a critical role for a Senior Principal New Business Developer,responsible for new business across UK, Ireland and Nordics. You will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to making possibilities happen in the Payments industry. If you’ve ever used an ATM, paid a bill through your phone, sent money to a friend or shopped online, chances are your transaction was safeguarded and processed using ACI solutions.

The Senior Principal New Business Developer has accountability for the development and execution of strategies, campaigns, and plans to grow ACI’s sales and revenue, specifically but not exclusively for the Commercial and Corporate Banking market sector. ACI has the privilege of a strong customer base across the region and this role is dedicated to selling into new clients to become best in class as measured by sales & revenue growth, customer satisfaction and customer loyalty.

Sales isn’t a solo role and every member of the mission team plays a vital role in delivering results. This position champions a “One Team” mindset, so motivating across the organisation and being passionate about Payments across the UK, Ireland and Nordic regions is critical to success. The Senior Principal New Business Developer will also play a key role in representing ACI at key events and represents ACI externally across the industry.

The role is pan-solution, offering the opportunity to take to market ACI’s broad portfolio of solutions, be those as licensed technology or as SaaS.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Lead cross-functional collaboration under a ‘New Business Mission’ to deliver sales and revenue growth (Solution Consulting, Client Delivery, Product Management, Marketing and Finance)

  • Build pipeline, nurture leads and close contracts to meet and exceed new logo business targets

  • Deliver a new Go-To-Market strategy against a clear addressable market

  • Develop and execute sales campaigns, based on ACI’s unique value proposition, differentiators and market drivers

  • Be the external market voice for product roadmap needs. Work with the Product Management team and internal teams ensuring customer feedback and their needs are shared and provided as future opportunities

  • Be Disciplined & Focused. Qualification, win strategies, and pursuit tactics aren’t buzzwords, they’re essential. You’ll document plans and be relentless in your pursuit of excellence

  • Execute on key employee and business initiatives as required to support strategic and operating plans

  • Understand and adhere to all corporate policies to include but not limited to the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience required for the job:

  • Significant number of years’ experience of relevant business management experience in Banking and/or financial services technology
  • Deep payments knowledge is not an absolute must, however an understanding of how to operate across Banks (be those Commercial, Corporate, Investment, Retail, Neo, Digital etc.…), Building Societies, EMIs and PSPs, is critical
  • Track record of creating go-to-market strategies and executing against operating plan
  • Desire to translate issues into client outcomes and not lead with product specification. Experience in leading with value tailored to individuals, functions and organisations
  • An existing network across UK, Irish and Nordic based banks, fintech and PSPs (multi-level contacts) and are passionate about building new value-based relationships
  • Excellent relationship and selling skills – delivery of results
  • In-depth industry knowledge, across regulation, market trends and buyer requirements
  • Thoughtful and accurate Sales process management
  • Behavioural must haves include Integrity, Commercial Acumen and Building Trusted Relationships

Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Experience needed for the job:

  • Specialism in selling High Value payments and Digital Assets, in particular cross border, RTGS and digital asset solutions to commercial and corporate banking clients
  • Proven ability to lead and motivate management teams
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Excellent negotiation and influencing skills
  • Budgeting, planning and variance management skills
  • Excellent ability to execute results-based management
  • In-depth knowledge of payment products
  • Ability to represent the voice of the customer and monitor the marketplace/identify business opportunities and trends
  • Best-in-class sales practices

Core Capabilities:

We seek colleagues who embody our core capabilities — these shape our culture and enable us to make a meaningful impact together:

  • Ensure Accountability: holding self and others accountable to meet commitments
  • Drives Results: consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  • Customer Focus: building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  • Cultivate Innovation: creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful.
  • Collaborates: building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.
  • Courage: stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visa status or work permit now or in the future.

In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment.

Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at Job ID (Requisition #20087)

ACI Worldwide is an AA/EEO employer in the United States, which includes providing equal opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities, and an EEO employer globally.

Important Notice About Recruitment Scams
Job seekers should be aware of ongoing recruitment scams where individuals or organizations impersonate legitimate companies to offer fake job opportunities. These scams often involve requests for personal information, payments, or interviews through unofficial channels. Please be cautious and verify any communications claiming to be from our company ( / @aciworldwide.com). The ACI Worldwide recruitment team will always follow official channels and will never request payment.

What You Will Do:

  • Independently review borrower and loan-level information for complex balance statement and payoff requests.
  • Prepare and validate Statements of Loan Balances and payoff quotes across standard, advanced, and exception-based request types.
  • Research unusual account conditions, missing information, conflicting documentation, and calculation discrepancies.
  • Process complex grant, principal and interest, receivable, recapture, appraisal-related, multi-loan, and other authorized quoting requests.
  • Evaluate individual loans within multi-loan borrower accounts and prepare accurate consolidated summaries when required.
  • Determine the appropriate procedural path and resolve issues within established authority.
  • Manage competing priorities across multiple work queues with limited day-to-day direction.
  • Validate calculation inputs, outputs, supporting documentation, attachments, and routing before submission.
  • Escalate unresolved policy questions, material exceptions, and matters outside assigned authority with clear supporting documentation.
  • Share technical knowledge and provide procedural clarification to team members when needed.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend practical improvements to procedures, templates, workflows, and controls.
  • Protect confidential borrower, financial, and account information.

What You Will Need:

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • 3-5 years of experience in financial operations, loan servicing, mortgage operations, account servicing, payment processing, or comparable analytical work.
  • Demonstrated experience independently handling complex account scenarios and exception-based work.
  • Advanced numerical accuracy, analytical ability, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to perform and validate detailed financial calculations.
  • Ability to research discrepancies, reconcile inconsistent information, and document conclusions.
  • Ability to interpret and apply written procedures, templates, controls, and workflow requirements.
  • Ability to independently prioritize assignments across multiple queues and competing deadlines.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to determine when an issue must be escalated.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including concise escalation documentation.
  • Ability to work effectively with limited day-to-day direction.
  • Ability to protect confidential borrower, financial, and account information.

What Would Be Nice To Have:

  • Associate degree or higher in business administration, finance, accounting, or a related field.
  • Experience preparing payoff quotes, Statements of Loan Balances, or comparable financial documentation.
  • Experience with complex payoff, foreclosure, refinance, property-sale, borrower payoff, or special-exception requests.
  • Experience reviewing accounts containing multiple related loans.
  • Experience with corrective workflows, document routing, quality-control practices, or advanced account research.
  • Experience identifying recurring issues and recommending process improvements.
  • Experience providing technical knowledge sharing or procedural guidance to peers.
  • Experience in a regulated, procedure-driven, or high-volume financial operations environment.

What We Offer:

Guidehouse offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects our commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.

Benefits include:

  • Medical, Rx, Dental & Vision Insurance

  • Personal and Family Sick Time & Company Paid Holidays

  • Position may be eligible for a discretionary variable incentive bonus

  • Parental Leave

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan

  • Basic Life & Supplemental Life

  • Health Savings Account, Dental/Vision & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts

  • Short-Term & Long-Term Disability

  • Tuition Reimbursement, Personal Development & Learning Opportunities

  • Skills Development & Certifications

  • Employee Referral Program

raw.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

  • HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Location: Remote - Field based. Candidates should be based in one of the following states: Connecticut, Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, Vermont, New Jersey, New York or Pennsylvania.

Overview of Role:

The Director of Market Access Payer Account at Summit Therapeutics reports directly to the Executive Director, Payer Strategic Accounts, and will be responsible for leadership and management of select national and sub-national payers and other assigned accounts. This is a critical customer-facing role helping to ensure broad access, reimbursement, and patient affordability. These accounts include, National/Regional Health Plans, PBMs, Medicare, state Medicaid, VA/DoD, among others.

The Director will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with decision makers within the accounts, including medical and pharmacy departments. This role involves executing strategies and tactics within each account, while also providing support to the regional field matrix teams when necessary. A strong understanding of managed markets, reimbursement, and payer account management is essential.

Role and Responsibilities:

  • Establish, broaden, and deepen relationships with target entities (e.g., health insurers, PBM's, other payers, etc.) and key decision makers and influencers (medical and pharmacy directors, etc.) that affect coverage and reimbursement decisions.
  • Accounts covered will include: Evernorth/Cigna, Highmark, UPMC, Horizon, CareFirst, BCBS MI, BCBS MA, MACs, FFS Medicaid
  • Positively influence decision makers, policies, guidelines, and contracts to facilitate timely and appropriate coverage, access and reimbursement for our drug candidates and approved products.
  • Implement Brand access strategies and develop account specific plans and assist in the resolution of access/reimbursement issues.
  • Work closely with the Medical Affairs field team to support the communication and understanding of our drug candidates and approved products with payers.
  • Work closely with the Patient Services team to support the patient journey and resolve coverage issues.
  • Assist Regional Sales teams with pull- or sell-through strategies based on payer coverage.
  • Establish and maintain relationships with key decision-makers, including Formulary, P&T, and Pathway leaders, Medical & Pharmacy Directors and other population-based stakeholders to secure appropriate access and optimal product positioning.
  • Co-create account-level strategies, tools, and tactics to communicate the product value proposition effectively. Collaborate on pricing and contracting strategies, HEOR evidence generation plans, patient support programs, payer marketing initiatives, and account management approaches.
  • Lead discussions with internal and external partners to ensure alignment on access, coverage, and reimbursement strategies.
  • Foster a high-performance culture within the field team by promoting accountability, urgency, ethical behavior, and professional development.
  • Stay informed on healthcare industry trends, payer policies, reimbursement processes, and competitive activity. Provide strategic insights to inform decision-making, access strategies, and product launches.
  • Ensure all Market Access initiatives are developed and executed in compliance with legal, regulatory, and ethical standards.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, balancing multiple priorities and meeting deadlines.
  • All other duties as assigned

Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 10+ years biotech/pharmaceutical experience
  • Minimum of 5+ years of focused account management experience in the oncology access marketplace
  • Demonstrated success in engaging with US payers, MACs, PBMs, and IDNs
  • Strong understanding of the US healthcare payer/access landscape and regulatory environment
  • Excellent strategic thinking, leadership, negotiation, and relationship management skills
  • Ability to work on cross-functional teams and drive complex projects to completion
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills
  • Successful record of achieving and maintaining compliance with all applicable regulatory, legal, and operational rules
  • Travel: Ability to travel to support business priorities as needed

This is the pay for this position

Pay Transparency
$197,000—$246,500 USD

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor. The total compensation package for this position may also include bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable variable compensation.

All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact Summit’s Talent Acquisition team at to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to Summit.

We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training or promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

About CrucialLogics Inc.

We secure your business using native Microsoft technologies you already own.

We apply our Consulting with a ConscienceTM approach in our security philosophy.

  • Security should be simple, easy to manage and scalable
  • Security does not require a large investment in various point solutions
  • Security is easily achieved by properly configuring technologies you already are paying for
  • Reduce your attack footprint by reducing overall infrastructure

You will never stop bad actors from targeting you. The goal in security is to put defences in place to detect the attempt before the breach.

As a Principal Consultant, you will lead enterprise clients in transforming their Microsoft 365 collaboration environments, focusing on SharePoint Online, Power Platform, and AI-driven solutions such as Microsoft Copilot 365 and Studio. You will architect, implement, and govern advanced collaboration, automation, and security strategies, leveraging AI to drive productivity, compliance, and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

  • AI-Driven Collaboration & Automation
    • Architect and deploy Microsoft 365 collaboration solutions, integrating Copilot and AI agents for enhanced productivity and knowledge management.
    • Lead migration projects from legacy platforms to Microsoft 365 and SharePoint Online, ensuring seamless adoption of AI-powered workflows and automation (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI).
    • Design and implement advanced SharePoint Online sites, custom solutions, and scoped agents that serve as subject matter experts for organizational knowledge.
  • Security, Compliance & Governance
    • Configure and maintain Microsoft Purview for data protection, risk management, and compliance across Microsoft 365 services.
    • Implement governance strategies for SharePoint Online, including retention policies, sensitivity labels, and external sharing controls.
    • Advise on and deploy AI governance policies, including Copilot licensing, user access controls, and responsible AI usage.
  • Technical Leadership & Client Engagement
    • Provide technical ownership of project success, ensuring team members understand risks, impacts, and interdependencies of project delivery tasks.
    • Collaborate with IT, security, and business stakeholders to align solutions with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
    • Deliver workshops, training, and ongoing support to drive user adoption of AI and collaboration tools.
  • Continuous Improvement
    • Stay current with the latest Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and AI developments, best practices, and emerging technologies.
    • Contribute to internal knowledge sharing and solution development for future client engagements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
  • 8+ years in SharePoint development, Power Platform, and Microsoft 365 security/compliance.
  • Proven expertise in deploying and governing Purview, SharePoint Online, Power Platform, Power BI Desktop, Defender for O365 and Cloud App Security.
  • Deep technical knowledge of Microsoft 365; SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Entra ID (Azure AD) and Microsoft Active Directory.
  • Experience with cross-tenant migration, automation and multi-tenant environments.

·Proven expertise in Languages; PowerShell, PnP, Python (for AI scripting), JavaScript, C#, JSON, Power Query (DAX), and experience with REST APIs and GraphQL for integrating AI services. Databases; Microsoft Dataverse, Microsoft SQL, MySQL, and experience with AI-driven data analytics.

  • Strong understanding of AI governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and client engagement skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Advanced expertise in Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, and SharePoint Online agent development using Copilot Studio, Azure DevOps, and AI/ML frameworks integrated with Microsoft 365.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven collaboration and governance strategies.
  • Microsoft certifications (MS-900, MS-700, MS-100, AI-102) are a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Dynamic and supportive work environment.
  • 3 weeks vacation, bonus structure.

Why Join Us?

Be at the forefront of digital transformation, enabling organizations to harness the power of AI and Microsoft 365 for secure, compliant, and innovative collaboration. Shape the future of work for our clients!

Controller (FP&A, Financial Reporting & Accounting Leadership) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced and hands-on Controller to lead accounting operations, financial reporting, compliance, and financial close processes for a growing organization.

This is a leadership role for someone who combines deep technical accounting expertise with financial planning, team leadership, and operational excellence.

You’ll work closely with Executive Leadership, FP&A, Operations, Auditors, and Finance stakeholders to ensure the organization maintains accurate financial records, strong internal controls, audit-ready reporting, and scalable accounting processes.

If you enjoy balancing detailed accounting oversight with strategic financial leadership, this role is built for you.

What You’ll Own

Month-End & Year-End Close

  • Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes.
  • Maintain a five-business-day month-end close target.
  • Review and approve:
    • Journal entries
    • Account reconciliations
    • Accruals
    • Payroll allocations
    • Depreciation schedules
    • Intercompany transactions
  • Prepare complete financial reporting packages, including:
    • Profit & Loss Statements
    • Balance Sheets
    • Cash Flow Statements

Financial Reporting & Executive Insights

  • Prepare GAAP and IFRS-compliant financial statements.
  • Deliver executive reporting including:
    • Variance analysis
    • Financial commentary
    • Dashboards
    • Executive reporting packages
  • Support:
    • Board reporting
    • Investor reporting
    • Strategic planning
  • Translate financial data into actionable business recommendations.

Internal Controls & Compliance

  • Design, implement, and strengthen accounting controls.
  • Ensure compliance with:
    • GAAP
    • IFRS
    • Tax regulations
    • Audit requirements
    • Regulatory obligations
  • Coordinate external audits and manage PBC (Prepared by Client) requests.
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready financial documentation.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Management

  • Partner with FP&A teams on:
    • Annual budgets
    • Forecasting
    • Scenario planning
    • Capital planning
  • Monitor:
    • Cash flow
    • Liquidity
    • Working capital
    • Debt compliance
  • Provide recommendations that improve financial performance and operational efficiency.

Accounting Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop the accounting team.
  • Review work for:
    • Accuracy
    • Completeness
    • Timeliness
  • Establish scalable accounting processes and quality standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement across accounting operations.

Process Improvement & Systems

  • Lead initiatives involving:
    • ERP implementations
    • Accounting automation
    • Workflow optimization
    • SOP development
  • Improve reporting systems and accounting infrastructure.
  • Reduce manual processes while increasing scalability and efficiency.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Strong balance of technical accounting expertise and business insight.
  • Highly organized and deadline-driven.
  • Comfortable presenting financial information to executive leadership.
  • Able to lead teams while remaining hands-on.
  • Proactive in identifying risks and process improvements.
  • Passionate about building scalable financial systems and controls.

Required Experience & Skills

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in:
    • Accounting
    • Finance
    • Related field

Experience

  • 7+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience.
  • 2+ years of leadership or supervisory experience.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of:
    • GAAP
    • IFRS
    • Internal controls
    • Financial reporting
    • Financial close management
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as:
    • NetSuite
    • SAP
    • Oracle
    • QuickBooks Enterprise
    • Similar platforms
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets.
  • Strong financial analysis and reporting capabilities.

Nice-to-Have

  • CPA, ACCA, or MBA.
  • Previous experience as:
    • Controller
    • Finance Manager
    • Accounting Manager
  • ERP implementation or M&A integration experience.
  • Industry experience in:
    • SaaS
    • Professional Services
    • Real Estate
  • Experience using:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker
    • Financial dashboards

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review reconciliations and approve journal entries.
  • Monitor month-end close progress and accounting deliverables.
  • Prepare financial reports and variance analyses.
  • Meet with leadership to discuss financial performance.
  • Coordinate audit and compliance activities.
  • Mentor accounting team members and review work quality.
  • Improve accounting processes and automation initiatives.
  • Analyze financial trends and recommend operational improvements.

In short: You’ll ensure financial operations remain accurate, compliant, scalable, and strategically valuable while supporting leadership with reliable financial insights.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Month-end close completed within five business days.
  • Zero material audit adjustments.
  • 100% on-time regulatory and tax filings.
  • Accurate and timely executive reporting.
  • Strong accounting team performance and development.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

We’re looking for US-based, actively practicing physicians (MD/DO) to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation program. General and internal medicine are our main focus. While each project involves unique tasks, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
