We are hiring! Fusion Growth Partners is seeking a detail-oriented, tech-savvy Virtual Assistant with strong English communication skills (written and spoken) to join our team as a Post Close Marketing Specialist. This role directly supports our real estate agent partners by creating and executing professional marketing materials after the sale is complete that keeps their brand sharp and their listings visible.

This is a fully remote position; you will work from home.

About Fusion Growth Partners

Fusion Growth Partners is a business incubator and accelerator. We partner with real estate agents and invest directly into their businesses, funding their staff, systems, marketing, and operations so they can focus on relationships and closing deals. We are one of the only companies in the country offering this level of service.

You can learn more about what we do ator see exactly what our agent partners receive at.


What You'll Be Doing

As our Post Close Marketing Specialist, you will be responsible for creating polished, on-brand marketing materials for our real estate agent partners whenever their properties have sold. This includes:

  • Designing and producing Sale Pending and Just Sold marketing pieces
  • Creating social media graphics and content for sale announcements
  • Posting and scheduling marketing content across platforms
  • Maintaining organized records and files for each property
  • Communicating with internal team members to ensure materials are delivered on time and to standard

You will follow detailed, step-by-step Standard Operating Procedures for every task. Training will be provided. What we need from you is precision, speed, and the ability to work independently once trained.


Compensation & Schedule

  • There is a 30-day probation period during which project rates are lower while we confirm fit and workflow. Full rates apply after probation is successfully completed.
  • Typical monthly earnings for a consistent contributor fall in the $600–$1,200 range depending on project volume and complexity, discussed in more detail during the interview process.
  • Fully remote — work from home
  • Part-time to full-time hours depending on listing volume

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

The ideal candidate:

  • Has strong English writing and communication skills
  • Is extremely detail-oriented — small errors in listing marketing reflect directly on our agent partners
  • Is comfortable working with digital marketing tools, CRMs, and design platforms
  • Can manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously without dropping the ball
  • Takes ownership of their work and doesn't need to be micromanaged
  • Has experience in graphic design, digital marketing, or real estate marketing

Required Skills

  • Adobe InDesign
  • Microsoft Office Suite
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Strong technological aptitude
  • Sharp attention to detail
  • Ability to organize and manage multiple projects simultaneously

Required Equipment

raw.title: Senior Security & Compliance - Healthcare | Zenara Health
raw.excerpt: Location: Remote - India Type: Full-time Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6:00 PM and 12:00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time.
raw.description:
Location: Remote - India

Type: Full-time

Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6:00 PM and 12:00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time. Attendance in that window is required. Your remaining work is yours to schedule.

Commitment: Approximately 50 hours per week

Industry: Healthcare technology experience is preferred but not mandatory

About the Company

Zenara Health is a technology-oriented mental healthcare organization building clinical software for behavioral-health clinics. We work with sensitive patient data, so security, access control, vendor risk, AI-tool risk, and evidence of how our controls operate are fundamental to earning customer trust.

We are a startup, not a department. We move quickly and need a security and compliance program that is rigorous enough for healthcare and practical enough to work in a small, fast-moving company.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Security & Compliance Lead to build and own Zenara’s security and compliance program.

You will set risk priorities, define security and HIPAA-related controls, verify that they work, and lead our responses to customer security reviews. You will work closely with the Head of Engineering and our Platform Engineer, who owns day-to-day platform operations and implements and operates many of the technical controls.

You own the program’s direction and outcomes. The Platform Engineer owns the day-to-day operation of the platform. You will work together to turn security requirements into working practices, not just documents.

Here is the test: can you inspect a real technical environment, identify the risks that matter most, explain the trade-offs, and work with engineers to implement and verify effective controls?

We are not looking for someone who only produces compliance paperwork. We need a leader with healthcare security judgment, technical depth, and the willingness to remain involved until a control actually works.

Our Security and Compliance Vision

Security and compliance should be part of how Zenara operates every day—not a last-minute exercise when a customer sends a questionnaire.

You will build a program with clear control owners, practical policies, current evidence, tracked remediation, and tested response procedures. It should give engineering a safe path to move quickly while helping us protect patient data and answer customer questions with confidence.

Your remit includes:

  • HIPAA-related safeguards, policies, and evidence
  • Security risk assessment and remediation priorities
  • Technical control standards and verification
  • Patient-data flows and access controls
  • Vendor and AI-tool risk
  • Customer security reviews and audit preparation
  • Incident response and escalation procedures
  • Security practices for AI-assisted engineering

The goal is not to create the largest possible program. It is to establish the right controls, make ownership clear, and ensure those controls keep working as Zenara grows.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the security and compliance roadmap, including risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and follow-through.
  • Establish and maintain HIPAA-related policies, procedures, control requirements, and supporting evidence.
  • Review cloud infrastructure, access controls, secrets management, and other technical safeguards with the Platform Engineer.
  • Define what technical controls must achieve; partner with the Platform Engineer to implement and operate them; independently verify their effectiveness.
  • Review patient-data flows, vendors, AI tools, and LLM-related data risks.
  • Set requirements for how AI agents and tools access data, systems, and production environments.
  • Lead responses to customer security questionnaires and coordinate preparation for audits or other external reviews.
  • Establish incident response and escalation procedures, and help coordinate the response to significant security events.
  • Review the Platform Engineer’s security work regularly, mentor them, and identify gaps early.
  • Maintain a clear record of findings, decisions, exceptions, control owners, and remediation progress.

How You’ll Work With the Platform Engineer

These are closely connected roles, but they do not have identical ownership.

You will own: security and compliance strategy, risk decisions, control standards, HIPAA-related program requirements, verification, vendor and AI-tool risk reviews, and customer security responses.

The Platform Engineer will own: day-to-day infrastructure operations, deployments, monitoring, backups and restores, technical implementation of platform controls, and recurring operational checks.

For example, you may define the access-control standard and how its effectiveness will be verified. The Platform Engineer may implement it in Azure and operate the recurring checks. You will review the evidence, address exceptions, and remain accountable for whether the standard is adequate.

What AI-Native Security Means Here

Our engineering team uses AI agents to help build and operate software. That creates opportunities to improve speed and consistency, as well as risks that conventional security processes may miss.

You will help define:

  • Which tools and agents may access patient data, code, infrastructure, and production systems
  • What permissions and approval boundaries they need
  • How we assess AI vendors and data-processing risks
  • How agent activity and security findings are logged, reviewed, and escalated
  • Where automation can improve control monitoring and evidence collection

You do not need to be the person building every agent. You do need the judgment to govern their use and verify that automated checks are reliable. AI can assist with security work; it does not take accountability for security decisions.

What We’re Looking For

  • Senior-level healthcare security and compliance experience, including substantial HIPAA expertise.
  • Verifiable examples of security or compliance programs, safeguards, or reviews you have led.
  • Hands-on technical security knowledge across cloud infrastructure, access control, secrets, and data protection.
  • Ability to assess a real technical environment—not only review policies.
  • Experience establishing or improving security practices in a small or growing organization.
  • Ability to translate risks and requirements into controls engineers can implement and operate.
  • Experience guiding engineers while independently assessing whether their controls work.
  • Clear written communication about risks, decisions, priorities, and practical next steps.
  • Judgment about what to address immediately, what to plan for, and when to escalate.

Relevant Areas

  • HIPAA and healthcare data security
  • Azure cloud and AKS / Kubernetes security
  • Access and secrets management
  • Patient-data flows and technical safeguards
  • Vendor and AI-tool risk
  • Customer security reviews
  • Control evidence and audit preparation
  • Incident response
  • Security roadmap prioritization

Nice to Have

  • SOC 2 or HITRUST experience
  • Azure security experience
  • Experience building a program at an early-stage startup
  • Experience assessing AI/LLM vendors and agent access to sensitive data

What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will review our current environment with the Platform Engineer, identify the highest-priority security and compliance gaps, clarify control ownership, and establish a practical remediation plan.

Within 90 days, core HIPAA-related policies and controls will have assigned owners and supporting evidence. Priority findings will be tracked to resolution, and the team will have a working cadence for reviewing risks, control effectiveness, and customer security requests.

Over time, Zenara will have a maintained security and compliance program: current evidence, tested incident procedures, tracked exceptions, clear ownership, and the ability to respond confidently to customer security reviews. Success means we can demonstrate how controls work in practice—not merely point to documents saying they exist.

Schedule

This is a full-time, remote role requiring regular live collaboration with our US-based founder and India-based engineering team. India-evening overlap is expected; the specific hours will be confirmed during hiring.

Significant security incidents may occasionally require coordination outside the usual collaboration window.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, based on demonstrated expertise and experience
  • Fully remote work
  • Equipment allowance
  • Direct access to the founder and Head of Engineering
  • Significant ownership of the security and compliance foundations of an AI-native healthcare company

Who Will Thrive in This Role

This role is well suited to someone who:

  • Has real healthcare security and HIPAA experience.
  • Can combine policy knowledge with technical review.
  • Enjoys building a program and developing the people who operate its controls.
  • Prioritizes clearly instead of treating every finding as equally urgent.
  • Follows through from recommendation to implementation and verification.
  • Can balance startup speed with disciplined protection of patient data.

You may struggle if you prefer to advise from a distance, produce generic documentation without verifying implementation, or need a large established security team and budget to make progress.

If you want to own the security and compliance program for an AI-native health-tech company—and build foundations that work in practice—we would love to hear from you.

raw.title: Cybersecurity Lead / ISSM Support
raw.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Cybersecurity Lead / ISSM Support professional to lead Task 6 cybersecurity delivery and support the Government Information System Security Manager (ISSM) in protecting USMEPCOM systems, applications, infrastructure, and information assets.
raw.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Cybersecurity Lead / ISSM Support professional to lead Task 6 cybersecurity delivery and support the Government Information System Security Manager (ISSM) in protecting USMEPCOM systems, applications, infrastructure, and information assets.

This Subject Matter Expert will provide leadership across security governance, risk prioritization, policy maintenance, authorization activities, vulnerability remediation, and inspection readiness. The Cybersecurity Lead will coordinate corrective actions across infrastructure, application, contractor, and Government teams while ensuring the accuracy of cybersecurity reporting and the timely closure of identified findings.

The successful candidate will bring extensive experience leading cybersecurity operations in Department of Defense environments and the ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable risk recommendations for Government and program leadership.

This position is remote, with a preference for candidates located in the Chicago area.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Cybersecurity Lead / ISSM Support professional will:

  • Lead delivery of ENLIST Task 6 cybersecurity activities and serve as the senior contractor cybersecurity subject matter expert.
  • Support the Government ISSM in security governance, risk prioritization, policy maintenance, authorization support, and cybersecurity inspection readiness.
  • Advise Government and program leadership on cybersecurity risks, compliance gaps, remediation priorities, and operational impacts.
  • Lead coordination of cybersecurity remediation activities across infrastructure, application, service delivery, contractor, and Government teams.
  • Support Risk Management Framework activities and the development, maintenance, review, and validation of authorization documentation.
  • Support Authority to Operate and Authority to Connect activities for applicable networks, systems, applications, and software.
  • Coordinate implementation and assessment of applicable NIST security controls and Department of Defense cybersecurity requirements.
  • Oversee Information Assurance Vulnerability Alert and Information Assurance Vulnerability Management tracking and remediation.
  • Coordinate recurring Assured Compliance Assessment Solution scans, analyze findings, and track vulnerabilities through remediation or approved risk acceptance.
  • Review Endpoint Security Solutions reports and coordinate resolution of identified security issues.
  • Develop, maintain, and monitor Plans of Action and Milestones, corrective-action plans, and other remediation records.
  • Monitor corrective actions to ensure findings are assigned, documented, validated, and closed within required timeframes.
  • Support certification and accreditation reviews, security control testing, Security Test and Evaluation activities, and development of associated test plans.
  • Support Cybersecurity Readiness Inspection preparation, assessment activities, findings management, remediation, and follow-up reporting.
  • Maintain and update the program Information Security Plan, cybersecurity policies, standard operating procedures, user guides, memoranda for record, and system interconnection agreements.
  • Review and validate system access requests and support enforcement of approved access-control requirements.
  • Evaluate systems and assets against applicable NIST, National Security Agency, Security Technical Implementation Guide, and approved desktop or platform security requirements.
  • Monitor changes to cybersecurity regulations, policies, technical requirements, and threat conditions, and recommend corresponding updates to program controls and procedures.
  • Produce accurate cybersecurity status reports, risk summaries, compliance metrics, inspection-readiness assessments, and executive-level briefings.
  • Validate the accuracy and completeness of cybersecurity data used in program reports, dashboards, and Government submissions.
  • Translate vulnerability data, security-control deficiencies, and technical findings into prioritized and actionable risk recommendations.
  • Promote consistent cybersecurity practices, lessons learned, and continuous improvement across the ENLIST program.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 12 years of relevant cybersecurity or information security experience.
  • Current Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) certification.
  • Demonstrated experience leading Department of Defense cybersecurity operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate technical cybersecurity findings into actionable risk recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience directly supporting a Government ISSM, Information System Security Officer, Authorizing Official, or system owner.
  • Advanced knowledge of the DoD Risk Management Framework, including authorization package development, security-control assessment, continuous monitoring, and authorization maintenance.
  • Experience applying DoDI 8510.01, NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, and related federal and DoD cybersecurity requirements.
  • Experience supporting Authority to Operate and Authority to Connect activities in a DoD environment.
  • Experience conducting or supporting vulnerability management using ACAS or Tenable, Endpoint Security Solutions, STIG Viewer, Security Content Automation Protocol tools, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience managing IAVA, IAVM, Plan of Action and Milestones, and corrective-action remediation processes.
  • Experience supporting Cybersecurity Readiness Inspections, security assessments, control testing, or Security Test and Evaluation activities.
  • Experience with eMASS or comparable governance, risk, and compliance platforms.
  • Experience developing cybersecurity policies, security plans, standard operating procedures, interconnection agreements, risk assessments, and executive briefings.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or other workflow platforms used to manage security findings, risks, remediation activities, and performance reporting.
  • Additional certifications such as CISM, CCSP, CGRC, CASP+, or equivalent advanced cybersecurity credentials.
  • Familiarity with current DoD 8140 cybersecurity workforce qualification requirements.
  • Strong leadership, stakeholder coordination, risk communication, analytical, and technical writing skills.
  • Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage multiple high-priority cybersecurity activities in a remote mission environment.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

The Senior CyberSecurity Engineer will design, implement, and support enterprise Identity Security solutions across a complex healthcare environment. The role focuses on secure identity lifecycle management, authentication, authorization, access governance, compliance, and integration of enterprise and clinical applications.
The engineer will work extensively with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC), Okta, Microsoft Active Directory (AD), and Microsoft Entra ID, supporting both modern cloud services and contemporary healthcare applications.

Responsibilities:

  • Engineer and support Identity Security solutions using SailPoint ISC, Okta, AD, and Entra ID.
  • Design and implement JML, provisioning/deprovisioning, access certification, RBAC, SSO, MFA, federation, and entitlement governance capabilities.
  • Integrate enterprise and clinical applications using SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, and REST APIs.
  • Apply least privilege and Zero Trust principles across workforce, partner, vendor, and application identities.
  • Automate identity processes to improve the reliability, scalability, and auditability of access controls.
  • Troubleshoot complex provisioning, directory, authentication, and access issues across interconnected platforms.
  • Partner with application, clinical technology, architecture, compliance, and cybersecurity teams to establish secure identity patterns.
  • Support regulatory and audit requirements, including controls associated with HIPAA and the protection of sensitive healthcare information.
  • Provide senior-level technical leadership, engineering standards, design reviews, and mentoring.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Strong experience in Identity Security, IAM, or cybersecurity engineering.
  • Hands-on experience with SailPoint ISC, Okta, Active Directory, and/or Entra ID.
  • Strong knowledge of identity lifecycle management, access governance, RBAC, SSO, MFA, and federation.
  • Experience with SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, APIs, and directory technologies.
  • Experience integrating applications into enterprise Identity Security ecosystems.
  • Healthcare or other highly regulated industry experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience securing clinical and healthcare applications is highly desirable.
  • Strong automation, troubleshooting, and technical problem-solving skills.


Use your skills to make an impact

A senior, hands-on engineer who understands Identity Security end to end, from identity lifecycle and authentication through access governance and compliance. raw.description:
This role requires at least 3 years selling custom website, web application or CMS projects at a digital agency or consultancy.

Who We Are

Urban Insight designs and builds websites and web applications for organizations that make a difference, including some of the best-known museums, associations, nonprofits and universities. For more than 25 years we’ve solved complex problems through strategy, design and development on open-source platforms, primarily Drupal and WordPress, including headless and composable architectures.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Director of Business Development to own new business growth. You’ll sell website redesigns, platform migrations, discovery and digital strategy, and multi-year support to marketing, digital and IT leaders, with typical engagements of $150,000 to $500,000.

The role has two key responsibilities. First, you’ll build your own book of business: identify the organizations in our markets we should be working with, open conversations with their leaders, and turn those conversations into qualified opportunities through outreach, events, partners and referrals. Second, you’ll own our sales process for every opportunity that comes to us through referrals, partners, RFPs, our website and marketing. You respond, qualify, run the meetings, write the proposals and close.

You won’t do it alone: our senior team joins larger pursuits as executive sponsors and subject-matter experts, our technical strategists and client strategists help shape solutions, and you’ll start from proposal templates and a library of past work. But each pursuit is yours to own.

Why you’ll win here: you’ll be selling an award-winning portfolio, clients like LACMA, Yale and USC, deep Drupal and WordPress expertise, and a delivery team with an average tenure of more than five years. Our clients come back for support and follow-on work, and you’ll have live opportunities from day one while you build your own book.

This is a role for someone who likes the hunt and knows how to run a disciplined sales process. You’ll also have a seat on our management team from day one as the voice of sales and business development.

Key deliverables

  • Build your book of business - Build and work a named target-account list across our core sectors using research-driven, personalized outreach by email, LinkedIn, phone and events. Develop referral and partner channels with platform partners, design firms, systems integrators and past clients.
  • Own the inbound sales process - Respond to every inbound lead within one business day, qualify it, and run discovery and every client meeting through to a decision.
  • Proposals, RFPs and presentations - Write and own proposals, RFP responses and presentations using our templates and proposal library. Bring in our senior team and technical strategists for content, solution design and orals, and partner with delivery on estimates and scopes of work.
  • Own every deal through to a strong start - Negotiate and close, set each new client up for success with our delivery team, and keep a CRM and pipeline the operations and leadership team can run the business on.
  • Market presence - Represent Urban Insight at conferences and sector events with a clear plan for meetings booked and followed up, working closely with our Marketing Director.

Success Metrics

In your first 3 months

  • Learn our services, case studies, sectors and current pipeline.
  • Take ownership of every open opportunity and bring each one current in HubSpot with a clear next step.
  • Working with our CEO and Marketing Director, build a target-account plan of 150 organizations.
  • Book 25+ first meetings with decision-makers at target organizations.
  • Create at least two self-sourced qualified opportunities of $75K or more.

In your first year

  • Achieve $1.5mm in new business bookings.
  • Generate $2.0mm in self-sourced qualified pipeline and $400K in bookings from new clients you sourced.

Key Requirements

  • 7+ years in B2B sales, including 3+ years selling custom website, web application or CMS projects (Drupal, WordPress, headless or similar) at a digital agency or consultancy.
    A track record of opportunities you personally sourced and closed, with numbers to show it.
  • Experience running the full sales cycle on services engagements of $100,000 to $500,000, including personally closing multiple deals of $150,000 or more with executive buyers.
  • You’ve sold web design and development or comparable digital services, and you understand how these projects are scoped, built and priced well enough to lead discovery and spot a risky scope.
  • Naturally curious and consultative; you uncover a client’s goals, pain points, budget and decision process before proposing a solution, and you turn conversations into relationships and relationships into opportunities.
  • Strong proposal writer; you have written winning proposals and RFP responses yourself.
  • Organized and disciplined about pipeline and follow-through.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling to nonprofits, cultural institutions, associations, and higher education.
  • Experience with modern outbound and CRM tools such as HubSpot, Apollo, Reply.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and AI research and writing tools.
  • Bachelor's degree.

Location & Availability

  • Remote within the U.S.; Los Angeles area is a plus.
  • Travel for conferences and client meetings, roughly 4 to 6 trips per year.

Compensation

  • Base salary of $100,000 - $150,000 plus commission, with on-target earnings of $165,000 - $205,000.
  • Commission is uncapped and pays a higher rate on clients you bring in yourself.
  • Health & Dental insurance (95% employer-paid).
  • Company-sponsored 401(k) plan with employer match.
  • Paid time off (15 days increasing to 20 after four years).
  • Holiday time off (~10 days per year).
  • Performance and compensation reviews annually.
  • An annual customized training plan and time to study.

About Urban Insight

  • Urban Insight is a leading digital agency -
  • We work with some of the best-known museums, nonprofits and other institutions, such as LACMA, The Broad, University of Southern California, City of Los Angeles, and the Japanese American National Museum.
  • We've won numerous design awards such as for our work for Stay Housed Los Angeles and the National World War 1 Museum & Memorial.
  • We're the top-ranked Web development agency in Los Angeles, according to Clutch, an independent analyst. Have a look at what our clients say about us:
  • We have a clearly defined project management methodology and case management system.
  • We run on the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS).

Why Work at Urban Insight

  • We take on interesting, meaningful projects for appreciative clients
  • We offer a flexible working environment - work from anywhere in the United States
  • We work with you to create a career path that works for you
  • The average employee tenure is 5.6 years
  • We're stable and growing. We've been in business for over 25 years and continue to grow
  • We allocate resources and time for training and professional development
  • We have weekly events to keep the team connected: Lunch & Learns, Lightning Demos, Game Breaks
  • There are many more reasons:

To Apply

Please apply on this page. This position is open until filled. Thank you for your interest in working with us at Urban Insight.

About World Business Lenders

World Business Lenders (WBL) provides general purpose short-term real estate collateralized commercial loans to a broad customer base comprised of small and medium sized businesses throughout the United States that lack access to traditional funding. WBL services its loan portfolio and loan portfolios for third parties, specializing in the management of non-performing loan pools and REO.

Overview

  • The Asset Resolution Counsel is responsible for leading the legal strategy, portfolio management, and resolution efforts for a portfolio of non-performing commercial loans secured primarily by real estate. This role serves as a strategic business partner responsible for maximizing recoveries while minimizing legal risk, loss severity, and resolution timelines.
  • Working collaboratively with internal stakeholders, outside counsel, loan servicing teams, and borrowers, the Asset Resolution Counsel develops and executes resolution strategies through negotiation, restructuring, litigation, foreclosure, bankruptcy, receivership, REO disposition, and other loss mitigation initiatives.
  • This position requires sound legal judgment, strong financial and analytical skills, and the ability to balance business objectives with legal and regulatory compliance.

Essential Functions:

  • Manage and monitor a non-performing real estate collateralized commercial loan portfolio, including REO, toward most effective and efficient resolution
  • Supervise, train and develop Asset Resolution Department staff
  • Conduct proactive and effective portfolio management in accordance with established performance standards
  • Monitor and manage commercial litigation/bankruptcy/foreclosure activities, functions and deadlines
  • Direct/monitor/liaise with in-house and outside attorneys, collection agencies and other vendors that support the loss mitigation effort
  • Interact with customers and their counsel
  • Negotiate and propose settlement agreements and bidding instructions
  • Monitor loss mitigation workout performance and loss severity trends
  • Implement and communicate loss mitigation decisions
  • Maintain delinquency and loss mitigation reporting, including trend analysis and assessment
  • Conduct comprehensive analysis of debtors' financial position, credit status, personal background, and historical payment performance
  • Facilitate negotiation and conflict resolution
  • Perform extensive quarterly review of portfolio being managed to confirm or reassess recovery estimates
  • Monitor related expenses (taxes, maintenance, utilities, fees, etc.) and timely propose protective advances
  • Participate in budget preparation for the Asset Resolution Department.
  • Other projects and duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Education: 
    • Law degree (from a nationally accredited U.S. law school is preferred).
  • Experience:
    • Experience working in commercial litigation, bankruptcy, foreclosure, and real estate loss mitigation
    • Experience successfully managing non-performing loan (NPL) pools and REO portfolios
    • Experience supervising, developing, and mentoring case management staff
    • Litigation experience and familiarity with litigation management tools
    • Experience working for a U.S.-based company.

Key Soft Skills:

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

  • Strategic Decision Making
  • Commercial Lending & Real Estate Expertise
  • Portfolio & Risk Management
  • Financial Analysis & Business Acumen
  • Litigation & Bankruptcy Management
  • Negotiation & Conflict Resolution
  • Leadership & Team Development
  • Vendor & Outside Counsel Management
  • Executive Communication & Presentation Skills
  • Data-Driven Decision Making
  • Process Improvement & Operational Excellence
  • Exceptional Written and Verbal English Communication Skills
  • Professional, Personable, and Customer-Focused Interpersonal Skills
  • Sound Judgment, Integrity, and Accountability

Technical Skills:

The successful candidate should demonstrate proficiency in the following:

  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel (pivot tables, formulas, data analysis, and reporting), Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience working with loan servicing systems, case management platforms, or asset management software used to administer commercial loan portfolios.
  • Ability to interpret and analyze:
    • Promissory Notes
    • Mortgages and Deeds of Trust
    • Loan Agreements
    • Guaranties
    • UCC filings
    • Assignments of Rents
    • Security Agreements
    • Title commitments and title policies
    • Familiarity with commercial foreclosure, bankruptcy, receivership, and litigation management platforms.
  • Experience reviewing and analyzing:
    • Property valuations and appraisals
    • Environmental reports
    • Financial statements and tax returns
    • Business cash flow
    • Borrowing base reports
    • Credit reports
  • Ability to prepare and evaluate:
    • Recovery analyses
    • Settlement recommendations
    • Litigation budgets
    • Protective advance requests
    • Reserve analyses
  • Working knowledge of PACER, state and federal court docket systems, Secretary of State business entity databases, UCC filing systems, county land records, and tax assessor websites.
  • Experience utilizing business intelligence and reporting tools to monitor portfolio performance, recovery trends, legal spend, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Familiarity with eDiscovery, electronic document management systems, and secure document sharing platforms.
  • Experience working with Monday.com, Salesforce, SharePoint, or similar workflow/project management systems is preferred.
  • Ability to leverage AI-assisted legal research, document review, contract analysis, and productivity tools (such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Westlaw Precision AI, or Lexis+ AI) while maintaining attorney judgment and confidentiality.
  • Strong understanding of data security, confidentiality, and regulatory requirements applicable to commercial lending and legal operations.

Work Requirements

  • Must be available to work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time.
  • Must have a stable internet connection and professional remote working setup.

Benefits

🏖️ Paid Time Off (PTO)

Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

Our clients span the globe and cover a wide range of projects including IoT, blockchain, banking, fintech, networking, and ecommerce. Vinova earns respect from customers by being committed to quality, flexibility, and speed. We strive to build great products by working with passion, working closely with our customers, and through open but disciplined collaboration. You will be working in an encouraging and challenging environment, taking advantage of the latest technology to deliver high-impact digital solutions for global clients. You will be engaging clients in both on-site and off-site capacities.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced, high-caliber Business Analyst (BA) to lead functional solution design and requirements governance for large-scale enterprise platforms and public-sector digital initiatives. Serving as the strategic bridge between client stakeholders, end-users, and multi-disciplinary engineering squads (PM, Tech Leads, Developers, and QC), you will translate intricate operational requirements into robust, scalable, and audit-ready functional architectures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead stakeholder discovery sessions to evaluate business processes, user journeys, operational bottlenecks, and system integration points. Model optimized "to-be" workflows using structured process flow diagrams.
  • Author and maintain high-precision Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Specifications (FS), user stories, acceptance criteria, and system flow models with end-to-end requirement traceability.
  • Drive sprint planning, backlog refinement, and requirement walkthroughs with Scrum Masters, Project Managers, and development teams to ensure technical implementation aligns strictly with functional expectations.
  • Partner with the QC team to ensure comprehensive test case and scenario alignment against business rules. Facilitate System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), lead defect triage sessions, and conduct thorough impact analyses on Change Requests (CRs).
  • Proactively identify requirement gaps, scope risks, and cross-platform technical dependencies, formulating practical and actionable solutions to keep project delivery on schedule.

Key Requirements

  • Proven track record as a Business Analyst delivering complex IT, web, or mobile software development initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing enterprise-grade software, complex business workflows, or integration-heavy platforms.
  • Exceptional proficiency in requirements gathering, business process mapping, writing precise user stories with testable acceptance criteria, and producing formal functional specs.
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum lifecycles; hands-on experience supporting SIT/UAT cycles alongside QC engineers and business end-users.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills with the ability to navigate difficult conversations, facilitate client workshops, and align cross-functional priorities.

Bonus Points (Highly Preferred)

  • Direct experience working on projects within Banking, Finance, Government / Public Sector, or compliance-heavy environments.
  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks, data governance standards, or statutory security compliance.
  • Industry credentials such as CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, or PSPO/CSPO.

Why Join Vinova?

  • Direct exposure to strategic digital transformations for leading statutory bodies and multinational enterprise clients.
  • Attractive remuneration structure, performance-driven project bonuses, and clear annual merit increments.
  • Transparent, collaborative engineering environment partnering directly with senior technology leaders across Singapore and Vietnam.

SUMMARY

The Senior Total Rewards Specialist is an experienced individual contributor who supports the day-to-day administration of compensation and benefits programs. Working under the direction of the Total Rewards Manager, this role keeps rewards processes accurate, compliant, and running on schedule. You will support key cycles, including annual merit and bonus, benefits annual enrollment, and market pricing, by preparing data, processing transactions, running audits, and answering employee and HR questions. You will be a go-to resource for complex questions and a reliable partner to HR, Finance, and business leaders.

Location: Remote

ESSENTIAL DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES

Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Supports the administration of employee compensation and benefits programs, including health and welfare benefits and retirement offerings.
  • Prepares analyses, reports, and recommendations to support compensation and benefits decision-making, ensuring alignment with organizational strategy, budget considerations, and market practices.
  • Partners with HR, Finance, and business leaders to provide guidance on compensation and benefits programs, policies, processes, and employee inquiries.
  • Administers day-to-day health, welfare, retirement, and leave programs, and resolves escalated employee questions and eligibility issues.
  • Supports annual open enrollment, including plan design changes, system setup and testing, carrier file verification, employee communications, and employee help sessions.
  • Processes life events, COBRA notices, and leave paperwork, and reconciles monthly carrier and vendor invoices.
  • Maintains job codes, salary ranges, and job descriptions in the HRIS and compensation tools.
  • Supports the annual merit, promotion, and bonus cycles, loads and validates data, builds worksheets, answers manager questions, and audits results.
  • Runs recurring compensation and benefits reports and keeps HRIS data accurate through regular audits.
  • Helps keep programs compliant with FLSA, ERISA, ACA, COBRA, HIPAA, FMLA, and state pay transparency laws.
  • Gathers data for annual filings, nondiscrimination testing, and audits (e.g., Form 5500, ACA reporting)

CORE KNOWLEDGE and SKILLS

  • Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex Total Rewards concepts into clear, compelling insights and build alignment across diverse stakeholders, including executive leadership.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with a customer-service approach to employee questions.
  • Performs work under minimal supervision while helping optimize total rewards programs and enhance the employee experience.
  • Strong knowledge of applicable compensation and benefits regulations, including FLSA, ERISA, ACA, COBRA, FMLA, and pay transparency requirements.
  • Advanced Excel skills (lookups, pivot tables, formulas) and strong attention to data accuracy.
  • Proficiency with HRIS platforms and compensation management tools; experience with an HRIS system such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle, or UKG.
  • Experience completing compensation surveys and using compensation programs such as Payscale, Marketpay, and JD Expert is preferred.
  • Sound judgment and discretion with highly confidential information.
  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude and other AI tools specific to Total Rewards is a plus.

Core Competencies:

  • Intentional Collaboration & Synergy Building- Demonstrated ability to cultivate purposeful collaboration and synergies among internal and external stakeholders through a strategic and thoughtful approach.
  • Empathy and Emotional Intelligence - Demonstrate empathy and emotional intelligence to better understand employee concerns about benefits and sensitive situations, approaching interactions with compassion.
  • Adaptability - The ability to adjust to changes in vendors, regulations, and employee needs while thriving in fast-paced environments filled with uncertainty.
  • Candor - Comfortable working in a culture that values transparency and is committed to sharing and receiving meaningful feedback for collective improvement.
  • Service mindset- This mindset emphasizes prioritizing the needs of others, fostering a culture of service, and empowering individuals to perform at their best. By leading through example, it inspires mutual support and respect and creates a positive environment where everyone feels valued.

EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE

  • 4+ years of Total Rewards experience, compensation and benefits experience required.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • CEBS, CCP, CBP, SHRM-CP/SCP, PHR/SPHR, or similar certification is a plus.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This position will not have any direct reports.

Salary Range: $73,300 - $88,000 annually, depending on experience and geographic location.

Please note that actual compensation offered may vary based on local pay requirements, and will meet or exceed state-specific minimum wage or salary thresholds.

Benefits and Well-Being:

We offer a competitive benefits package, including 6 paid holidays, 1 paid floating holiday and up to 20 days of Paid Time Off per year, Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, Company-matching 401(k) and Employee Stock Purchase Program, in addition to other programs and perks. More details about our benefits can be found here.

The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, project teams, engineers, and customer representatives to design secure solutions, support security transformation initiatives, and ensure alignment with industry and government security frameworks.

This position offers the opportunity to work across security architecture, consulting, security assurance, IRAP readiness, solution delivery, and security operations, helping clients strengthen their overall cybersecurity posture while meeting regulatory and contractual obligations.

Key Responsibilities

Security Architecture & Design

  • Provide security architecture guidance across cloud, infrastructure, network, endpoint, and identity platforms.
  • Validate security requirements for new and existing solutions.
  • Conduct design reviews to identify risks and control gaps.
  • Develop and maintain architecture and security design documentation.

Client Advisory & Delivery

  • Engage directly with Australian Government clients to facilitate security workshops, architecture reviews, and risk discussions.
  • Translate business and regulatory requirements into practical and effective technical outcomes.
  • Conduct security assessments, gap analyses, and cybersecurity maturity reviews.
  • Present findings, recommendations, and remediation strategies to technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Provide security oversight throughout project lifecycles, from requirements gathering through implementation and operational transition.
  • Participate in governance forums, design authorities, and technical review boards to ensure solutions meet security, architecture, and contractual requirements.

Pre-Sales & Solution Support

  • Support customer pursuits and pre-sales activities by providing cybersecurity subject matter expertise.
  • Contribute to solution designs, statements of work (SOWs), and technical proposals.
  • Participate in customer workshops and solution discussions.
  • Identify opportunities for security uplift, advisory services, and managed security engagements.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Conduct security risk assessments and maintain risk registers.
  • Develop risk mitigation and treatment recommendations.
  • Develop and maintain security standards, policies, procedures, and supporting documentation.
  • Support audit, assurance, and accreditation activities aligned to the Information Security Manual (ISM), Essential Eight, and Protective Security Policy Framework (PSPF).

IRAP & Security Assurance

  • Provide architecture guidance and control reviews aligned with ISM requirements.
  • Support clients in preparing for IRAP assessments and accreditation activities.
  • Develop security documentation, evidence packs, and compliance artefacts.
  • Collaborate with assessors, project teams, and stakeholders to address and remediate assessment findings.

Security Operations

  • Review vulnerability assessment and security reporting outputs.
  • Support vulnerability prioritization and remediation activities.
  • Assist Security Operations Centre (SOC), engineering, and client teams during security incidents.
  • Contribute to incident reporting, investigation, and corrective action planning.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

Essential

  • Demonstrated experience in security architecture, cybersecurity consulting, security engineering, governance, risk and compliance (GRC), or security operations.
  • Experience working within government, defence, or other highly regulated environments.
  • Strong understanding of the Information Security Manual (ISM), Essential Eight, PSPF, and security assurance practices.
  • Experience conducting security assessments, architecture reviews, and remediation planning activities.
  • Experience supporting projects through design, implementation, and operational transition.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across business, technical, and executive audiences.
  • Practical knowledge of cloud platforms, infrastructure, networking, endpoint security, and identity technologies.

Highly Desirable

  • Experience supporting Australian Government or Defence customers.
  • Experience with IRAP assessments, accreditation programs, or security assurance initiatives.
  • Experience in cybersecurity consulting, advisory services, managed security services, or pre-sales engagements.
  • Experience presenting to senior leadership teams, CISOs, governance boards, and technical review forums.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
  • CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)
  • CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor)
  • SABSA
  • TOGAF
  • Microsoft SC-100
  • Microsoft AZ-500
  • CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional)
  • Relevant industry experience and demonstrated delivery capability will be considered equally valuable to formal certifications.

Additional Requirements

  • Must be an Australian Citizen.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government security clearance if required for specific client engagements.
  • Existing Australian Government security clearance (Baseline, NV1, or NV2) is advantageous but not mandatory.

Role Type: Contractor (~15 hrs/week)

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Domain Contributor - Evaluation Specialists to support an internal project evaluating and improving advanced AI models. Scope of Work

  1. Design nuanced, domain-specific tasks that probe AI model limits and surface reasoning flaws.
  2. Author questions and scenarios demanding deep subject knowledge, beyond general understanding.
  3. Assess AI-generated outputs, validating accuracy against authoritative, primary sources in your area of expertise.
  4. Document clear rationales for model shortcomings, specifying missed reasoning, source errors, or nuances.

  4. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to articulate findings and feedback.
  5. Demonstrated ability to precisely follow detailed instructions and evaluation frameworks.
  6. Background in adversarial or “stomp the model” task design is advantageous.
  7. Graduate-level research, experience at a Fortune 100 company, or professional fluency in a non-English language a plus.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

And legal data is structured so AI agents can do useful work with it.

You won't hand requirements to engineering and move on. You'll prototype with AI, prove what works, and partner with our Product organization to turn the best of what we build into features our customers use. This is where we put AI to work for people, starting with our own.

What you get to do in this role:  

Own the roadmap

  • Own a multi-quarter roadmap for legal AI and platform initiatives across Contract Management Pro, Legal Service Delivery, and connected systems
  • Plan each quarter in epics, then deliver through iterative development, testing, and production release
  • Write epics, user stories, technical spikes, acceptance criteria, and solution approach documents that engineers can build from
  • Prioritize a busy backlog with clear tradeoffs, and say no when it matters
  • Lead discovery with legal and business teams, identify opportunities to improve workflows, and translate them into prioritized product requirements and measurable outcomes

Build AI agents legal teams trust

  • Design and deliver AI agents for legal work, such as advice and counsel recommendations, contract redlining against our standard terms, request intake and triage, and contract review

  • Make sure anything headed to production gets engineering review and hardening
  • Prove it works
  • Define evaluation criteria, test sets, and pass thresholds before any AI feature reaches production
  • Run model and vendor evaluations without locking into a single model or provider
  • Build and own value models (hours saved, request volume, cycle time) and report AI impact to senior leadership monthly and quarterly

Partner across ServiceNow

ORDERYOYO

Lead Software Engineer – Payments

Remote · Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices · Competitive salary

About the Role

At OrderYOYO, payments sit at the heart of everything we do. Every order placed, every restaurant paid, and every dispute resolved runs through the systems this team owns and operates.

We're looking for a Lead Software Engineer – Payments to own the next stage of our payments platform's evolution — as a hands-on technical leader who can grow and manage a team of payments engineers, set the technical direction for a business-critical domain, and support our transition to a more scalable operating model across online ordering and in-store platforms (POS, Kiosk, and payment terminals).

You'll play a central role in shaping how OrderYOYO handles money — from authorisation and settlement to disputes and merchant invoicing — while building and developing the people who make that possible.

Role Mission

Lead the people, architecture, and delivery behind OrderYOYO's payments platform — enabling KYC onboarding, deductions, settlement/payout timing, dispute flows, and merchant invoicing — while growing a high-performing engineering team and raising the bar on reliability, security, and engineering quality in one of our most business-critical domains.

Core Responsibilities

People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of payments engineers — providing hands-on technical guidance, regular feedback, and clear paths for career development.
  • Own hiring and team-building for the payments engineering function, partnering with recruiting to define role profiles, run interviews, and bring in strong talent.
  • Run day-to-day people management: 1:1s, goal-setting, performance reviews, and career progression conversations for direct reports.
  • Build a team culture where payments knowledge is documented and shared, not tribal — through design reviews, standards, and mentoring.
  • Represent the payments engineering team in leadership and cross-functional conversations, translating business needs into technical strategy and team priorities.
  • Balance hands-on technical contribution with people-management responsibilities, staying close enough to the codebase to lead by example and unblock the team.

Technical & Domain Ownership

  • Set the technical direction and long-term architecture strategy for payment-domain services, including gateway integrations, payment intent/authorisation/capture/refund flows, payout orchestration, and reconciliation.
  • Oversee marketplace capabilities: onboarding/KYC integration, merchant configuration, settlement instructions, deductions, and invoicing/merchant-statement alignment.
  • Ensure robust “flow-of-funds” primitives across the team's systems — idempotency, ledgers/events, and audit trails that are fully supportable for finance and compliance.
  • Own the strategy for PSP and partner integrations, with close attention to tri-party / sub-merchant implications where applicable.
  • Oversee dispute/chargeback and fraud-handling touchpoints across internal workflows and PSP tooling, and drive collaboration with Ops on runbooks and escalation paths.
  • Partner closely with Product, Legal/Compliance, Finance, and Support to convert requirements into safe, testable production behaviour.
  • Raise engineering quality in a high-change domain: automated testing, safe rollouts/canaries, observability, and incident-response improvements, with accountability for outcomes across the team.

Must-Have Requirements

  • Proven experience leading, mentoring, or people-managing a team of software engineers — including hiring, performance management, and career development.
  • Strong backend engineering background in distributed systems — microservices, async processing, resilient APIs, and eventual consistency.
  • Production experience with payment flows (auth/capture/refund, webhooks, reconciliation) and “money correctness” patterns such as idempotency keys, double-entry thinking, and auditability.
  • A solid security mindset: PCI compliance, PII protection, secrets management, least privilege, and secure coding practices.
  • Comfort working in an Azure-first environment (APIs, queues/eventing, monitoring), with strong CI/CD and automated testing practices.
  • Clear, confident communication with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders in high-stakes scenarios — incidents, financial breaks, and compliance requests.
  • Strong judgement on when to move fast, when to standardise, and when to say “not yet” with evidence — balancing team capacity, technical debt, and business priorities.

Strong-to-Have Experience

FICO (NYSE: FICO)is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity


This position is a great opportunity for a strategic, creative, and AI-savvy marketer with a proven track record of designing and executing multi-channel enterprise B2B marketing programs that start conversations and drive and accelerate pipeline at scale.

This director owns solution campaign marketing for North American growth accounts— the broad base of prospect and early-stage accounts across FICO's target industries. The mandate is to build interest, awareness, and qualified pipeline across that account universe so that accounts land, generate initial ARR, and earn a place in our Pod-based ABM program. This role is the engine that feeds the Pods, which are responsible for expansion of our FICO® Platform solution across our existing customer accounts.


What You’ll Contribute


  • Serve as the strategic solution campaign marketing lead for all NorAm growth accounts. You’ll set priorities and orchestrate execution, collaborating with FICO’s digital, value messaging team, events, and SDR teams without direct management authority — requiring strong influence and coalition-building skills.
  • Design and execute well-orchestrated, scalable multi-channel campaigns incorporating email, webinars, advertising, tradeshows, and other 1:Many tactics to create awareness and interest across account base and convert it into qualified pipeline. Candidates should be equally strong across both disciplines; and all campaigns will be AI first.
  • Define and run the account journey from first touch to "Pod-ready": build and manage a consistent set of criteria and handoff process, in partnership with sales and Pod leadership, for when a landed account with initial ARR graduates from campaign-based coverage into a Pod for ongoing ABM.
  • Own marketing-sourced pipeline, new-logo, and initial-ARR targets across assigned account base, and manage the allocated marketing budget against those targets.
  • Bring a point of view on how AI can be used to generate qualified pipeline beyond content creation at scale — including approaches such as predictive or intent-based lead scoring, AI-driven account prioritization and next-best-action recommendations across a large account universe, and AI-assisted SDR workflows or automation. Hands-on implementation experience is not required, but candidates who can speak credibly to what they’ve tried, what worked, and what didn’t will be strongly preferred, as this person will help shape our broader AI strategy for pipeline generation.
  • Apply scaled, 1:Many and 1:Few campaign strategies across the non-Pod account base —to build pipeline broadly and surface the accounts with the strongest signals for a Pod handoff.
  • Build and maintain a strong partnership with NorAm Sales leadership and Pod leads, and nurture ongoing relationships with account managers, the SDR team, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Develop messaging strategies and content for emails, webinars, and events, collaborating closely with product marketing and other stakeholders.
  • Partner with the events team to plan and execute outstanding tradeshows and customer-specific events (approximately 10–25% travel expected).
  • Identify white-space growth opportunities across the assigned NorAm account base within the context of the fiscal sales plan and multi-year regional strategy, and build the pipeline of accounts ready to graduate into the Pod model.

What We’re Seeking


  • Deep knowledge of complex selling environments in the B2B technology world and what it takes to build brand and product awareness and pipeline.
  • 10 to 15 years of progressive B2B technology marketing experience, with a demonstrated ability to operate at a strategic level and lead through influence rather than direct authority.
  • Proven experience running scaled, always-on campaign engines (email, digital, webinars, tradeshows) across a large, diverse account base, and converting broad interest into qualified, sales-ready pipeline.
  • B2B technology marketing experience spanning FICO's core industries (banking, telco, and related sectors) preferred; familiarity with the competitive and regulatory landscape across these spaces is a significant advantage.
  • Maturity and skill in collaborating with senior executives, customers, and sales teams to align on goals and work through business challenges.
  • Creative skills in both communications and problem solving.
  • Expertise in using metrics and marketing performance measurement to optimize results and ROI in a corporate marketing environment.
  • Strong experience using GenAI to develop demand generation and event content and personalize content to specific personas and accounts, and — ideally — broader experience exploring AI-driven approaches to pipeline generation beyond content creation (see above).
  • Outstanding writing and presentation skills.
  • A passion for technology, learning, and creativity.
  • Knowledge and experience building demand marketing plans, and a clear point of view on how campaign-based demand generation and Pod-based ABM should hand off to one another as accounts mature.
  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in marketing or a related field.

Our Offer to You


  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers, and Earn the Respect of Others.
  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits, and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.
  • The targeted base pay range for this role is: $115,500 to $181,500 with this range reflecting differences in candidate knowledge, skills and experience.

Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

• Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.

• Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.

• Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at

raw.description:
Reimagine the infrastructure of cancer care within a community that values integrity, inspires growth, and is uniquely positioned to create a more modern, connected oncology ecosystem. We’re looking for a Medical Director to help us accomplish our mission to improve and extend lives by learning from the experience of every person with cancer. Are you ready to be the next changemaker in cancer care?

A note on level: We're open to candidates at the Associate Medical Director or Medical Director level depending on experience and scope of prior ownership in precision medicine.

What You'll Do

Flatiron Health is looking for a data-and technology-oriented clinician with oncology subject matter expertise who is passionate about real-world evidence (RWE) accelerating progress against cancer. You will be part of the Global Research Oncology team that operates across the US, UK, Germany, and Japan.

In this role you will collaborate with a cross-functional team of oncologists/clinicians, data scientists, epidemiologists, software engineers, product managers, account directors, and clinical data specialists to help develop, commercialize, and deliver our oncology research data and services leveraging a breadth of tools, including artificial intelligence. You will serve as a core medical resource with a particular focus in precision medicine and cancer genomics. You will also help biopharma clients apply clinical and molecular use cases across the full R&D lifecycle—from early pipeline discovery through post-market clinical development. In addition you will:

  • Clinical Oncology & Precision Medicine Expert: Serve as a core medical expert unblocking high-volume, custom data requests across oncologic diseases including rare tumor types and complex, multi-omic biomarker profiles. Flexibly pivot across oncologic disease areas to scope, design, and clinically validate custom datasets and analyses for our biopharma partners.
  • Translational Oncology & Discovery Partner: Partner with clients early in their R&D lifecycle to show how clinical-molecular datasets can fuel target discovery, characterize novel biomarker-defined cohorts, evaluate tumor biology, and guide combination therapy approaches. Help researchers validate preclinical hypotheses in real-world cohorts and explore clinical trial findings via reverse translation.
  • Clinical Development Translation: Apply clinical development and trial design principles to help biopharma clients bridge the gap between traditional clinical endpoints and real-world evidence (RWE). Help clients understand how real world data can support external control arms, historic cohorts, or synthetic control designs for niche or rare trial populations.
  • Commercial Pre-Sales & Scoping Subject Matter Expert: Proactively provide clinical and molecular data expertise to support teams during pre-sales, client scoping, and solution building utilising internal or off-the-shelf external AI tools. Partner with scientific and commercial leaders to translate a client’s clinical development planning, target validation, or complex inclusion/exclusion criteria into precise data specifications across our various data assets.
  • Cross-Functional Solutioning: Partner closely with matrixed project teams to apply established clinical-molecular frameworks to complex dataset deliveries and custom client requests.
  • Internal Capability Building: Support the development of internal training resources and clinical documentation to help upskill delivery teams on rare biomarker cohorts and molecular data structures.
  • Scientific Contribution: Participate in research study projects requiring physician expertise with support from senior leaders, including presenting or speaking at scientific conferences.

Who You Are

You're a kind, passionate, and collaborative problem-solver who values the opportunity to think beyond the way things are. In addition, you are an oncologist with post training experience in clinical, academic or industry settings and direct experience with cancer genomics. This position requires leadership, outstanding problem-solving, analytical and communication skills, and experience multitasking and prioritizing in a fast-paced environment.

  • Medical Training: You hold an MD (or equivalent) with foundational training in oncology, hematology, or a related subspecialty.
  • Experience: You have post-training clinical, academic, or early industry experience. Qualifying years of experience are following completion of a subspecialty fellowship.
    • 1-3 years for the Associate Medical Director level
    • 3-5+ years for the Medical Director level
  • Clinical Development & Discovery Exposure: You have familiarity with clinical trial design, protocol development, or early-phase (Phase I/II) clinical development. Exposure to laboratory translational oncology, cancer genomics, or biomarker discovery research is highly valued.
  • Clinical Agility: You possess deep clinical intuition and are highly comfortable learning and diving into the clinical landscape of diverse, low-incidence rare tumors and complex molecular landscapes.
  • Matrix Collaboration: You are adept at working within a matrix-structured environment with multiple stakeholders and product lines, translating highly technical medical and genomic concepts for non-clinical internal teams.
  • Operational Execution: You are able to handle multiple tasks concurrently, contribute to intermediate-complexity clinical data projects with guidance and mentorship from senior leaders, and meet ongoing deadlines in a fast-paced technology driven environment.

Where You’ll Work

In this remote position, you have the freedom to choose your preferred work location while aligning your working hours with your team's. For further details on our hybrid work approach and remote work type, please visit the how we work website.

Life at Flatiron

At Flatiron Health, we offer a full range of benefits to support you and your loved ones so you can focus your working hours on improving cancer care and accelerating cancer research, and your non-working hours on everything else life has to offer:

  • Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive compensation package
  • 401(k) contribution to help you reach your retirement planning goals
  • Financial health resources including 1:1 financial advice
  • Mental well-being tools and services
  • Parental benefits and policies including family-building care and generous leave
  • Path to parenthood programs supporting fertility, adoption and surrogacy
  • Travel support for safe healthcare services

In addition to our robust benefit offerings, visit our Life at Flatiron page to learn how we support continuous learning and celebrate inclusion and belonging in the workplace.
