Bilingual Medical Scheduling & Patient Support Specialist

Remote | Gastroenterology | Part-Time, 40 hours/week | Rate: $6.5/hour

About the Role

This Gastroenterology practice is looking for a highly organized, patient-focused Bilingual Medical Scheduling & Patient Support Specialist to support its clinics in two locations in Texas.

This role is heavily focused on appointment scheduling and patient communication, with a high daily call volume of approximately 70 to 90 calls per day. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced healthcare environment, managing multiple communication channels, and maintaining accurate patient documentation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Appointment Scheduling

  • Handle approximately 70 to 90 inbound and outbound calls daily related to appointments for the Lewisville and Denton locations.

  • Schedule, reschedule, and cancel patient appointments while ensuring accurate and timely communication with patients.

  • Maintain and update provider schedules in RingCentral and eClinicalWorks (eCW) based on availability and scheduling requirements.

2. Fax Management

  • Send and receive faxes involving patient records, referrals, insurance documents, and other clinical or administrative information.

  • Review incoming fax communications and route documents to the appropriate provider, department, or patient record.

  • Accurately log, upload, and organize faxed documentation within the clinic's systems.

3. Language Interpretation Support

  • Provide occasional language interpretation assistance between patients and clinic staff when needed.

  • Help ensure medical and administrative information is communicated clearly and accurately across language barriers.

  • Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and accuracy when assisting with patient-provider communication.

4. Outbound Calling

  • Conduct outbound calls for appointment reminders, follow-ups, patient updates, and care coordination.

  • Contact insurance companies, referring providers, pharmacies, or other healthcare offices when necessary.

  • Document call outcomes, follow-up requirements, and relevant information accurately in the patient's record.

5. Patient Text Messaging

  • Send appointment confirmations, reminders, updates, and other approved patient communications through text messaging.

  • Monitor and collect patient responses and escalate questions or concerns to the appropriate clinic team member when needed.

  • Document relevant text conversations and patient responses in RingCentral and eCW to maintain continuity of care.

6. Billing and Payment Reminder Support

  • Contact patients regarding outstanding balances, billing reminders, or upcoming payment obligations as instructed by the clinic.

  • Provide basic payment-related information and direct patients to the appropriate billing resource when additional assistance is required.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in medical administration, medical virtual assistance, patient scheduling, front desk support, or a similar healthcare role is strongly preferred.

  • Comfortable handling a high-volume call environment, including approximately 70 to 90 calls per day.

  • Experience using eClinicalWorks (eCW) and RingCentral is highly preferred.

  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills with a professional and patient-friendly approach.

  • Strong attention to detail, organization, documentation, and ability to manage multiple tasks throughout the workday.

  • Experience supporting a gastroenterology or specialty medical practice is an advantage.

  • Ability to communicate in an additional language and provide interpretation support is an advantage.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is confident speaking with patients throughout the day, comfortable managing a high volume of appointments and communications, and able to stay organized while supporting two clinic locations. You should be dependable, detail-oriented, professional, and capable of providing a positive patient experience while maintaining accurate documentation.

TheQCx Program ManagermustrepresentVantage anddriveQuality and Commissioning efforts across the project from design to turnover.Itis expectedthat the Quality Manager will behave as a role model andact asanambassadorof Quality, Safety and Commissioning best practicesin all interactions with internal and external stakeholders.

Must be able to foster a positive and collaborative working environment with the team, as well as performing the role of ‘Critical Friend’ whenneeded.

🚀 The Vision: Building the Operating System for Product Creation

Since 2013, THE/STUDIO has been building the definitive operating system for product creation. We are combining modern SaaS technology with custom manufacturing to make producing physical goods as seamless, fast, and scalable as launching software.

We operate two core platforms: Customize Now (our best-in-class, on-demand manufacturing platform) and Source Anything (our new SaaS product that enables customers to seamlessly work with global factories beyond our own network).

You will own everything a customer reads and experiences after they find us: the website, lifecycle communication, email, and the positioning and messaging behind all of it. The goal is simple. More visitors become customers, and more customers come back.

This is an in-house role. It depends on collecting and applying knowledge about our product, market and audience every week, which is why we are not outsourcing it.

Position Title: Senior Consultant or Principal Consultant - Microsoft Modern Work Solutions

Position Location: Remote in the Contiguous United States

Job Summary:

As a Senior Consultant or Principal Consultant (depending on experience level) within our Digital Workplace Practice, you will lead the design and delivery of Microsoft Modern Work solutions, with a focus on mergers and acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant migrations, and endpoint solutions with Microsoft Intune. You will guide clients through discovery, architecture, migration planning, execution, and post-migration stabilization across identity, messaging, collaboration, and endpoints. This hands-on consulting role combines technical delivery, client advisory, and team mentorship to help organizations integrate or separate workplaces while protecting data, maintaining business continuity, and minimizing disruption to users.

Essential Functions:

  • Assist with statement of work development and validation as needed.
  • Lead client discovery, workshops, and readiness assessments across Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and endpoint management to define Modern Work requirements, M&A objectives, migration scope, dependencies, integration or separation timelines, and business continuity needs.
  • Develop migration strategies, effort estimates, workload sequencing, migration waves, cutover runbooks, and rollback or recovery plans with clear assumptions, exclusions, and acceptance criteria. Evaluate migration tools against workload coverage, limitations, client constraints, and cost.
  • Develop target-state recommendations and architecture diagrams for Microsoft 365 tenant consolidation and separation, including identity alignment, hybrid dependencies, coexistence, domain transitions, access controls, and endpoint integration, in partnership with security and infrastructure teams.
  • Lead hands-on migrations of mailboxes, OneDrive accounts, SharePoint sites, and Teams content, coordinating engineering teams and vendors while managing permissions, data integrity, and workload-specific limitations.
  • Configure Microsoft 365 services and coordinate identity transitions, including Microsoft Entra ID, directory synchronization, and application access.
  • Design and implement endpoint solutions with Microsoft Intune, including Windows Autopilot provisioning, device configuration and compliance policies, application deployment and protection, endpoint security policies, and Windows update management. Plan device enrollment and management transitions for M&A integrations and tenant migrations, minimizing disruption to users.
  • Execute pilots, migration testing, cutover validation, and troubleshooting to verify data, mail flow, sign-in, collaboration, device access, and security controls; provide post-migration stabilization and operational handoff.

🚀 The Vision: Building the Operating System for Product Creation

Since 2013, THE/STUDIO has been building the definitive operating system for product creation. We are combining modern SaaS technology with custom manufacturing to make producing physical goods as seamless, fast, and scalable as launching software.

We operate two core platforms: Customize Now (our best-in-class, on-demand manufacturing platform) and Source Anything (our new SaaS product that enables customers to seamlessly work with global factories beyond our own network).

We are a profitable, previously Silicon Valley-backed, fully remote company, and we are not just looking to improve manufacturing, we are looking for a visionary operator to help us truly revolutionize the global supply chain.

💻 The Role

You will own everything a customer reads and experiences after they find us: the website, lifecycle communication, email, and the positioning and messaging behind all of it. The goal is simple. More visitors become customers, and more customers come back.

This is an in-house role. It depends on collecting and applying knowledge about our product, market and audience every week, which is why we are not outsourcing it.

Why This Role Is Exciting:

  • Direct Access to Leadership: You will have the opportunity to work directly with our CEO and executive team, giving you high visibility, direct mentorship, and a seat at the table.

  • Product & Strategic Influence: We operate with flat hierarchies. Your daily insights from the ground level will directly shape our product roadmap, workflows, and company strategy.

  • Rapid Scale & Career Trajectory: We are growing rapidly. Joining us right now means high autonomy, minimal red tape, and massive room for personal and professional acceleration.

🎯 What You’ll Do

  • Website and CRO. Own the structure, messaging and conversion of our website and key product pages. Plan and run tests that can be read, and ship changes with design and engineering.

  • Lifecycle communication.Build the customer journey after the first order: onboarding, reorder triggers, win-back and repeat paths. Own our recurring revenue goals together with the Head of Marketing.

  • Positioning and messaging.Define how THE/STUDIO and each product line are positioned for each customer segment. Keep one source of truth used by the website, ads, sales and our AI sales agent.

  • Email.Plan, write and run lifecycle and marketing email as part of customer communication.

  • Customer research.Turn sales calls, customer conversations and reviews into copy, page changes and new tests.

  • Reporting.Measure your work on revenue and CRM data: conversion rate, repeat revenue, repeat order value.

💡 The Profile We’re Looking For (Our Core Pillars)

Our CEO defines our top performers by three distinct traits. If this describes how you operate, you will thrive here:

  1. Raw Intelligence & Problem-Solving: High processing power, business acumen, and logical reasoning. You can think on your feet, connect complex ideas, and break down ambiguous problems quickly.

  2. "Give a Shit" Energy (Extreme Ownership): You take 100% accountability for your domain and outcomes. You don't make excuses or blame external factors. You look inward, find solutions, and push across the finish line.

  3. Rapid Adaptation & Radical Candor: You embrace blunt, constructive feedback and pivot instantly without ego. You excel in a fast-moving environment where you need to act with urgency without waiting for hand-holding.

Requirements:

  • 4+ years in B2B or e-commerce marketing with ownership of website conversion, messaging or lifecycle

  • A track record of copy and pages built from real customer research, not assumptions

  • Experience building lifecycle or email programs, with results you can show in revenue

  • Solid A/B testing basics: sample size, a single primary metric, a minimum effect worth acting on

  • Ability to own work end to end with little supervision, from strategy to shipped page or flow

  • Fluent written English

Nice to have

  • Experience with funnels that mix self-serve and sales-led buying

  • Hands-on with a CRM (Pipedrive, HubSpot) and an email platform

  • Experience writing prompts or knowledge bases for AI sales or support agents

  • Background in custom manufacturing, merch or print on demand

💰 Compensation & Terms

  • Flexible & Competitive: We offer competitive, outcome-driven compensation packages tailored to the candidate's level of impact.

  • Engagement Type: Full-time, exclusive independent contractor role.

🔎 Our Hiring Process

  1. Submit Application: IMPORTANT! Please submit your resume/CV in English

  2. Initial Screen: Brief intro chat to evaluate mutual fit, communications, and expectations.

  3. Assessment / Case Study:(If applicable for the role) Practical demonstration of your capabilities.

  4. Final Executive Interview: Conversation with key team members.

  5. Reference Checks: Verification of past performance with former leaders and CEOs.

Note that every role is different, so the process may vary depending on the requirements of the role. Please note that due to the volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide feedback to all applications.

  • Lead the development of stormwater and erosion and sediment control (ESC) plans across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring technical quality, regulatory defensibility, and timely delivery from concept through approval.
  • Author and review NPDES permit applications, Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plans (SWPPPs), Notices of Intent (NOIs), and supporting ESC design documents.
  • Serve as the firm’s regional technical authority on NPDES and ESC matters, advising clients and internal project teams on permitting strategy, sequencing, and compliance.
  • Coordinate with federal, state, and local agencies (EPA, state environmental agencies, conservation districts, MS4 program administrators) to submit permit applications, secure approvals, and respond to agency inquiries and comments.
  • Interpret and apply construction general permits (CGPs), industrial stormwater permits, and state-specific ESC and stormwater design standards across the assigned region.
  • Develop and implement technically sound, cost-effective solutions to complex stormwater and erosion control challenges, including BMP selection, drainage design coordination, and post-construction stormwater management.
  • Review deliverables prepared by junior staff and subconsultants to ensure technical accuracy, code compliance, and consistency with client expectations.
  • Provide direct communication with clients, delivering reports, updates, and solutions, and managing expectations through to permit issuance.
  • Manage scope, schedule, and budget for NPDES and ESC work packages, tracking progress and forecasting effort, and delivering on time and on budget.
  • Identify project risks, establish solutions, and escalate appropriately within internal management.
  • Identify changes in scope, generate the necessary documentation, and support negotiation of change orders with the client.
  • Host regular meetings with clients and internal project teams to review progress, regulatory developments, concerns, schedule, and deliverables.
  • Support inspections and construction compliance, including SWPPP inspection protocols, corrective actions, and permit close-out.
  • Mentor and develop junior environmental staff in stormwater design, ESC planning, and permitting practice.
  • Apply in-depth knowledge of environmental regulations and permitting requirements, including those related to stormwater (NPDES) and erosion and sediment control.
  • Follow all of Canacre’s established best practices and procedures for project delivery, quality assurance, and safety.
  • Perform other duties as required.

What You'll Bring

Education

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Environmental Science, Biology, or a related field.
  • Professional licensure (PE) or certification such as Certified Professional in Erosion and Sediment Control (CPESC) or Certified Professional in Stormwater Quality (CPSWQ) is a strong asset.

Experience

  • 5+ years of professional consulting experience focused on NPDES permitting, stormwater management, and erosion and sediment control plan development.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing SWPPPs, ESC plans, NOIs, and NPDES permit applications across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Experience interfacing directly with regulatory agencies to secure stormwater and construction permits.
  • Experience with construction compliance, SWPPP inspections, and permit close-out.
  • Prior experience mentoring or providing technical oversight to junior staff.

Knowledge / Skills

  • Deep working knowledge of the Clean Water Act, NPDES program, construction general permits, and state-specific ESC and stormwater design standards.
  • Proven ability to produce technically sound, defensible, and permit-ready design documents.
  • Strong understanding of stormwater BMPs, hydrology, and erosion control practices.
  • Proven track record of delivering projects within scope, on time, and on budget.
  • Ability to manage, mentor, and lead others.
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously with minimal supervision.
  • Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and highly organized with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to build strong, lasting relationships with clients, agencies, and key stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office; familiarity with GIS and stormwater/civil design software is an asset.

Learn more about Sephora on our official careers site inside-sephora.com, and search for verified US roles at join.sephora.com.

Belong to Something Beautiful

At Sephora, beauty is about feeling seen, valued, and empowered, individually and collectively. It is connecting deeply with others, celebrating diversity and inclusivity, unlocking your potential, and making a difference every day. Together, we belong to something beautiful. 

Your Role at Sephora

Ready for a career glow up? As Retail Communications Manager, Translation and Localization, you’ll lead the development and delivery of accurate, inclusive, and contextually relevant Spanish-language content for Sephora’s retail organization. The work you do will impact beauty, as you help ensure store teams receive clear, consistent, and culturally relevant information that supports seamless execution and an exceptional client experience. You’ll be part of the Retail Communications team, which supports more than 650 Sephora stores, 1,000 Sephora at Kohl’s locations, retail leadership, brand partners, and Asset Protection. You’ll collaborate with partners who are equally passionate about delivering the right information at the right time, while establishing translation standards, managing workflows, and preserving Sephora’s business intent and store-centered voice across languages.

What You’ll Do

Translation & Localization

  • Manage end-to-end Spanish translation and localization across the department using translation technology for key deliverables, including policies, guidelines, communications, eLearnings, PDFs, videos, and audio.
  • Translate, edit, proofread, and adapt content into Spanish while preserving business intent, tone, terminology, clarity, and cultural and contextual relevance.
  • Establish and maintain quality-assurance practices for Spanish-language content, including version control, accessibility, and publishing accuracy.
  • Monitor published Spanish-language content and coordinate corrections, updates, or retirement when source content changes.
  • Identify and implement improvements to translation processes, tools, and workflows to increase speed, consistency, and quality.
  • Maintain and consistently apply translation glossaries, style guides, and terminology standards for Spanish-language content.
  • Manage translation request prioritization by evaluating content readiness, business priority, timing, effort, audience impact, and localization risks.

Collaboration (or Cross-Functional Partnership)

  • Collaborate across the organization, including with Retail Communications, Instructional Design, Retail Training, HR, Legal, and subject-matter experts, to confirm business intent, resolve source-content questions, and validate specialized terminology.
  • Partner with the Retail Communications and Design teams to ensure translated materials follow established content, brand, design, and store-voice standards.
  • Provide translation and localization expertise to cross-functional partners, identifying risks and recommending solutions when content cannot be translated directly without affecting clarity, meaning, or audience relevance.

Retail Communication Optimizations

  • Embrace a continuous improvement mindset, driving excellence across communications responsibilities.
  • Continually evaluate, lead, and participate in improvements to Retail Communications processes and tools to ensure they remain effective and relevant.
  • Travel to Sephora stores as needed to monitor project progress and adoption, gather feedback and insights, and develop new or improved procedures.
  • Support and own special projects, leveraging your expertise to ensure successful execution and alignment with broader business goals.

Retail Communications Support

While the primary focus of this role is translation and localization, you may occasionally support core retail communications during peak periods, coverage gaps, or special projects.
  • Create and execute comprehensive and compelling communication strategies for stores and retail leadership, supporting clarity and alignment across the business.
  • Provide expert guidance on messaging, timing, methods, and communication vehicles to maximize impact.
  • Serve as a gatekeeper by evaluating communication requests across departments to ensure they are necessary and aligned with organizational priorities.

What You’ll Bring

  • Four or more years of professional translation and localization experience.
  • Full professional fluency in Spanish and English, both written and spoken, with demonstrated experience translating, editing, proofreading, and adapting business content in both languages.
  • Strong knowledge of linguistic quality assurance, cultural adaptation, and maintaining consistent tone, style, and technical terminology across languages.
  • Experience using Content Management Systems, Translation Management Systems, translation-memory tools, or similar translation technologies.
  • Strong project-management and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize a high volume of requests and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent listening and collaboration skills, with a commitment to understanding business-partner and audience needs.
  • Sound judgment and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to solve problems independently, navigate ambiguity, and recognize when to escalate concerns.
  • Flexibility and resilience when managing changing priorities, time-sensitive requests, and evolving business needs.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Acrobat and Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • A degree in translation, communications, linguistics, business, or a related field is preferred.
  • Professional certification in translation or localization is preferred.
  • Experience in retail communications, professional communications, or a retail environment is preferred.
  • Experience with Articulate Storyline, Articulate Rise, Vyond, Adobe Creative Suite, closed-captioning tools, audio-editing software, AI voiceover tools, or XLIFF files is a plus.
  • Experience with Retail Zipline or learning-management systems is a plus.
  • A proactive approach, openness to feedback, and commitment to continuous learning and improvement.

What You’ll Get:

The annual base salary range for this position is $86,105.00 - $114,570.00 The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include, as applicable, the applicant’s qualifications for the position; years of relevant experience; specific and unique skills; level of education attained; certifications or other professional licenses held; other legitimate, non-discriminatory business factors specific to the position; and the geographic location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will perform the job. Individuals employed in this position may also be eligible to earn bonuses. This job will be posted for a minimum of five days.

  • Caring Community. You’ll collaborate with teammates who are equally passionate about innovating and driving the industry forward – together, united in beauty.
  • Fulfilling Path. Your career transformation starts here, with opportunities that will challenge, stretch and develop your skills.
  • Meaningful Work. As you make an impact on beauty, you’ll feel and see the positive change (consumer, industry, and social) that your individual voice is a part of.

Rewards as Unique as You:

Some benefits have eligibility requirements and may depend on job classification and length of employment.

  • Health. Choose a healthcare plan to fit you and your family’s needs with medical, dental, and vision coverage. Sephora also fully covers our employees’ disability and life insurance.
  • Wealth. We offer a competitive 401k with 4% match as well as FSA and HSA programs. We also offer a Student Debt Retirement plan, where your student loan payments qualify to earn the 401k match from Sephora.
  • Balance. You’ll be empowered to find the perfect blend of work/life balance that actually works for you with PTO, flexibility, protected leave, and more.
  • Growth. Career growth is built into every role, with access to training, development, and tuition reimbursement.
  • Perks. Think you’ve tried it all? Enjoy a 30% discount on all merchandise/services, opportunities for free product or “gratis,” and flash sale discounts on LVMH brand products.
  • Support. Join a team that truly cares – with free mental health and financial coaching resources with 24/7 access to Modern Health and Financial Finesse. Plus, volunteer and donation matching.

Sephora values a diverse and inclusive workplace and considers all applicants without regard to sex, pregnancy, race, color, national origin, gender (including gender identity and gender expression), age, religion, sexual orientation, military/veteran status, disability, or any other protected category. Sephora is committed to providing reasonable accommodation ta applicants with disabilities or other medical conditions. 

Sephora will consider all qualified applicants, including those with arrest and conviction records in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws, including the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the New York City Fair Chance Act.

The QISG team brings together Engineering, Safety, Quality, Material Procurement, QA/QC, Right-of-Way Acquisition, Scheduling, Environmental Planning, Permitting, Title and Land Management expertise that ensure outstanding results for our clients.

About this Role

Job Title: Engineering Project Manager - Transmission Line

At QISG, our Transmission Line teams play a vital role in the safe, reliable, and efficient delivery of power across communities and regions. We design, build, maintain, and upgrade high-voltage transmission infrastructure that supports the backbone of the electric grid. Whether working on new construction, line upgrades, or critical maintenance, our teams ensure projects are executed with the highest standards of safety, quality, and performance. Our work involves both traditional methods and the latest industry innovations to deliver sustainable, cost-effective, and reliable solutions for our customers.

The Engineering Project Manager will provide engineering expertise and technical support throughout the project lifecycle and support field operations, customer account management, procurement, and key stakeholder groups within Quanta. It will report to the Engineering Director and support transmission lines across the QISG platform.

raw.description:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Claim

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$104,000.00 - $171,700.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

As a Major Case Specialist, Excess Casualty, you are responsible for investigating, evaluating, reserving, negotiating, and resolving the office and/or department's most complex, high-exposure, and highest-severity injury and/or property damage claims within appropriate authority and oversight. You will serve as an expert technical resource to claim professionals, business partners, customers, and other stakeholders.

As of the date of this posting, Travelers anticipates that the posting will remain open until October 30th, 2026.

What Will You Do?

  • Independently manage and oversee an active caseload of injury and/or property damage claims and litigation from first notice of loss through resolution within level of authority. Typically, handles high complexity injury and/or property damage claims which includes coverage disputes and contractual indemnity issues.
  • Conduct detailed investigations to gather evidence, assess liability and determine extent of damages and establish appropriate reserves.
  • Evaluate claim information and documentation to make informed decisions regarding coverage and resolutions.
  • Engage in negotiations with claimants, legal representatives, and other parties to achieve fair and equitable resolutions.
  • Develop and execute advanced resolution strategies and coordinate internal and external resources to conduct comprehensive claim investigations and evaluations.
  • Prepare and present detailed reports on claim status, trends and outcomes to senior management.
  • Work closely with legal, underwriting, and other departments to ensure coordinated claim handling.
  • Partner with Counsel to develop, direct, and execute litigation management strategies.
  • Maintain comprehensive and accurate records of all claim activities, communications, and decisions.
  • Identify areas in which we can improve or enhance current best practices and offer creative solutions.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) to comply with state and Travelers’ requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • May require travel, including overnight stays, to attend mediations, trials, arbitration, etc.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Five plus years of complex, bodily injury claim and litigation experience.
  • Active adjuster license, where required by state law.
  • Experience with claims management and estimating software, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to understand, synthesize, interpret, and convey complex information in a simplified manner to multiple stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to make independent decisions and handle complex claims, evaluate severe losses, and negotiate settlements strategically.
  • Exceptional customer service skills; demonstrated ability to manage relationships with key stakeholders while delivering a consistently positive experience.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills with the ability to manage a high-volume workload and prioritize effectively.
  • Expert-level negotiation and conflict resolution skills with the ability to apply strategic claim handling practices.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Expert level knowledge of insurance principles, policy language, exclusions, and ISO forms with thorough understanding of business line products.
  • Strong understanding of state and federal insurance regulations, fair claims practices legislation, and legal requirements, with the ability to apply this knowledge to complex claims.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Four years of bodily injury liability, property damage liability, or comparable claim related experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit .

raw.description:
Responsibilities

Peraton is searching for a talented z/OS Systems Programming Manager to become part of Peraton’s Citizens Security & Public Services, State and Regional team supporting a contract with the state of Alabama. This leadership position will include hands-on mainframe systems programming responsibilities and can be delivered remotely.

Day to Day Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the design and definition of the system and network architecture for new or existing complex computer systems
  • Propose efficient transition approaches to new technology platforms and define transitions for the addition of new customers to our Data Center location in Albuquerque, New Mexico
  • Manage software and network product solutions, performance, upgrades and enhancements, and disaster recovery initiatives
  • Share cost, schedule, and technical program management responsibilities with the Data Center Program, Facilities and Operations Managers
  • Manage and assist with the daily operations of the systems team (supervision of the system programmers and network engineer, assignment of work, schedules, day to day workflow, performance management, and operating costs)
  • Formulate policies, procedures, and standards relating to systems, and network management
  • Perform and report system-wide capacity analysis and recommendations for future technical/solution direction and areas for improvement
  • Provide program management and customer reports to include: Service Level Agreement (SLA) adherence; systems performance; network performance; disaster recovery planning, test approaches, and test results; and future technology direction forecasts
  • Collaboration on annual ALECS Disaster Recovery exercises
  • Develop and maintain product vendor relationships
  • Responsible for personnel, software, network and DR program budgets and related assets
  • Oversee the design, implementation and support of system, database and application backup and recovery solutions.
  • Manage and assist with the upgrade and maintenance of the system, DB2 and related 3rd party software at or above release levels of N-1Collaborate within the Data Center Team and the customer locations
  • Manage and assist team members in the following Data Center functional areas: technical services, systems programming and administration, security administration, network engineering, software and network asset management, hardware/software/network procurements, and disaster recovery
  • Manage and assist with all aspects of complex technology software and network solutions; operating system and third-party software asset management, installation, and maintenance; disaster recovery planning and test execution; network architecture and solution asset management, installation, and maintenance; and systems security and maintenance
  • Data Center board member and/or chairperson for: Change Management, Problem Management, and Risk Management and supports various technical categories of Program Management for one or more contracts
  • Lead, facilitate, respond to, or partner with peers in response to customer, Federal, IRS, or corporate audits, questionnaires, or reviews related to Data Center delivery, SLAs, or regulatory requirements
  • Program or project risk assessment, risk management, and risk avoidance strategies and techniques
  • Ensure systems’ adherence and compliance with customer contract requirements and Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Develop and maintain the following schedules: on-call, database monitoring, database software and product upgrades, systems monitoring, systems software and network product upgrades, systems administration, team change management activities, various technical projects and value-added initiatives, various training initiatives including technical training and certifications
  • Coordinate technical and programming activities with internal Data Center team members, customers, and corporate peers

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • High School diploma with 10+ years of experience
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen or Green card holder.
  • 5 years of hands-on experience as a z/OS Systems Programmer
  • Hands-on experience installing, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting z/OS mainframe environments
  • 5 years of experience in technical lead or project lead role supporting senior level technical teams
  • 5 years experience in analyzing and solving system software and/or network problems or issues

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting data center environments, including hosting, infrastructure services, and systems programming
  • Experience providing technical leadership in data center outsourcing or managed services environments
  • Strong background in enterprise mainframe technologies
  • Experience installing, maintaining, and configuring z/OS mainframe software and related subsystems
  • Experience working in a 24x7x365 service delivery environment, including participation in on-call rotations, weekends, and holidays
  • Experience supporting disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution
  • Experience supporting Firm Fixed Price programs or contracts
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, and Visio

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

The Architect will serve as the technical lead for Facets implementation initiatives, providing end-to-end architectural guidance from infrastructure provisioning through application configuration and integration.   • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of Facets platform environments on AWS, including compute (EC2, ECS), storage (S3, Oracle), and networking (VPC, Direct Connect) components

  • Support high-volume batch processing operations including overnight claims adjudication cycles, capitation runs, and eligibility file processing with performance optimization
  • Develop and maintain architecture documentation, system diagrams, runbooks, and technical specifications for all Facets-on-AWS implementations

  • Experience with EDI transaction standards (X12 837, 835, 834) and healthcare interoperability protocols (HL7, FHIR)
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and DevSecOps practices including CI/CD pipeline design and automated deployment
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, AWS ECS/EKS) and microservices architecture patterns
  • Strong understanding of HIPAA Security Rule, FedRAMP, and CMS security requirements for cloud-hosted healthcare systems
  • Agile/SCRUM methodology experience, preferably within SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) environments
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (CloudWatch, Splunk, or equivalent) for enterprise healthcare applications
  • Familiarity with Windows Server administration as it relates to Facets platform hosting and operations

raw.description:
ICF's Disaster Management Division seeks a Senior Director, Housing Implementation (Sector Lead) to direct a major sector within the HUD Line of Business, with accountability for business growth, delivery quality, financial performance, and people leadership across ICF's housing implementation portfolio. This Remote U.S. senior leadership role guides single-family housing recovery programs, construction management and resilient housing initiatives for state, local, territorial, utility, and developer clients.


The Sector Lead establishes the strategy and direction for the housing implementation practice in alignment with Line of Business and Division strategic plans. The role leads through an experienced management team rather than through direct project delivery and holds three interlocking accountabilities: growing the sector’s book of business, managing sector staff for high performance, and ensuring consistent delivery across all projects in the portfolio.


This is an opportunity for an experienced disaster recovery, grant management, operations, and housing leader to shape a business-critical sector, build trusted client relationships, develop leadership talent, ensure operational excellence across project teams, and deliver sustained growth and quality across a complex national portfolio.


Responsibilities:

Sector Strategy and Market Position

  • Establish multi-year sector strategy and annual operating goals using housing expertise, HUD policy and funding direction, market trends, competitive intelligence, and company priorities.
  • Anticipate and address complex housing implementation challenges, including changes in CDBG-DR program design, procurement practices, delivery models, and resilience funding.
  • Strengthen ICF’s market position as a thought leader by representing the company with clients, industry groups, and conferences and contributing to Line of Business and Division planning.

Business Development and Growth

  • Lead sector growth from opportunity identification through capture, teaming, proposal strategy, pricing, and bid/no-bid recommendations in partnership with Line of Business, account, and business development leaders.
  • Achieve $40 million in annual sales and maintain a qualified pipeline of at least $100 million, with disciplined quarterly review of coverage, quality, risk, and conversion assumptions.
  • Build senior client relationships, influence key decisions, and expand cross-sector and cross-Line of Business opportunities by connecting clients with ICF’s full capabilities.

Portfolio, Financial, and Delivery Oversight

  • Own sector financial performance, including $30 million in recognized annual revenue, $40 million in contract awards, a $100 million qualified pipeline, profitability, margin, utilization, and backlog burn.
  • Direct portfolio delivery through Project Managers and senior managers, establishing consistent standards, controls, quality benchmarks, staffing, and early intervention for projects that are off plan.
  • Balance client satisfaction, execution, innovation, profitability, and risk while ensuring compliance with CDBG-DR regulations, locality specific program policies and procedures, 2 CFR 200 and other state-specific financial and procurement requirements, applicable relocation requirements, building codes, and other client-specific requirements.

People Leadership and Talent Development

  • Lead the sector through subordinate managers and senior managers, with accountability for workforce planning, hiring, staffing, bench management, performance, engagement, and succession depth.
  • Develop leadership talent through mentoring, Impact Conversations, internal mobility, and clear alignment between individual roles, the sector strategy, and business goals.
  • Create an inclusive, high-performing environment and provide calm, decisive leadership during challenges, constraints, and post-disaster surge conditions.

Cross-Organizational Leadership

  • Lead collaboration across sector and Line of Business boundaries, removing barriers to sharing staff, capabilities, and client relationships.
  • Champion ICF’s strategy, mission, and direction while fostering timely decision-making, agility, and an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Engage stakeholders in critical cross-organizational decisions to resolve staffing, resource, and client-ownership issues and achieve aligned outcomes.

Measures of Success

  • Achieve annual revenue, sales, pipeline, profitability, qualification discipline, and win-rate goals established in the approved operating plan.
  • Deliver consistent quality demonstrated through client satisfaction, strong CPARS and past-performance ratings, on-time and on-budget execution, and no material compliance findings.
  • Advance talent and organizational outcomes through retention, internal promotion, engagement, succession depth, cross-sector collaboration, and strategic initiative leadership.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in disaster recovery, housing, or community development programs, including substantial CDBG-DR housing implementation experience.
  • 5+ years leading through subordinate managers, with demonstrated accountability for business results and staff performance.
  • 5+ years of demonstrated knowledge of HUD CDBG-DR and CDBG-MIT regulatory frameworks, 2 CFR 200, and housing program delivery models, including single-family rehabilitation and reconstruction, affordable housing development, and buyout-adjacent housing programs.
  • 2+ years of demonstrated business development experience, including capture leadership and proposal strategy for competitive state and local procurements.
  • 2+ years of experience managing a portfolio with profit and loss responsibility of $20 million or more in annual revenue.
  • Willing and able to travel by air and vehicle, with anticipated travel up to 50% (TBD).
  • Must have a valid, current U.S. driver’s license and be able to successfully pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check.

PREFERRED SKILLS/EXPERIENCE:

  • Established relationships with state and local disaster recovery agencies and housing authorities.
  • Recognized external presence in the disaster recovery housing field through publications, conference speaking, or industry working groups.
  • Experience leading organizations through structural or operating-model change.

PROFESSIONAL SKILLS:


  • Strategic leadership of a business-critical housing implementation sector, with the ability to translate regulatory, market, competitive, delivery, and company inputs into an actionable business plan.
  • Executive-level communication, influence, negotiation, and relationship management with senior clients, industry stakeholders, and organizational leadership.
  • Ability to lead through an experienced management team, develop talent, align a diverse workforce, and make high-impact decisions under broad objectives.
  • Strong financial and operational discipline across revenue, sales, pipeline, profitability, margin, utilization, backlog, staffing, delivery quality, and risk.
  • Business development, capture, proposal strategy, competitive positioning, pricing input, cross-selling, and client-growth capabilities.
  • Ability to recognize challenges early, adjust course proactively, and maintain calm, clear direction during high-pressure or surge conditions.

raw.description:
About Legence Legence (Nasdaq: LGN) is a leading provider of engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance services for mission-critical systems in buildings. The company specializes in designing, fabricating, and installing complex HVAC, process piping, and other mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems—enhancing energy efficiency, reliability, and sustainability in new and existing facilities. Legence also delivers long-term performance through strategic upgrades and holistic solutions. Serving some of the world’s most technically demanding sectors, Legence counts over 60% of the Nasdaq-100 Index among its clients.

CONTENT DEVELOPMENT & SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER

  • Reports to: Vice President, Marketing, Legence
  • Position Type: Direct-Hire / Full-Time
  • Location: Remote; Ability to Travel up to 10%

Position Overview:

Legence is seeking an experienced Content Development & Social Media Manager to lead the development and activation of compelling content across Legence and its portfolio of Business Unit brands. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role for a strong writer, storyteller, and social media strategist who can translate complex technical expertise, projects, and business priorities into clear, engaging content for a range of audiences and channels. This individual will help bring consistency and scale to social media across a multi-brand organization. They will partner closely with Business Unit marketing contacts, subject matter experts, executives, creative resources, communications, and the enterprise marketing team to strengthen the visibility of Legence and its companies while preserving the distinct expertise and voice of each brand. Experience within construction, engineering, architecture, consulting, energy, the built environment or another complex B2B industry is strongly preferred. Key Responsibilities Content Strategy & Development

  • Develop high-quality content that strengthens the visibility, reputation, and market positioning of Legence and its Business Units.
  • Proactively identify compelling stories, projects, expertise, trends, and perspectives from across the enterprise and turn them into meaningful marketing content.
  • Write and edit content across a variety of formats, including:

◦ Website and landing page copy ◦ Thought leadership articles ◦ Case studies and project profiles ◦ Social media content ◦ Executive and subject matter expert thought leadership ◦ Email and digital campaigns ◦ Industry and end-market content ◦ Marketing collateral ◦ Video scripts and supporting copy ◦ Press releases ◦ Campaign messaging

  • Interview executives, technical leaders, subject matter experts and project teams to develop credible, differentiated content.
  • Translate complex engineering, construction, maintenance, sustainability, energy, and technical concepts into clear, compelling stories for both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Repurpose strong content across multiple formats and channels to extend its value and reach.
  • Maintain editorial quality and ensure content reflects appropriate voice, messaging and brand standards while recognizing the distinct identities of individual Business Units.
  • Partner with marketing, communications, and creative teams to identify opportunities for integrated campaigns and storytelling.

Social Media Strategy & Management

  • Help lead and execute social media strategy across Legence and supported Business Unit brands, working alongside the communications team who leads culture, recruiting, and investor related content.
  • Develop and maintain editorial calendars in collaboration with Business Unit marketing contacts, communications, and enterprise stakeholders.
  • Manage the development, review, approval, scheduling, and publishing of social content.
  • This role is not managing direct reports or a team.
  • Draft and edit social copy spanning corporate and industry content, projects, thought leadership, services, and Business Unit stories.
  • Adapt content appropriately across Legence and Business Unit channels while maintaining alignment with enterprise brand and messaging standards.
  • Manage day-to-day social media workflows using Sprout Social and Asana.
  • Coordinate with creative resources on social graphics, photography, video, and other visual assets.
  • Support employee advocacy and amplification programs designed to expand the reach of Legence and Business Unit content.
  • Monitor social channels, comments, messages, mentions and relevant industry conversations, escalating issues when appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities to amplify strong Business Unit stories across enterprise channels.

Campaigns & Digital Content

  • Partner with the broader marketing team to develop integrated content campaigns supporting priority markets, services, business initiatives and growth objectives.
  • Develop content that can be activated across social, web, email, thought leadership and other digital channels.
  • Support campaign development and execution through HubSpot, where appropriate.
  • Collaborate with marketing and Business Unit teams on targeted thought leadership and campaigns tied to services and priority market sectors.
  • Apply SEO and emerging AI-search/GEO best practices to digital content to strengthen discoverability.
  • Identify opportunities to extend the life and value of content by strategically repurposing it across audiences, brands and channels.

Analytics & Optimization

  • Track and evaluate content and social performance to understand which topics, formats and channels generate the strongest engagement and results.
  • Use insights from Sprout Social, web analytics, HubSpot, and other available platforms to continuously improve content strategy.
  • Evaluate performance across content categories, formats and Business Units.
  • Translate data and performance trends into clear recommendations for future content, campaigns and channel strategy, aligning with Legence’s Data and Analytics Manager.

Qualifications Required

  • 5–8 years of professional experience in content development, content marketing, social media, digital marketing, communications, or a related discipline.
  • Exceptional writing, editing and storytelling skills, with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to communicate complex subjects clearly and compellingly.
  • Demonstrated experience developing content for multiple formats, audiences, and digital channels.
  • Hands-on experience managing corporate or B2B social media channels and editorial calendars.
  • Strong understanding of how content, social media, and digital channels work together to build brand visibility and support broader business objectives.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple simultaneous priorities and deadlines.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to develop productive relationships across functions, businesses, and levels of an organization.
  • Ability to work independently, proactively identify opportunities, and move projects forward without extensive direction.

Preferred

  • Experience within construction, engineering, architecture, consulting, energy, sustainability, commercial real estate or another technical B2B environment.
  • Experience working within a multi-brand, multi-business or decentralized enterprise organization.
  • Experience supporting multiple businesses with different audiences, priorities, and levels of internal marketing support.
  • Experience with Sprout Social or a comparable enterprise social media management platform.
  • Experience with Asana or another enterprise work management platform.
  • Experience with HubSpot or comparable marketing automation technology.
  • Familiarity with web CMS platforms, SEO, AI search/GEO principles, digital analytics and content performance measurement.
  • Experience developing executive and subject matter expert thought leadership.
  • Experience supporting employee advocacy or social amplification programs.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, Public Relations or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Compensation Suggested salary range: $115,000-$130,000

Benefits Overview 401(k) Plan with Company Match: Currently match contributions dollar-for-dollar up to 4% of eligible pay; immediate vesting. Health & Welfare Benefits: Employer provided medical, dental, vision, prescription drug, Employee Assistance Program and accident & illness coverage. Life and Disability Insurance: Employer provided basic life insurance and AD&D valued at 50K coverage amount with the option for voluntary buy up for additional coverage. Time Off: Flexible non-accrual vacation; company holidays per policy. (For California employees, this is separate from California paid sick leave, if applicable.) Expenses: Business travel and related expenses reimbursed per company policy. Reasonable Accommodations If you need assistance or accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at or your dedicated recruiter with the job title and requisition number. Employment Eligibility Candidates must have current work authorization in the U.S.; visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Third-Party Recruiting Disclaimer Legence and its affiliates do not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies; any such submissions without a prior signed agreement authorized by Legence Holdings LLC's CHRO or Director of Talent Acquisition will not incur fees and are considered property of Legence. Pay Disclosure & Considerations Where pay ranges are indicated, please note that a successful candidate’s exact pay will be determined based relevant job-related factors, including any of the following: candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications, as well as geographic and market considerations. We are committed to ensuring fair and competitive compensation for all employees and comply with all applicable salary transparency laws. Equal Employment Opportunity Employer Legence and its affiliate companies are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), marital or familial status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), political affiliation, military service, other non-merit-based factors, and any other characteristic protected under applicable local, state or federal laws and regulations. raw.title: Enterprise Architect
raw.excerpt: T-Rex Solutions is seeking a hands-on Cameo Enterprise Architect to support our DHA Customer, PEO DHMS, through the Workforce 3.
raw.description:
T-Rex Solutions is seeking a hands-on Cameo Enterprise Architect to support our DHA Customer, PEO DHMS, through the Workforce 3.0 program within Architecture & Service Excellence (A&SE). The primary responsibility is to build, maintain, and govern enterprise architecture and MBSE models in Cameo Enterprise Architecture / CATIA Magic that provide a traceable source of truth for architecture analysis, integration, modernization, and decision support.

The role also performs enterprise architecture and systems-engineering work across business, application, service, data, infrastructure, integration, technology, and security domains. Support may span ESS Next and shared development/integration/test services, MHS GENESIS / DHMSM, EIDS and data integration, operational medicine / MHS GENESIS-Theater, and other PEO DHMS PMOs as needed. The architect will translate program, engineering, cybersecurity, acquisition, and operational inputs into current-state, transition, and target architectures, risks, roadmaps, and decision products.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain authoritative enterprise architecture and MBSE models in Cameo Enterprise Architecture / CATIA Magic, applying DoDAF, UAF, SysML, UML, BPMN, or other approved methods appropriate to the architecture problem.
  • Establish and maintain Cameo modeling conventions, repository/package structures, profiles and stereotypes, naming standards, reusable libraries, templates, traceability methods, validation rules, quality checks, baselines, versioning, and controlled change; support Teamwork Cloud / Cameo collaboration capabilities where used.
  • Create model-based capability, operational, system, service, data/information, interface, process, sequence, dependency, security, and requirements-traceability views; use diagrams, tables, matrices, queries, and reports to expose gaps, conflicts, dependencies, and incomplete relationships.
  • Reconcile and migrate architecture information from Visio, PowerPoint, spreadsheets, Systems Architect, requirements repositories, interface documents, and other legacy artifacts into Cameo; generate model-driven outputs for engineering, acquisition, cybersecurity, program, and leadership audiences and coach contributors on model quality and use.
  • Develop and maintain current-state, transition, and target architectures across enterprise domains, with emphasis on system-of-systems interoperability, cross-PMO dependencies, shared services, and A&SE priorities such as ESS Next and enterprise development/integration/test environments.
  • Analyze APIs, interfaces, data exchanges, information flows, cloud and infrastructure dependencies, cybersecurity boundaries, DevSecOps pipelines, test environments, and operational constraints; review requirements, use cases, RFP/PWS materials, interface-control documents, technical designs, standards, service catalogs, and test artifacts for architecture impacts and alignment.
  • Conduct technical research, alternatives analyses, trade studies, impact assessments, and architecture risk analysis; develop recommendations, transition roadmaps, architecture decision records, standards, governance artifacts, and mitigation plans tied to mission and business outcomes.
  • Facilitate architecture working sessions, model reviews, and technical decision forums; organize incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear architecture options, decisions, actions, and concise briefings for Government, technical, and leadership stakeholders.

Requirements:

  • Minimum of five years of enterprise architecture, solution/system architecture, systems engineering, MBSE, or digital-engineering experience in a complex technology environment, including recent hands-on experience developing and maintaining models in Cameo Enterprise Architecture / CATIA Magic.
  • Demonstrated Cameo experience beyond static diagramming, including repository/model structure, traceability, model quality and validation, reusable patterns or libraries, matrices/tables/queries/reports, and collaborative model management; Teamwork Cloud / Cameo Collaborator experience is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency with DoDAF 2.02, UAF, SysML, and the development of capability, operational, system, service, data, interface, sequence, process, dependency, and requirements-traceability models. Familiarity with evolving UAF and SysML standards is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to decompose complex systems and model structure, behavior, interfaces, information/data, requirements, dependencies, constraints, and end-to-end mission or business threads at multiple levels of abstraction.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise and hybrid-cloud environments, APIs and integration, data architecture, cybersecurity/RMF and Zero Trust concepts, DevSecOps/CI-CD, development and test environments, and software/service lifecycle considerations.
  • Experience translating requirements, acquisition materials, RFPs/PWSs, interface-control documents, technical designs, standards, and test materials into actionable architecture products, technical analyses, and decision support.
  • U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain a Common Access Card (CAC) and required access to DHA systems and environments.

Desired Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field is preferred; equivalent directly relevant experience will be considered. Strong technical writing, modeling, briefing, and facilitation skills are required; INCOSE, OCSMP, TOGAF, or comparable credentials are a plus.
  • Direct experience supporting DHA, PEO DHMS/DHMS, Workforce 3.0, Architecture & Service Excellence, the Military Health System, or a closely related DoD health-IT environment is strongly preferred. Relevant experience may include ESS/ESS Next, MHS GENESIS/DHMSM, JOMIS, EIDS, operational medicine, FEHRM, or federal health-data interoperability.
  • Other DoD or federal architecture experience is highly valued. Commercial experience is also relevant when it comes from complex, regulated, multi-stakeholder or system-of-systems environments and the candidate can clearly demonstrate how it transfers to Government interoperability, cybersecurity, acquisition, and governance needs.

T-Rex Overview

Established in 1999, T-Rex Solutions, LLC is a proven mid-tier business providing data-centric mission services to the Federal government as it increasingly tries to secure and leverage the power of data. We design, integrate, secure, and deploy advanced technical solutions for our customers so they can efficiently fulfill their critical objectives. T-Rex offers both IT and professional services to numerous Federal agencies and is a leader in providing high quality and innovative solutions in the areas of Cloud and Infrastructure Services, Cyber Security, and Big Data Engineering.

T-Rex is constantly seeking qualified people to join our growing team. We have built a broad client base through our devotion to delivering quality products and customer service, and to do that we need quality individuals. But more than that, we at T-Rex are committed to creating a culture that supports the development of every employee's personal and professional lives. T-Rex has made a commitment to maintain the status of an industry leader in compensation packages and benefits which includes competitive salaries, performance bonuses, training and educational reimbursement, Transamerica 401(k) and Cigna healthcare benefits.

T-Rex is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex (including pregnancy and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, family medical history or genetic information, political affiliation, military service, or other non-merit based factors.

In compliance with pay transparency guidelines, the annual base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $160,000. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. T-Rex considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations when extending an offer.

T-Rex offers a diverse and collaborative work environment, exciting opportunities for professional growth, and generous benefits, including: PTO available to use immediately upon joining (prorated based on start date), paid parental leave, individual and family health, vision, and dental benefits, annual budget for training, professional development and tuition reimbursement, and a 401(k) plan with company match fully vested after 60 days of employment among other benefits.

Based in St. Louis, Core & Main is a leader in advancing reliable infrastructure™ with local service, nationwide®. As a specialty distributor with a focus on water, wastewater, storm drainage and fire protection products and related services, Core & Main provides solutions to municipalities, private water companies and professional contractors across municipal, non-residential and residential end markets, nationwide. With over 370 locations across the U.S., the company provides its customers local expertise backed by a national supply chain. Core & Main’s 5,700 associates are committed to helping their communities thrive with safe and reliable infrastructure. Visit coreandmain.com to learn more.

Job Summary:

The Estimator II – Critical Infrastructure Group (CIG) is responsible for performing detailed material quantity takeoffs and supporting bid efforts for a variety of infrastructure projects with moderate complexity. This role works more independently than Estimator I, applying developing technical knowledge of materials, construction methods, and project specifications. Estimator II collaborates with sales, Pre‑Bid, and engineering teams to help ensure accurate scope development and competitive bid proposals.


Major Tasks, Responsibilities and Key Accountabilities


Major Tasks, Responsibilities, and Key Accountabilities

Project Evaluation & Takeoff Development

  • Independently performs material quantity takeoffs for standard and moderately complex projects.
  • Interprets construction drawings, specifications, and notes to determine accurate material requirements.
  • Identifies specialty materials with some guidance.

Bid Strategy & Sales Support

  • Prepares scopes and provides material lists for sales and customers with increasing independence.
  • Participates in pre‑takeoff and post‑takeoff discussions to support knowledge transfer.
  • Works with contractors and sales teams to clarify scope, project needs, and standard value‑engineering opportunities.

Vendor & Internal Collaboration

  • Communicates with vendors to obtain basic product information, lead times, or material guidance.
  • Coordinates with the Pre‑Bid team to maintain accurate scope definitions.

Technical Development

  • Continues to improve plan-reading, takeoff accuracy, and product knowledge.
  • Begins mentoring Estimator I personnel by answering questions and reviewing simple takeoffs.

Key Competencies

  • Growing technical expertise in infrastructure materials
  • Solid analytical skills
  • Effective communication with internal and external partners
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
  • Increasing confidence in takeoff responsibilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of estimation experience in water/wastewater treatment plant construction, or critical infrastructure projects
  • Proven experience performing detailed material quantity takeoffs from construction plan sets
  • Strong understanding of civil and mechanical infrastructure systems

Experience

  • 2–4 years of estimation experience or related industry background
  • Demonstrated ability to perform accurate takeoffs from plan sets
  • Experience engaging with contractors or vendors preferred

Education

  • Associate degree or Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Construction Management, Engineering, or related discipline
  • Equivalent industry experience considered

Job Description

Join us as Project Manager Clinical Supplies to manage the end-to-end supply chain for clinical trials, ensure timely and efficient distribution of trial materials, maintain optimal inventory levels, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to support the successful execution of clinical studies.

  • We are currently seeking Associate Project Managers, Project Managers, and Sr. Project Managers to support our Functional Service Provider (FSP) model.

We are passionate about building robust, fault-tolerant, highly scalable systems that enable us to be on-time and precisely accurate in every financial interaction we have both with our consumers and institutional finance partners.

Ledger Engineering works with our finance partners to support everything from closing our monthly books to annual audits. We bridge the technical gap between data, strategy, and the thorough level of accounting detail required to operate a publicly-traded company. Outside of accounting, we partner with the Capital Markets team to help open our business to investors who require a similar forensic level of reporting.

What You'll Do

· You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.

· You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.

· You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.

· You take ownership of your team’s operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, policies, testing and alerting in place to support “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.

· You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.

What We Look For

· You have an extensive track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, Spark and Kubernetes.

· You have experience in financial systems, ledgering, treasury or adjacent domains where data accuracy and system reliability are critical.

· You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.

· You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work.

· Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross-functional peers.
