WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The Manager, Artist Agreements & Clearances is a cross-company role responsible for securing and managing artist agreements, releases, and content clearances in support of production and distribution across the Recording Academy and its affiliates. In this position, you will be a key liaison between internal stakeholders, artists, managers, labels, publishers, and legal teams, supporting events, series, exhibits, GRAMMY Studios programming, and expanding organizational objectives. You are a detail-oriented professional with a genuine passion for music and the music industry. You excel at building and maintaining strong relationships, can balance creative needs with legal and company requirements, and are calm under pressure. You have a collaborative spirit and service mentality.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Artist Releases & Agreements

  • Draft, negotiate, execute, and manage artist agreements and releases across all Recording Academy and affiliate productions, ensuring timely execution for live and pre-recorded content.
  • Maintain organized records of all agreements, including rights granted, restrictions, and obligations.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure content usage plans and artist negotiations are accurately reflected in contractual terms.

Sync and Misc. Clearances

  • Secure synchronization rights and related clearances for music and content use across all Recording Academy and affiliate platforms.
  • Coordinate with record labels, publishers, PROs, and other rights holders to obtain necessary licenses.
  • Track and manage rights by territory, media, term, and usage to ensure compliance.
  • Oversee the license lifecycle, including payments, amendments, extensions, expirations, and archiving
  • Troubleshoot and resolve clearance issues under tight production timelines.
  • Support additional clearance needs, including artwork, likeness, podcast, and other media usage.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with internal stakeholders early in the process to assess and address clearance, release, and agreement needs.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for all artist-related contractual and clearance matters.
  • Clearly communicate requirements, risks, and timelines to internal and external stakeholders.

Process & Systems Management

  • Refine workflows for outreach, negotiations, contract execution, and rights tracking.
  • Maintain and improve systems for documenting, tracking, and reporting rights and permissions.
  • Keep standardized clearance process resources current and accessible.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and mitigate risk.

Risk Management & Compliance

  • Ensure content is cleared prior to distribution across all platforms.
  • Flag risks and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Stay current on music rights, licensing practices, and industry standards.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s Degree required.
  • 5+ years’ experience in music business affairs, content clearance, and music publishing.
  • Paralegal experience and/or the ability to draft and review content licensing agreements and negotiate terms with knowledge of how smaller negotiations affect big-picture relationships.
  • Established relationships with record labels, music publishers, and artist management.
  • Proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese preferred.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and comprehensive follow-through.
  • Flexibility to succeed in a fast-paced production environment with tight deadlines.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects proactively and independently while providing cross-company support.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS FOR CERTAIN ROLES

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit for long periods of time, and work at a computer for long periods of time.

SALARY AND BENEFITS

The starting salary for this position is $64,400 to $70,800 per year, benchmarked against industry standards. Salaries for positions required to be in specific geographic locations reflect the corresponding labor market.

The actual offer extended will depend on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and the role's requirements. Positions working 20+ hours per week also receive our comprehensive benefits package (with medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401k match, generous paid time off, and more). Click here for an overview of our company benefits.

Explore our career opportunities to join a team that values creativity, innovation, and diversity.

ABOUT THE RECORDING ACADEMY AND ITS AFFILIATES

RECORDING ACADEMY

The Recording Academy represents the voices of performers, songwriters, producers, engineers, and all music professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the recording arts remain a thriving part of our shared cultural heritage, the Academy honors music's history while investing in its future through the Grammy Museum, advocates on behalf of music creators, supports music people in times of need through MusiCares, and celebrates artistic excellence through the Grammy Awards—music's only peer-recognized accolade and highest achievement. As the world's leading society of music professionals, we work year-round to foster a more inspiring world for creators.

LATIN RECORDING ACADEMY

The Latin Recording Academy is an international, membership-based organization comprised of Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking recording artists, musicians, songwriters, producers and other creative and technical recording professionals. The organization is dedicated to improving the quality of life and cultural condition for Latin music and its makers. In addition to producing the Latin Grammy Awards to honor excellence in the recorded arts and sciences, The Latin Recording Academy provides educational and outreach programs for the Latin music community either directly or through its Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation.

LATIN GRAMMY CULTURAL FOUNDATION

The Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation is a charitable organization established by the Latin Recording Academy in 2014. The organization is dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of Latin music creators through scholarships, educational programs, grants, and access to creators and industry executives.

MUSICARES

A friend and ally of the music community, MusiCares was established by the Recording Academy to safeguard the health and well-being of all music people. A four-star charity and safety net in times of need, MusiCares offers confidential preventative, recovery, and emergency programs to address financial, medical, and personal health issues. Through the generosity of our donors and volunteer professionals, our dedicated team works across the country to ensure the music community has the resources and support it needs.

GRAMMY MUSEUM

The Grammy Museum is a nonprofit organization dedicated to celebrating and exploring music from yesterday and today to inspire the music of tomorrow through music preservation, education, exhibitions, and public programming and aims to create a world in which shared love of music sparks curiosity, creativity, and community. Programs include Grammy in the Schools education programs that are offered year-round for students, teachers, and schools throughout the United States.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

The Recording Academy, its affiliates, and the music industry have a strong culture of inclusion and respect for everyone. The Recording Academy makes intentional, courageous, and principled decisions for stronger business outcomes and ensures that all creators and professionals live and work in a fair and safe environment. It is the Recording Academy's policy to provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees. The Recording Academy does not discriminate on the basis of race (nor traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, religion (including religious dress and grooming), creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), national origin, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law. The Recording Academy will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship to the Recording Academy. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including selection, job assignment, compensation, promotion, discipline, termination, access to benefits and training, recruitment, hiring, transfer, and social and recreational programs.

Culver Franchising System, LLC is currently looking for a dynamic, results-oriented Franchise Business Consultant (FBC) to support our new and existing franchisees and growth in the Minneapolis-St. Paul metro area and Western Wisconsin.

This role is responsible for guest service, new restaurant openings and financial results in Culver’s franchised locations. They also provide ongoing leadership and advice to franchisees regarding restaurant operations including supporting positive guest relations, product quality, training, team development and expense controls; while providing expertise to franchisees in building restaurant sales and profits, ultimately adding value to the Culver’s brand.

The territory includes locations in the Minneapolis-St. Paul metro area and Western Wisconsin. This remote, home-based role requires travel approximately 80% of the time with some overnight stays.

Essential Functions:

  • Serve as a liaison between Culver Franchising System, LLC (CFS) Culver’s support team, suppliers and franchisees
  • Provide leadership and advice to franchisees on their restaurant operations, including food cost control, labor investments, expense control, safety, sanitation, product quality control, training, and guest relations
  • Ensure franchisee operations are conducted in such a manner as to reflect favorably on the brand, protect trademark rights and be in compliance with all brand standards
  • Be knowledgeable of Franchise Disclosure Document (FDD) to ensure operational compliance
  • Ensure restaurant openings are successfully managed with appropriate support teams and leadership, planning, while adhering to established restaurant opening budgets
  • Support franchisees approved for expansion with operations and human resources preparations
  • Support franchisees in meeting sales, experiences and guest satisfaction goals are achieved or exceeded
  • Represent company operations, as needed, on various operations, Franchise Advisory Council, R&D, training, information technology, supply or other functional committees as needed
  • Plan and set priorities to achieve business objectives
  • Influence others by building respectful working relationships built on trust and a strong base of credibility
  • Demonstrate an ability to adapt to different situations and personalities, while maintaining a high level of personal integrity

Requirements:

  • Two-year College or University degree in related field and 5-8 years related experience or equivalent combination of education and work experience as a General Manager/District Manager in a multi-unit restaurant concept
  • Ability to travel up to 80% of the time including nights and weekend travel
  • Excellent time management and organization skills
  • Food Safety & Sanitation Certificate
  • Valid Driver’s license and an acceptable driving record

Additional Information:

To be considered for this opportunity, please make sure to attach your resume to your application.

Starting Pay Range: $90,000-$110,000 per year, commensurate with experience.

This role includes a generous incentive bonus based on business results and individual success.

raw.description:
Job Description Summary

The Manager, Digital Platform Operations is responsible for driving operational excellence across commercial digital platforms by ensuring platform stability, scalability, and disciplined execution of customer-facing programs and initiatives.



This role strengthens the platform operating environment through standardized processes, governance, and operational rigor while supporting a seamless customer lifecycle from early solution design through implementation, launch, and ongoing operations.



The position partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders across Product R&D, Engineering, Commercial, Marketing, Customer Success, and Delivery teams to translate strategic objectives into operational execution plans, maintain organizational readiness, and ensure consistent delivery outcomes.

GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

This role ensures commercial digital platforms operate effectively, customer lifecycle processes are executed consistently, and teams are equipped with the structure, governance, and operational discipline needed to deliver successful customer outcomes. The Manager serves as a key operational leader focused on scaling operations, improving execution consistency, and enabling sustainable growth across the digital platform portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Operations Excellence

  • Support the operational management and continuous improvement of commercial digital platforms.
  • Drive platform stability, reliability, and scalability through standardized operating procedures and governance practices.
  • Monitor operational performance metrics, service levels, and key platform health indicators.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to resolve operational issues and implement process improvements.
  • Establish and maintain standard work practices that improve consistency and execution quality.
  • Identify operational risks and drive mitigation activities to support customer and business objectives.

Program Operational Excellence

  • Manage operational activities supporting the customer lifecycle, including pre-deal assessments, implementation readiness, go-live coordination, and post-launch reviews.
  • Ensure operational readiness across internal teams before customer deployments and launches.
  • Coordinate launch activities and transition plans to support successful customer onboarding and adoption.
  • Develop and maintain repeatable execution models that improve delivery predictability and customer satisfaction.
  • Facilitate cross-functional readiness reviews and governance meetings.

Process & Governance Management

  • Implement and maintain operational processes, tools, and workflows supporting platform delivery and customer success.
  • Track program milestones, dependencies, risks, and action plans to ensure successful execution.
  • Support governance reviews through preparation of operational metrics, performance reporting, and status updates.
  • Ensure adherence to established operational standards, policies, and best practices.
  • Document and continuously improve operating procedures and service delivery processes.

Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze operational and customer performance data to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Drive initiatives that improve efficiency, quality, scalability, and customer outcomes.
  • Support root-cause analysis and corrective action planning for operational challenges.
  • Develop reporting mechanisms that provide visibility into platform health, customer readiness, and operational performance.
  • Promote a culture of operational excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Desired Qualifications

  • Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Sciences, or related field.
  • Experience in digital platform operations, program management, customer success operations, implementation management, or operational excellence roles.
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments supporting enterprise software, SaaS, digital services, or healthcare technology platforms.
  • Experience in Cyber operations, AWS disciplines, Cloud operations and deployment, IT infrastructure and governance.
  • Strong project and program management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting commercial digital products or healthcare technology solutions.
  • Knowledge of Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, ITIL, or related operational methodologies.
  • Experience managing customer onboarding, implementation, or go-live activities.
  • Familiarity with operational reporting, KPI management, and governance processes.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership –always with unyielding integrity.


Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

raw.description:
Position Overview:

The Executive Assistant is a force multiplier and operational partner to the Senior Executive Assistant, supporting the executive office of the President and Chief Financial Officer. This role focuses on event execution, communications support, administrative operations, and after-hours backup. The Executive Assistant reports to the Senior Executive Assistant and works under their strategic direction on all complex or executive-facing decisions.

The Sr. EA retains ownership of calendar management, strategic cross-functional coordination, executive communications strategy, and complex vendor relationships. The Executive Assistant amplifies the Sr. EA's capacity by owning execution on defined operational areas.

Key Responsibilities:

Event Coordination & Logistics:

  • Execute event planning and logistics under Sr. EA strategic direction, including departmental meetings, executive office events, and organization-wide initiatives (e.g., holiday parties, town halls, all-hands meetings)
  • Manage vendor coordination, catering, transportation, and on-site setup
  • Track RSVPs, attendee confirmations, and special accommodations
  • Ensure all prep materials for upcoming meetings are available and accounted for; track meeting attendees and flag status to Sr. EA to determine next steps
  • Ensure materials and run-of-show documents are available to President and CFO
  • Handle post-event follow-up and execute event troubleshooting and real-time problem-solving

Communications Support & Coordination:

  • Under the Sr EA guidance, the EA role will:
  • Manage routine email processing, routing, and responses
  • Coordinate scheduling emails, meeting confirmations, and calendar updates
  • Maintain communication logs and prepare executive communication summaries

Calendar & Scheduling Support:

  • Maintain calendar accuracy and update logistics for confirmed meetings
  • Monitor the calendar for conflicts and flag to Sr. EA immediately
  • Prepare weekly calendar reviews and highlight key activities for Sr. EA
  • Coordinate with external participants on scheduling logistics
  • Support scheduling calls and meeting coordination under Sr. EA direction

Administrative Operations & Support:

  • Maintain OCFO filing systems, databases, and operational documentation
  • Prepare executive materials: reports, presentations, briefing documents
  • Handle office management and supply ordering
  • Process expenses, reimbursements, and financial documentation
  • Manage shared calendars, scheduling tools, and software administration

Cross-Functional Coordination:

  • Execute multi-executive scheduling logistics under Sr. EA strategy
  • Set up meetings and coordinate follow-up on Sr. EA direction
  • Manage operational details with internal stakeholders
  • Document meetings, action items, and deliverables
  • Serve as escalation point for operational issues

Team Operations & Knowledge Management:

  • Assist with EA team scheduling and coordination
  • Update and maintain EA playbooks and operational documentation
  • Support onboarding and knowledge transfer procedures
  • Maintain shared team resources and calendars
  • Document processes and operational best practices

After-Hours & Urgent Support:

  • Handle urgent after-hours requests and escalate appropriately
  • Maintain communication during business-critical situations
  • Escalate all executive-facing decisions to Sr. EA

Reporting & Authority:

Reports to: Senior Executive Assistant

Authority Level: Operational execution on defined responsibilities under Sr. EA direction. Does not own calendar strategy, executive communications strategy, or cross-functional coordination strategy. All executive-facing or strategic decisions escalate to Sr. EA.

Required Qualifications & Competencies:

  • 5+ years as an Executive assistant
  • This position will require trips to the Bay Area
  • Social media skills, including creating and managing content across platforms
  • Strong organizational and project management skills; ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; professional correspondence ability
  • Ability to work independently and follow Sr. EA direction without constant oversight
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and logistics
  • Ability to remain calm and problem-solve in high-pressure environments
  • Proficiency with Outlook, Teams, Office 365, and calendar management software
  • Demonstrated ability to follow processes and escalate appropriately
  • Flexible, adaptable, and willing to adjust priorities as needed
  • Discretion and professionalism in handling confidential information

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting C-suite or senior executive team
  • Event planning and coordination experience
  • Experience with vendor management and contract coordination
  • Knowledge of financial operations or compliance requirements
  • Experience working as part of a larger administrative team

What Success Looks Like:

  • Sr. EA can delegate event execution without micromanaging logistics
  • Routine communications are handled professionally without Sr. EA involvement
  • Executive-facing communications always go through Sr. EA before delivery
  • Calendar logistics are executed perfectly; Sr. EA owns the calendar strategy
  • Urgent after-hours issues are handled competently or escalated immediately
  • Sr. EA has more bandwidth for strategic work due to execution support
  • No duplicate effort or parallel decision-making between Executive Assistant and Sr. EA

Work Environment & Expectations:

  • Fast-paced environment with competing priorities and time-sensitive requests
  • Occasional after-hours support for urgent executive needs
  • Collaboration with Sr. EA, finance teams, compliance, and cross-functional partners
  • High level of professionalism and confidentiality required
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing circumstances and priorities
  • Support role—all executive decisions and strategy owned by Sr. EA

Key Distinctions: This Role vs. Senior Executive Assistant:

Executive Assistant OWNS:

  • Event execution and vendor logistics
  • Routine communications and scheduling
  • Administrative operations and documentation
  • After-hours urgent support

Senior Executive Assistant OWNS:

  • Calendar strategy and all hold decisions
  • Executive communications strategy and messaging
  • Cross-functional coordination and stakeholder relationships
  • Compliance and governance decisions
  • Strategic project coordination
  • All executive-facing interactions and decisions
  • Supervision and direction of Executive Assistant role
  • Travel logistics coordination (managed through external Travel Manager)

In compliance with applicable pay transparency requirements, the application window for this position is expected to close on October 9, 2026, subject to change based on business need.

A Day in the Life and the Impact You’ll Make:

You will help save lives, reduce serious injuries, and improve the culture of DEKRA’s clients through organizational change initiatives that drive safety performance improvement through client engagements. Our Consultant positions are critical for the overall success of any client engagement, and are the lynch pin between the front line through the organization to the c-suite.

The overall objective of our Consultants is to utilize organizational change knowledge to deliver the results that our clients are seeking, become a trusted advisor, and expand the scope and breadth of existing client engagements. When leading projects, they are accountable for assuring that their team can effectively delivery our primary Consulting solutions with excellence by coaching and mentoring with sincere, candid feedback.

To be successful in this position our Consultants will need a deep understanding of our centerline solutions, be able to adapt these solutions to meet client objectives and understand how the offering can be integrated into the client organization.

What You’ll Do:

Depending on experience, skills, and client needs DEKRA Consultants spend time in a variety of ways:

  • Delivering workshops and presentations to groups of various size.
  • Conducting one-on-one or small group field coaching with clients.
  • With advancement to Project Lead Consultant, perform client-related project management working on smaller to gradually larger and more complex projects.

Three key performance areas summarize the scope of this position:

Client Facing responsibilities:

  • Understand the client’s objectives and needs and adapt the centerline model for the client engagement giving the greatest probability of success.
  • Understand the role of Governance in Safety
  • Ability to establish effective safety governance that aligns with the client organizational structure and functioning.
  • Guide and facilitate measurable governance.
  • Delivering DEKRA’s suite of solutions with mastery of the concepts combined with industry subject matter expertise.
  • Utilize centerline positions and materials that illustrate DEKRA’s Point of View on leadership, safety, and project execution.
  • Coach client leaders from the frontlines to senior leaders and become their trusted advisor.
  • Track progress in meeting client objectives and adjust when necessary.
  • Develop a communication structure to reliably remain up to date on the client’s situation including safety performance, successes, business challenges, industry trends, etc.
  • Communicate routinely and effectively to the client leadership team.
  • Practice honesty: be truthful with the client, in a manner that preserves the relationship, even when it’s hard to do so.

Team Responsibilities:

  • Create excellent deliverables internally so peers and project leaders can efficiently do their part.
  • Meet deadlines.
  • When leading others on client projects:
    • Enable and manage the success of the project team
    • Assure all solutions are integrated and aligned toward meeting client objectives
    • Communicate routinely and effectively to delivery team, and the overall project team
    • Assure the project team delivers to the client’s adaptation of the centerline, across all parts of the client organization
    • Deliver performance-related feedback to individual consultants, including areas for improvement and recognition for positive contributions
    • Escalate project related consultant success stories and guidance feedback to appropriate management levels

Business Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to a safe and healthy work environment by actively participating, taking responsibility, and following established procedures and policies.
  • Maintain a complete and accurate project plan for the life of the project including consultant scheduling to meet delivery needs
  • Meet goals of personally delivering billable hours as assigned by your manager in addition to working on assigned internal projects
  • Manage projects toward stated realization rate, ensuring effective utilization of consultants
  • Achieve monthly forecast accuracy
  • Expand the scope of client relationships and maintain long term engagements by identifying additional areas of opportunity and surface to the Project/Program Manager
  • Maintain a professional brand of credibility internally at DEKRA and externally within the marketplace
  • Gain acceptance by existing clients to be references for future projects

What You’ll Bring:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
  • Experience: 8+ years of experience in organizational change, or operations with safety responsibility, or in an industrial consulting role, or in a safety role
  • Certifications/Licenses: CSP or equivalent, LEAN Green/Black Belt preferred
  • Presence in front of Leaders – first line though senior manager
  • Demonstrated cognitive flexibility
  • Ability to successfully navigate client ambiguity
  • Ability to develop deep knowledge of DEKRA solutions
  • Ability to interpret the impact of non-safety processes on safety and culture
  • Ability to develop a strategic plan which supports the scope of work and overall safety excellence
  • Ability to manage client excellence and DEKRA business
  • Ability to create a project team culture that supports and aligns with business values
  • Fluency with various Governance structures and how they “fit” and function in various situations
  • Fluency with leading and lagging metrics and the ability to proposes specific metrics for the client
  • Fluency in applying effective change management
  • Fluency in Safety Management System best practices and ability to propose enhancements to close gaps
  • Ability to lead a matrixed team
  • Ability to develop others

Physical Considerations:

  • Must be able to work in a variety of client locations, environments, and conditions. This may include climbing stairs, walking long distances, walking on rough and uneven terrain, walking through client work facilities, working in heat/cold conditions, indoors and outdoors.
  • Must be able to accommodate working various shifts as client activities are scheduled.
  • Must be able to withstand the rigors of extensive travel.
  • May require difficult travel and long periods of driving.
  • Ability to move and conduct work with full range of motion.
  • Ability to lift 25-50lbs (luggage)
  • Extended periods of computer-based work
  • Extended periods of standing

Travel Considerations:

  • Domestic and/or potential for international travel required, estimated up to 75%.

What You’ll Receive for the Value You Bring:

Compensation:

This position allows for hourly professional fees according to confirmed project work; with fees ranging from $50/hour to $130/hour. Actual pay is based on several factors including market location, position-related knowledge, skills, and experience, and placement in a specific consulting level based on experience and work history.

Additional Position Details:

  • Reports to: VP Consulting Leader
  • Work Model:Remote
  • Work Location:US-based Remote
  • Supervises Others:No
  • Status: Part-time, Flexible
  • FLSA Classification:Non-exempt
  • Visa Sponsorship Eligibility:This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Growth in DEKRA:

DEKRA colleagues are welcome to apply for any position that is a potential match with their qualifications if performance in their current role is in good standing. The career path following this specific role is as follows:

  • Senior Consultant
  • Principal Consultant

About Us:

As a global provider of comprehensive services and solutions, we help our customers improve their safety, security, and sustainability outcomes. DEKRA is the world’s leading testing, inspection and certification (TIC) companies offering innovative professional services in the fields of vehicle inspection, expert appraisals, industrial product testing & certification, management system certifications, leadership consulting, and much more. DEKRA is a purpose-driven organization with a deep passion to make the world a safer place on the road, at work, and at home. In DEKRA, you will be part of a continuously growing organization with a near 100-year history involved in more than 50 countries on five continents.

We hope you’ll consider a career with DEKRA North America as we strive to become the Global Partner for a Safe World!

DEKRA North America is an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

DEKRA North America is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you need special assistance or accommodation while seeking employment, please call +1 (770) 971-3788. We will make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.

DEKRA North America will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay.

raw.description:
Position Summary

The Epilepsy Foundation is seeking a detail-oriented and strategic Senior Manager of Contracts and Procurement with deep experience in government grant compliance, contract negotiation, procurement, and regulatory reporting within the nonprofit sector.

This role is responsible for overseeing the organization’s contracts and procurement functions while ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local requirements, including the Federal Funding Accountability and Transparency Act (FFATA), Uniform Guidance (2 CFR Part 200), and applicable state charitable registration requirements.

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience navigating complex regulatory requirements, managing high-stakes contracts and agreements, and partnering across departments to mitigate organizational risk and ensure compliance. This position will serve as a key subject matter expert on grant-related procurement, contracting, and regulatory obligations while supporting the Foundation’s mission and organizational priorities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Contracts & Procurement Management: Execute and oversee the end-to-end contracts and procurement function, with a strong focus on regulatory compliance for federally and state-funded grants.
  • Federal Grant Compliance: Ensure organizational adherence to federal grant requirements, including FFATA reporting, Uniform Guidance (2 CFR Part 200), cost principles, procurement standards, and other applicable requirements.
  • Contract Development & Negotiation: Lead the review, drafting, negotiation, and administration of contracts, memoranda of understanding (MOUs), subrecipient agreements, cooperative agreements, and vendor contracts.
  • Charitable Registration Compliance: Coordinate state charitable solicitation registrations, renewals, and related compliance requirements across applicable jurisdictions.
  • Policies & Procedures: Develop, implement, maintain, and continuously improve procurement and contracting policies and procedures that align with nonprofit best practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Grant & Funder Requirements: Monitor and report on compliance with funder-specific procurement requirements, contractual obligations, and reporting requirements.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the organization’s subject matter expert on grant-related procurement, contracting requirements, and regulatory obligations.

raw.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.


About the Role

McKesson Medical-Surgical is seeking a Senior eCommerce Brand Manager, Private Label to join our Consumer Markets team. You will lead the commercial strategy and performance of a portfolio of private label health care products across Amazon, online marketplaces, and other consumer-facing ecommerce channels.

This highly visible individual contributor role owns the end-to-end business performance of the portfolio, including growth, assortment, and listing strategies, product launch planning, profitability, and strong cross functional coordination of marketplace execution.

The ideal candidate brings deep Amazon and marketplace expertise, strong business acumen, and a proven track record of scaling brands across ecommerce channels through data-driven decision making.

Working cross-functionally with Marketing, Pricing, Supply Chain, Product Development, Operations, and Marketplace teams, you will identify and lead the go to market plans to drive profitable growth.

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of McKesson's private label consumer business during a period of brand evolution.


What You'll Do

Drive Private Brand Growth & Own Performance

  • Serve as the commercial owner for a portfolio of private label products across Amazon, marketplaces, and other ecommerce channels.
  • Develop and execute growth strategies that balance revenue, profitability, market share, consumer demand, and long-term brand health.
  • Lead financial forecasting, business reviews, performance reporting, and identification of risks and opportunities.
  • Deploy Amazon expertise to lead as project owner supporting a large product rebranding effort delivering a coordinated ecommerce approach to drive and grow the new brand as a 3P seller
  • Evaluate assortment, pricing, promotional effectiveness, and channel performance to maximize growth and profitability
  • Assess commercial tradeoffs and recommend investments, pricing changes, promotional activity, assortment optimization, and portfolio priorities.

Lead Go-to-Market Execution Cross functionally

  • Lead cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment of go to market initiatives within a matrixed organization.
  • Identify expansion opportunities rooted in analytics, competitive intelligence, and consumer trends.
  • Provide direction to teams by identifying products and categories with the greatest growth potential.
  • Support product lifecycle management and commercialization activities across ecommerce channels.
  • Ensure products are competitively positioned with clear consumer value propositions and effective pricing architecture in partnership with the Pricing team.
  • Develop launch strategies including positioning, pricing, content requirements, inventory readiness, and success metrics.
  • Partner with Marketing teams to drive advertising, customer acquisition, promotional, and brand-building initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Marketplace and Listing teams to improve search visibility, conversion, digital shelf performance, and key programs.
  • Coordinate with Supply Chain and Operations partners to ensure inventory availability, launch readiness, and business continuity.

Deliver Insights & Influence Decisions

  • Leverage marketplace analytics, search insights, syndicated data, and internal reporting to create actionable commercial plans and make strategic decisions
  • Develop executive-ready business reviews, presentations, and strategic recommendations.
  • Monitor competitive activity, marketplace trends, and consumer behavior to identify growth opportunities.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Ecommerce, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in ecommerce, marketplace management, category management, brand management, merchandising, commercial strategy, or related disciplines.
  • 3+ years of Amazon 3P seller experience directly managing brands and product categories
  • Strong experience owning business performance metrics, forecasting, P&L management, and profitability analysis.
  • Proven ability to analyze complex data and translate insights into growth strategies and actions
  • Experience operating effectively in fast-paced, matrixed organizations.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing portfolio growth strategies that drive revenue, profitability, and market share gains.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and strategy articulation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or advanced business degree.
  • Experience within Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), retail, consumer products, or omnichannel commerce environments.
  • Experience managing brands across Amazon, Walmart Marketplace, Target Plus, eBay, or similar ecommerce platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central, Stackline, Helium 10, Circana (IRI), NielsenIQ, 84.51°, or other ecommerce and category analytics platforms.
  • Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
  • Strong strategic thinking, financial acumen, and problem-solving capabilities.

·

Travel & Working Conditions

  • Travel may be required for business meetings, planning sessions, customer engagements, and other business needs.
  • Ability to work at a computer for extended periods and participate in both virtual and in-person meetings.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Staff DevOps Engineer to develop, maintain, and optimize the infrastructure, systems, and automation that support software development, deployment, and operations. This role is responsible for improving software delivery workflows, infrastructure reliability, scalability, and security through automation and collaboration with engineering teams.

The successful candidate will have strong expertise in CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), cloud technologies, scripting, and systems administration. They will play a key role in resolving complex technical challenges, implementing DevOps best practices, and driving continuous improvement across development and infrastructure environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to enable consistent, automated, and reliable software delivery.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools.
  • Collaborate with software development and operations teams to improve build, testing, release, deployment, and monitoring processes.
  • Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability solutions to support system reliability and performance.
  • Maintain and optimize cloud-based and/or on-premises environments, ensuring availability, scalability, security, and operational stability.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure, deployment, and system issues across development, testing, and production environments.
  • Apply DevOps best practices, including version control, automation, configuration management, and continuous improvement.
  • Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge-sharing resources.
  • Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure efficiency, deployment reliability, system performance, and operational processes.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as required to support business needs.

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • 12+ years of relevant professional experience in DevOps, infrastructure engineering, systems administration, or a related technical field.
  • University degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Hands-on experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI, or Azure DevOps.
  • Proficiency in scripting or programming languages such as Python, Bash, or Go.
  • Practical experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or AWS CloudFormation.
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Strong understanding of Linux and/or Windows system administration and networking fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes.
  • Understanding of infrastructure security, system availability, scalability, and performance optimization.
  • Demonstrated analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently, collaborate effectively across teams, and manage competing technical priorities.

Preferred skills

  • Kafka
  • MySQL and/or PostgreSQL
  • Redis
  • Networking

Du vermittelst dein technisches Know-how in praxisnahen Service-Trainings – vor Ort bei unseren Partnern, in modernen Trainingszentren oder online per Webinar.

Du planst, organisierst und leitest Trainings eigenverantwortlich von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Durchführung – unterstützt von einem erfahrenen Backoffice-Team.

Du erstellst E-Learning-Kurse und digitale Lerninhalte für unsere Bobcat Learning Platform und machst Wissen jederzeit zugänglich.

If you are a seasoned ServiceNow Architect who’s looking for new challenges and more freedom, you are in the right place.
Our customer base expands across all sectors and fields from public to private, from energy to healthcare. We support them with projects that are both interesting and challenging.

About Sofigate CEE Zrt.

We are the largest team of senior ServiceNow technology experts in Hungary. As a subsidiary of Sofigate, we have strong ServiceNow technical and business background.

Sofigate is a Nordic Regional Elite Tier Strategic Partner of Servicenow having delivered 1000+ successful ServiceNow projects for 200+ customers, and our exeptional experience was recognised by ServiceNow as granting us with the #1 EMEA Elite Tier partner award.

We're proud to offer a unique working environment that's built around the needs of our expert team. Flexible working conditions: We understand that everyone's lives are different, which is why we offer flexible working hours and the ability to work from anywhere. This allows you to manage your time and to get the best out of your work and your free time. Competitive compensation:We beat the Hungarian market with our compensation package, which includes opportunities both for employees and contractors. Independent work within a supportive senior team: We believe in a collaborative and supportive work environment. Our close-knit team is always ready to help each other out. Nordic working environment: As part of a Nordic parent company, we embrace the Nordic working culture of fairness, equality, and trust. We believe in creating a positive work environment where everyone is valued and respected.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for experienced ServiceNow Architects and Senior Solution Consultants who are passionate about business technology, automation and helping customers achieve meaningful business outcomes through the ServiceNow platform.

At Sofigate, we work closely with our customers to understand their business challenges, identify opportunities and turn ideas into practical, scalable solutions. As a trusted advisor, you will help customers and our delivery teams see the bigger picture, make informed decisions and get the most value from their ServiceNow investments.

AI is already transforming how organisations work, and an increasing number of our customers are adopting or exploring AI-powered capabilities. Experience with AI, LLMs or ServiceNow's AI capabilities is a strong advantage. Equally important is your curiosity, willingness to learn and motivation to explore how emerging technologies can create real business value.

We work collaboratively, follow proven best practices and use agile methods and prototyping to demonstrate value early. Above all, we are looking for someone who takes ownership, enjoys working with customers and colleagues, and wants to help shape what comes next.

To sum it up, you’ll benefit from the following skills:

  • 5+ years of experience working with ServiceNow, preferably in architecture, solution consulting or senior technical roles.
  • Broad understanding of the ServiceNow platform, its modules, capabilities and how they work together.
  • Ability to understand business needs and translate them into scalable, sustainable ServiceNow solutions.
  • Strong technical understanding, analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Confidence to advise and constructively challenge customers, explain recommendations and guide decision-making.
  • Ability to see the bigger picture, identify improvement opportunities and support long-term platform development.
  • Experience in solution design, technical guidance, testing and quality assurance.
  • Understanding of AI, LLMs and their potential applications in ServiceNow, or a strong interest and willingness to develop expertise in this area.
  • Passion for business technology, innovation and creating measurable customer value.
  • A proactive, self-driven attitude with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working with both business and technical stakeholders.

• Fluency in English.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with customer business stakeholders, platform owners and technical teams to understand requirements and translate them into practical solutions.
  • Design and guide scalable ServiceNow solutions based on platform best practices, long-term maintainability and customer business needs.
  • Provide architectural and technical guidance to development and delivery teams, supporting solution design, implementation, troubleshooting and testing.
  • Understand and advise on ServiceNow capabilities across different modules, identify synergies and recommend opportunities for further platform adoption.
  • Proactively identify improvement opportunities, challenge existing approaches when appropriate and explain the business and technical reasoning behind recommendations.
  • Support the development of customer ServiceNow roadmaps, considering current needs, future opportunities, integrations and overall platform architecture.
  • Explore opportunities to leverage AI, automation and emerging ServiceNow capabilities to improve customer processes and business outcomes.
  • Stay up to date with ServiceNow releases, new capabilities, platform developments and relevant technology trends.
  • Support and continuously improve customers' existing ServiceNow environments, ensuring solution quality, consistency and sustainable platform development.

About Sofigate

We are The Business Technology Company with the fastest time-to-value in the gen AI era. We achieve that by combining our transformation expertise with low/no-code platforms and generative AI. That’s how we create sustainable customer value. In practice, that means helping our customers to develop the interplay between business and technology: to design, build and implement transformations and business-friendly technology solutions, like Salesforce, ServiceNow and SAP.

As leaders of Business Technology management, we are the founder of the Business Technology Forum, the developer of theBusiness Technology Standard. Our team of 800+ professionals based in 8 offices across 5 countries – Finland, Sweden, Denmark, Hungary and Poland – are always ready to help, both our colleagues and our customers. At the very core of our being are our values: dare, care and grow.We dare to challenge the market, foster a community that cares about our people and drive growth with a customer centric business vision.

Take ownership of your work. Own your future

As a Sofigator, you get the opportunity to work with knowledgeable and driven colleagues, develop and challenge yourself and create sustainable value for our customers. We have an international, vibrant and fun culture with great openness and flexibility. We value every Sofigator and strive to build a diverse, equal, and inclusive workplace where everyone’s voice is heard, and where everyone can become the best versions of themselves. We value a healthy work life balance and support you in maintaining it.

Growth is not just a corporate thing for us – it is personal. There is so much to explore and learn within our community, and together with our customers, that having a bit of fun is unavoidable.

We do not leave the future up to chance. We take ownership of it. You can, too. Own your future!

Advanced Software Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Advanced Software Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (United States)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Advanced Software Engineer to provide deep technical leadership across multiple teams and drive the design and execution of complex, cross-cutting engineering initiatives. As a Staff engineer you will be a key technical voice in shaping architecture, raising the engineering bar, and helping the organization deliver ambitious technical roadmaps. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical depth with strong organizational judgment, and will be comfortable operating at the intersection of strategy, architecture, and hands-on execution. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • Eight or more years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Proven track record of leading complex, cross-team engineering initiatives.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of distributed systems, cloud platforms, or large-scale data systems.
  • Strong programming skills in at least one major backend language.
  • Excellent system-design and architecture skills.
  • Demonstrated mentorship and technical leadership of senior engineers.
  • Strong understanding of operational excellence, reliability, and observability.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Track record of influencing engineering culture and standards.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience driving multi-year platform modernization initiatives.
  • Public technical contributions (talks, papers, OSS) in relevant areas.
  • Hands-on experience operating large-scale production systems.
  • Exposure to building engineering organizations as well as platforms.
  • Familiarity with FinOps and cost-aware engineering practices.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to  or contact us at (908) 505-3899. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Help train and evaluate AI agents on expert-level fluid simulation tasks. You'll take CAD geometry, set up and run simulations, build verified reference solutions, and write Python checks for the agent's results.

raw.description:
Overview

As part of the Office of Grants Management, the Pre-Award Coordinator supports Carle Health System's externally funded programs by providing pre- and post-award sponsored project support to ensure compliance with OMB 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance as well as compliance with grant and institution specific requirements. This individual is primarily responsible for administration of various activities associated with the submission of externally sponsored awards in collaboration with funding agencies, grantee departments, program directors, and leadership. This position will utilize professional judgment, independence, and discretion to serve as a grants point of contact for Carle under guidance from the Executive Director of Grants Administration. Primary responsibilities include assisting grantee departments with the submission and management of their externally funded programs and accounts, as well as working with Carle's Office of Grants Management, leadership and staff to develop and maintain dynamic record-keeping and reporting systems for sponsored project data, enabling strategic planning and growth for Carle's sponsored programs.

Responsibilities

Designated official to submit grant proposals to external sponsors on behalf of Carle Health (including applications for new awards, renewals, continuations, supplements and extensions) Interpret agency guidelines and regulations for funding opportunities with federal and private sponsors and advise applicant departments on requirements, terms, and conditions of submitting an application Review proposal budget and narrative and confirm institutional commitments and operational feasibility Prepare and assist with administrative information and requirements Prepare and assist with proposal and progress report documents including budget development and justification, biosketches, other support, letters of support, and other required documentation Review and maintain various reports to effectively monitor the award lifecycle and monitor financial activity for grant accounts to ensure compliance with internal and external policies and that all transactions comply with project budgets and agreements Review financial reports and analyses to assist program directors with the administration and development of their sponsored programs. Assis the program directors when budget revisions or award amendments are needed Represent Carle Health during internal and external audits, in collaboration with Carle’s Accounting and Compliance units Work collaboratively as a member of the Office of Grants Management to improve tracking and reporting of grant proposals and awards. Assist with writing grant policies, operational procedures, and training. Participate in national meetings and conferences related to grants accounting and financial administration.

Qualifications

Certifications: , Education: Bachelor's Degree: Related Field (Required), Work Experience: Related field

Carle Health Company Overview

Find it here.

Discover the job, the career, the purpose you were meant for. At Carle Health, we're committed to fostering a workplace where every team member feels valued, respected and empowered, where passion and purpose come together to positively impact the lives of our patients and our communities. Find it all at Carle Health.

Our nearly 17,000 team members and providers work together to support patient care across central and southeastern Illinois. We’ve grown to include eight, award-winning hospitals and a multispecialty provider group with more than 1,500 doctors and advanced practice providers. We’re developing the next generation of providers and healthcare professionals through Carle Illinois College of Medicine, the world’s first engineering-based medical school, and Methodist College. raw.title: Manager, Paid Acquisition & Investment
raw.excerpt: Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success.
raw.description:
Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting-edge technology, we’re enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?

We’re looking for a Manager, Paid Acquisition & Investment to serve as our resident Subject Matter Expert (SME) and independently own day-to-day execution across our core paid channels (Meta, Google, TikTok, and Snapchat), reporting to the Director, Growth.

The impact you’ll make:

Right now, someone is scrolling through their phone while working out how next year can look different from this one. They have a plan, and the right credit card could be a real step toward it. Whether Mission Lane shows up at that moment, in a way that makes sense for where they are, depends on how well our paid campaigns are built, optimized, and scaled. As our Manager, Paid Acquisition & Investment, you are the trusted expert who runs the campaigns that put us in front of them at the right time, for the right reasons.

In your first year, you will take autonomous ownership of our paid channels, translating high-level strategy into flawless, reliable execution. Campaigns go live perfectly aligned with strategic intent, budgets are managed with precision, and the cost of bringing in each approved customer consistently hits target. Mission Lane is in a stable, exciting phase of growth, making this a great moment to lead the execution of our paid media engine. You’ll do that by:

  • Serving as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) and independently owning campaign execution across Meta, Google, TikTok, and Snapchat, from complex builds through launch and advanced optimization.
  • Autonomously managing specific advertising budgets and pacing against plan, decisively pulling the right platform levers to hit our Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) targets.
  • Translating marketing strategy into reliable campaign execution, partnering with creative and marketing teammates to ensure what goes live perfectly reflects the strategic vision.
  • Driving a rigorous testing roadmap, running sophisticated A/B tests on behalf of the marketing team and translating complex data into actionable, strategic decisions.

You’ll thrive in this role if:

  • You know the platform levers like the back of your hand: You are an expert in bidding strategies, ad formats, audience targeting, and identifying exactly what to adjust when performance shifts.
  • You are a highly trusted operator: You consistently run channels end-to-end, require minimal oversight, and flawlessly execute on overarching marketing strategies.
  • Budget management is second nature: You check pacing and variance as a daily habit, and you have a proven history of managing specific budgets to hit strict CAC targets.
  • Quality acquisition drives you: Acquiring the right customers matters to you just as much as acquiring them efficiently, and you instinctively reach for ROAS or an LTV:CAC view to dictate your optimizations.
  • You launch with uncompromising precision: Setup always matches strategic intent, rigorous QA happens before go-live, and defects are virtually nonexistent.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience independently managing and executing paid media campaigns (Meta, Google Ads, TiKTok, etc.) in an analytical, performance-driven environment.
  • A proven track record of acting as the SME, independently managing specific ad budgets, and consistently hitting CAC, CPA, or ROAS targets.
  • Expert-level knowledge of platform-specific levers, bidding strategies, ad formats, and audience targeting.
  • Extensive experience designing, running, and measuring complex A/B tests for paid media.
  • Ability to travel approximately 4+ times per year for in-person collaboration.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in financial services, fintech, or consumer lending.
  • Experience independently scaling a business function in a fast-moving startup environment.
  • Familiarity with SQL for deeper, self-serve data analysis.

Compensation:

Annual full-time starting base salary range: $118,465-$157,875.00

This role is eligible for additional compensation in the form of participation in our annual incentive program. Pay is based on factors such as work experience, education, certification(s), training, skills, and competencies related to the role. Mission Lane also offers a comprehensive benefits plan, which includes paid time off, 401(k) match, a monthly wellness stipend, health/dental/vision insurance options, disability coverage, paid parental leave, flexible spending account (for childcare and healthcare), life insurance, and a remote-first work environment.

About Mission Lane:

Founded in December 2018, Mission Lane is a purpose-driven fintech company based in the U.S., with headquarters in Richmond, Virginia.

It all started with a realization: nearly fifty percent of the adult population in the U.S. doesn’t have access to a clear line of credit. Most traditional credit card companies either overlook or overcharge this group because they have less-than-perfect credit scores or no scores at all. We decided this just wouldn’t do.

In partnership with our sponsor banks, we offer credit cards under the Mission Lane brand name, with better, clearer terms, and a more refined customer experience than the alternatives available to people working hard to improve their credit. To date, over four million consumers have chosen Mission Lane, earning high customer ratings on Credit Karma for its market segment and industry leading Net Promoter scores.

Mission Lane has cumulatively raised over $600 million of equity from leading investors, including Invus Opportunities, QED Investors, LL Funds, funds affiliated with Oaktree Capital Management, and other leading investors.

Our commitment to a workplace built on respect and dignity is guided by our core value of Unity. We believe that everyone plays a vital role in our shared purpose, and we actively cultivate an environment where all individuals have the opportunity to do their best work. By fostering a culture of empathy and collaboration, we create a strong sense of belonging and support for every team member.

Mission Lane is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other protected status.

Mission Lane provides reasonable accommodations to applicants who need them for medical or religious reasons, as required by law. Applicants can initiate an accommodation request by contacting .

Mission Lane is not sponsoring new applicant employment authorization and please, no third-party recruiters.

Application Integrity:

Our cardholders trust us with their financial well-being, and this trust starts with the integrity of the people on our team. We're looking for team members who share our dedication to transparency and truth. Please verify that the information in your application is accurate and complete.

Providing any information to Mission Lane that is not completely truthful at any point during the application or hiring process may result in removal from the hiring process, disqualification from future opportunities, withdrawal of an offer or other sanctions for candidates and, in addition for employees, disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment.

Position Summary:

At managed.com, we're a remote-first, global team. We're also AI-first, so finding practical ways to use AI is part of every role here.

As the Senior Paid Media Manager, you will own paid media strategy and hands-on execution across the Managed.com portfolio of brands. This senior individual contributor will manage budgets, campaigns, testing, attribution, and reporting to improve customer acquisition, brand awareness, and revenue growth while partnering with content, SEO, web development, marketing leadership, and external agencies.

What you’ll do:

  • Build and execute paid media strategies across Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, X Ads, and other relevant channels
  • Plan, allocate, and optimize annual six-figure advertising budgets across paid channels to meet business goals and improve return
  • Set campaign KPIs, monitor pacing and performance, and report results and optimization recommendations to leadership
  • Manage keyword research, competitive analysis, bid strategies, and campaign structures across audiences, regions, and devices
  • Develop and refine audience targeting using first-party and third-party data
  • Create and refine ad copy and creative, and run A/B tests across advertisements, landing pages, and campaign concepts
  • Analyze customer journeys, conversion paths, and campaign attribution to identify and implement performance improvements
  • Use the company’s internal AI-connected paid media system and other practical AI workflows to review performance, streamline work, and support optimization decisions
  • Partner with web development to improve conversion tracking and landing-page performance, including work involving GA4 and Google Tag Manager
  • Coordinate paid and organic search strategies with content and SEO partners
  • Develop and maintain controls that reduce click-fraud risk
  • Manage external agencies and vendors and share paid media best practices with the broader team
  • Support other tasks or projects as assigned to meet team and business needs

About you:

  • 5+ years of experience managing paid media campaigns, including at least 2 years in a senior role
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience managing paid media platforms and personally managing annual advertising budgets of six figures or more; strategy-only or agency-oversight experience is not sufficient
  • Expert knowledge of paid search, paid social, display, and remarketing, with the ability to translate business goals into effective campaigns
  • Advanced analytical and attribution skills, including the ability to use customer-journey and campaign data to improve conversion paths and performance
  • Ability to design and interpret A/B tests involving ad copy, creative, and landing pages
  • Strong skill in writing and refining effective ad copy and creative that aligns with brand messaging
  • Experience with marketing automation and CRM systems; experience with comparable platforms is acceptable
  • Experience with, or a demonstrated interest in, using AI to streamline workflows, review performance, and support campaign optimization
  • Careful project management, clear recommendations, and effective presentation of performance data to leadership
  • A record of working independently, following through from idea to results, identifying performance or tracking issues proactively, and keeping remote partners aligned
  • Availability to work with US Eastern Time or similar hours and provide sufficient overlap for collaboration with colleagues in North America and Europe when needed
  • Experience with web hosting, SaaS, or similar B2B technology products is a plus.
  • Additional assets include Google Ads or Meta Blueprint certification, experience with GA4 and Google Tag Manager, familiarity with WordPress or a comparable CMS, and experience working remotely.
  • Communication skills and fluency in written and spoken English, with other languages considered an asset

What we offer:

  • Remote-first work, with team members across many countries
  • Competitive pay, benchmarked against the markets we hire in
  • Room to grow, with real ownership of your work and support for professional development
  • Flexibility in how and when you work, within the core hours your team needs
  • Access to the AI tools you need to do your work, and the room to experiment with them

About us:

Managed.com is the company behind a family of specialist brands spanning business technology, infrastructure, and channel commerce. These include HostPapa, ColoCrossing, Hostopia, CloudBlue, and LogoMaker. Each brand serves its market through its own products and customer experience. Together, we are bringing those strengths closer to create more connected experiences and help businesses build, operate, and grow in the AI era.

Our culture is built on trust, respect, and doing work that matters to our customers. As our brands come together, there's real room to grow into new roles and new areas of the business.

Managed.com is an equal-opportunity employer. We value the range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences across our team, and we hire and promote based on skills and contribution.

We're committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities at every stage of the hiring process. If you need an accommodation, let us know, and we'll work with you to meet your needs.

raw.description:
About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).
  • Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.
  • Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation
