We help protect our customers against life’s uncertainties. Regardless of where you work within the company, you’ll be helping provide protection and peace of mind when our customers need it most.

The Vice President & Chief APD Actuary serves as the Asset Protection Division’s senior actuarial and risk executive. Reporting to the Division President, this leader provides independent actuarial oversight and shapes pricing, underwriting, portfolio, and risk decisions to support disciplined growth and strong financial performance. The role leads the actuarial function, partners across the business, and ensures the integrity of actuarial opinions, reserve analyses, and regulatory reporting.

Responsibilities

· Provide independent actuarial and risk oversight for APD’s asset protection products, including VSC, GAP, and ancillary offerings; establish credibility as APD’s independent actuarial voice; and preserve professional skepticism while escalating material concerns.

· Oversee pricing strategy and performance across APD lines; challenge models, assumptions, methodologies, and data quality; strengthen pricing, reserve, model, and risk governance; and recommend actions that support profitability, disciplined margins, financial objectives, and APD’s risk appetite.

· Partner with Product, Underwriting, Finance, Commercial, Claims, and Operations on risk selection, guidelines, new products, program governance, portfolio trends, loss drivers, pricing implications, and mitigations that balance growth, capital efficiency, and risk.

· Monitor in-force performance through dashboards and risk indicators, including loss ratios, emergence patterns, frequency and severity trends, and other experience metrics; recommend actions to improve outcomes or rebalance risk.

· Lead actuarial support for reinsurance strategy, evaluating structures, pricing, economic value, capital impact, retention limits, counterparty exposure, performance, and emerging risks to protect earnings and balance-sheet resilience.

· Lead reserve adequacy assessments and support capital, solvency, financial planning, stress testing, and M&A analyses with Finance and Enterprise Risk.

· Own P&C actuarial and regulatory reporting, including reserve analyses, actuarial opinions, and supporting memoranda; monitor relevant developments and ensure timely, accurate, compliant, decision-useful reporting.

· Engage Pricing Committees, the CFO, the Chief Risk Officer, and other senior stakeholders through timely, decision-useful portfolio insights, clear performance reporting, actionable recommendations, and effective enterprise partnerships.

· Build and lead an accountable, high-performing actuarial organization with strong capabilities, clear decision rights, technical standards, disciplined analysis, constructive challenge, continuous improvement, integrity, and succession depth.

Leadership Capabilities

· Applies deep P&C or specialty insurance expertise across pricing, reserving, reinsurance, in-force performance, loss drivers, and portfolio risk.

· Uses strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills to translate complex actuarial analysis into clear, actionable insights and disciplined decisions.

· Communicates actuarial judgments, uncertainty, and recommendations credibly to executives, governance committees, boards, auditors, regulators, and technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

· Builds trusted, action-oriented partnerships across functions while constructively challenging assumptions and maintaining actuarial independence.

· Develops accountable, high-performing teams and creates alignment through clear communication, effective change leadership, and disciplined execution.

· Brings an enterprise and customer perspective and leads with curiosity, adaptability, resilience, courage, authenticity, and professional integrity.

Requirements

    · A minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible actuarial experience in P&C, specialty, or asset protection insurance, including senior actuarial team leadership and experience across pricing, reserving, risk management, financial reporting, regulatory engagement, and executive decision support.

    · Associate of the Casualty Actuarial Society (ACAS) required; Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society (FCAS) preferred.

    · Experience with extended warranty, service contract, GAP, or similar protection products preferred.

    · Reinsurance and loss portfolio monitoring experience strongly valued.

The financial health of our employees is just as important as physical and emotional health. Some of the financial wellbeing benefits include contributions to healthcare accounts, a pension plan, and a 401(k) plan with Company matching. raw.excerpt: Spacelift is the infrastructure orchestration platform built for the modern software era, managing the full lifecycle for both traditional IaC and AI-accelerated infrastructure.
raw.description:
Spacelift is the infrastructure orchestration platform built for the modern software era, managing the full lifecycle for both traditional IaC and AI-accelerated infrastructure. It integrates with Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, Pulumi, and Ansible in a single governed workflow so you deliver secure, compliant infrastructure at scale. Developer self-service, Golden Paths with guardrails, an OPA policy engine, and drift detection accelerate developer velocity while maintaining control. Spacelift Intelligence adds AI-powered provisioning and diagnostics across traditional and AI-driven workflows.

Spacelift was founded in 2020 by long-time DevOps practitioner Marcin Wyszynski and successful entrepreneur Pawel Hytry and has raised $82.3M in funding over four rounds from top venture capital firms including Insight Partners, Blossom Capital, Hoxton Ventures, Inovo Venture partners and Five Elms Capital.

About the role

Spacelift is looking for aProduct Manager to own our Kubernetes application-delivery product, a new product for teams that run Argo CD in production.

You will own the product from customer discovery through delivery, launch, and adoption. Working with Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Support, you will identify important customer problems, decide where to invest, and turn validated opportunities into products customers use.

Most teams running Kubernetes have settled on Argo CD and do not want another CD engine. Their problems sit around it: promoting a release through environments without hand-written CI glue, knowing which version runs where, gating production on approvals and tests, and passing values from Terraform into application config. The product works with the Argo CD a customer already runs. We have an early design that captures the idea, not a spec, and parts of it will change. You will test the idea with customers, decide what the product should be and what ships first, and take it to market.

This role is for an experiencedproduct manager who has owned technical products and brings hands-on production experience with Kubernetes application delivery.You should also understand core infrastructure-as-code workflows, because connecting infrastructure to applications is part of the product.

What you'll do

  • Speak regularly with platform engineers, DevOps teams, infrastructure leaders, prospects, and customers.

  • Study production workflows to understand problems involving governance, coordination, visibility, reliability, and adoption.

  • Combine customer interviews with product usage, support cases, commercial feedback, and market research to identify the problems worth solving.

  • Define product requirements, success measures, and clear recommendations using tools such as 5 Questions, PR/FAQs, specifications, and decision records.

  • Prioritize work based on customer value, strategic fit, effort, risk, and potential learning.

  • Work with Design to explore, prototype, validate, and refine solutions.

  • Partner with the Engineering Manager on scope and trade-offs while Engineering leads architecture and technical execution.

  • Recruit design-partner customers and run pilots of early versions with them.

  • Work with the Director of New Product Development on product direction, major investment decisions, and the path to market.

  • Coordinate launch readiness with Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Support.

  • Review adoption and customer feedback after release, then decide whether to improve, expand, or stop the work.

  • Build and apply working knowledge of Spacelift, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, policy, cloud infrastructure, and our execution engine, including how the Kubernetes product connects with existing IaC workflows.

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of product management experience, including independent ownership of a technical B2B product or product area from discovery through delivery and adoption.

  • Hands-on production experience with Kubernetes application delivery, gained through product management, engineering, solutions engineering, or a similar technical role: Argo CD, Helm, Kustomize, and GitOps promotion across environments.

  • The ability to explain how these tools work and where teams encounter operational or organizational challenges.

  • Working familiarity with Terraform or OpenTofu and core IaC workflows, including Git-based changes, plan and apply, state, policy, and drift.

  • Experience identifying user problems, synthesizing qualitative and quantitative evidence, and turning findings into clear product decisions.

  • Strong written communication and the ability to work directly with engineers and technical customers.

  • Good judgment, curiosity, and a willingness to change direction when the evidence supports it.

  • Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above).

  • Based in European Union.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Kargo, Flux, Argo Rollouts, Harness, or another GitOps delivery tool.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, OPA/Rego, CI/CD, RBAC, audit systems, or internal developer platforms.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS or developer tools.

  • Familiarity with Working Backwards, 5 Questions, or another evidence-led product practice.

  • Experience using SQL, product analytics, or AI tools for research and analysis.

Why Spacelift?

  • Innovative Culture: Join a team shaping cloud infrastructure management’s future.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be a key player in driving Spacelift’s business and AWS partnership to new heights.

  • Work-Life Balance: Flexible work environment, with remote-first options and competitive compensation packages.

  • Collaborative Team: Work with passionate, talented people committed to driving success for our customers and partners.

Recruitment process:

  • 30' HR intro call

  • 45' Director Product Management Interview

  • Take-home exercise

  • 60' Debriefing Panel with SVP of Product and Design

Our values

  • We build for CUSTOMERS

  • We RESPECT each other

  • We take OWNERSHIP seriously

  • We succeed through COLLABORATION

  • We embrace SPARK & WONDER

More here:

Join Us! At Spacelift, you won’t just be working on a technical product - you’ll be part of a team shaping the future of DevOps. Apply to contribute to a platform loved by its users and take your career to the next level!

raw.description:
The International Centre for Research on Women (ICRW) is the world’s premier institution dedicated to advancing gender equity through rigorous research, evidence-based programming, and strategic advocacy. For nearly five decades, we’ve influenced how governments, multilateral institutions, foundations, and corporations address one of the most urgent challenges of our time.

ICRW Asia operates at the intersection of research excellence and practical implementation - generating evidence that drives policy, designing interventions that create measurable change, and building partnerships that scale impact across communities, countries, and continents.

The Strategic Imperative

Educational gains for women are clear, yet without decisive action, gender parity will remain elusive for decades. The next Executive Director of ICRW Asia will drive the shift with bold strategic leadership , deepening our policy influence, expanding our voice, and leading ambitious, evidence-backed programs that affect millions.

This is more than a leadership role. It is an invitation to shape the trajectory of gender equity across one of the world’s most dynamic regions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide overall leadership, strategic direction, and oversight to all ICRW Asia verticals - research and programmes, operations, finance, human resources, communications, and related management functions ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
  • Lead and diversify fundraising activities as the chief fundraiser; develop and execute a strategy to expand the donor base across bilateral, philanthropic, multilateral, and private sector partners, securing long-term financial sustainability.
  • Oversee planning, budgeting, and financial management to meet short- and long-term needs; ensure robust fiscal health, accountability, and compliance with all legal and regulatory requirements across countries of operation and fundraising.
  • Recruit, lead, and develop a diverse, high-performing team; set and monitor transparent performance and development goals; foster a performance-oriented, inclusive, and equity-driven work culture.
  • Strengthen ICRW’s role as a thought leader in gender-based research and advocacy; expand programme implementation to engage new audiences; and cultivate high-value partnerships and coalitions to position ICRW as the “go-to” organization for gender research and policy influence.
  • Serve as chief spokesperson for ICRW Asia, representing the organization in high-profile regional and global fora; lead a consistent, impactful communications strategy across platforms and stakeholders.
  • Execute and sign all deeds, agreements, contracts, and official documents on behalf of ICRW Asia; maintain a transparent and productive relationship with the ICRW Asia Board to guide strategic direction and ensure adaptability in a changing environment.

Professional Experience and Qualifications Required

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Social Sciences, Gender Studies, Public Administration, or related field.
  • 15-20 years’ professional leadership experience in Asia or globally, in the non-profit, public, or private sectors preferably in public health, international development, or gender-related issues with a demonstrated commitment to gender equity and social justice.
  • Proven track record in fundraising and resource mobilization from diverse sources; strong ability to build and sustain strategic partnerships with donors, civil society, stakeholders, and the private sector.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-disciplinary teams in dynamic environments; prior leadership of an organization, entity, or business unit of comparable scale and complexity preferred.
  • Expertise in leveraging or conducting research, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into accessible messaging for varied audiences.
  • Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with experience fostering a culture grounded in diversity, equity, social justice, ethics, transparency, and accountability.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to deliver measurable impact while ensuring financial health; skilled in budgeting, financial analysis, and scenario planning.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally.

Evidence & Impact

Explore all research and insights :

The Culture We Offer

At ICRW Asia, we strive to create an environment that reflects our commitment to gender equity and social inclusion. The team is multidisciplinary, comprising researchers, economists, anthropologists, and advocates who work together to generate evidence-based insights and actionable policy recommendations.

We value:

  • Academic rigor with contextual relevance
  • Collaborative inquiry and thought leadership
  • A commitment to inclusivity, diversity, and equitable workplace practices

As a regional hub within a globally respected organization, ICRW Asia combines:

  • The credibility and reach of a global institution
  • The adaptability and local responsiveness of a regional entity

Read more about our approach and values:

Why Exceptional Leaders Choose ICRW

These reflections are drawn from feedback shared by former policy advisors, multilateral agency partners, bilateral donors, funders, and internal staff on public platforms such as Glassdoor and LinkedIn:

  • ICRW stands at the intersection of rigorous research and strategic advocacy - a place where data drives action and change are shaped by evidence.
  • When global donors and governments need more than just frameworks - when they need grounded insights and policy-aligned strategies - ICRW becomes their go-to partner.
  • More than an institution, ICRW Asia is a space for mission-driven inquiry. Researchers are encouraged to question, challenge, and engage deeply with systems of power and justice.

raw.description:
The Apprentice assists in providing a high level of technical support for their assigned business unit. This includes understanding and documenting the business processes, reporting and analysis of data, working on projects, improving business processes using available tools, and more.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The QA Engineer Apprentice is an entry-level role that assists with manual testing, defect reporting, and test documentation while gradually gaining independence. This position prepares individuals to manage basic testing responsibilities independently and supports QA Engineers.

  • Completes assigned tasks on time with supervision.
  • Learns to manage small workloads and escalates issues proactively.
  • Assists Quality Analyst Engineer I and Quality Analyst Engineer II with testing.
  • Performs manual testing accurately under guidance.
  • Reports defects clearly, pays attention to details, and follows test documentation standards.
  • Collaborates with Quality Analyst Engineers and team members to learn best practices.
  • Supports team tasks and actively participates in meetings and trainings.
  • Develops the ability to recognize basic testing priorities and risks.
  • Seeks clarification when uncertain about tasks or findings.
  • Consistently meets testing deadlines and delivers high-quality test results with minimal disruption to the development cycle.
  • Takes initiative in identifying potential issues early and communicates them proactively to the appropriate team members.
  • Communicates test results and issues clearly.
  • Asks questions and listens attentively to feedback.
  • Applies basic problem-solving to assigned testing tasks.
  • Open to experimenting with simple automation tools.
  • Demonstrates initiative to learn and improve.
  • Follows direction effectively.
  • Keeps test cases and defect reports organized under supervision.
  • Begins to learn how to prioritize daily work.
  • Positive, curious, and willing to accept feedback.
  • Patient and persistent when facing challenges.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

None

QUALIFICATIONS AND CREDENTIALS

  • Working on a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Basic understanding of software testing principles.
  • Willingness to learn automation fundamentals.
  • Good attention to detail and problem-solving mindset

ABILITIES AND COMPETENCIES ESSENTIAL TO THE FUNCTION OF THE JOB


Communication and Comprehension

  • Ability to effectively communicate both verbally and in writing.
  • Proficiency in understanding, speaking, reading, and writing English to support professional correspondence and collaboration.
  • Strong interpersonal and public communication skills to represent Liberty University in a professional manner.
  • Strong organizational skills.

Problem Solving

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills; ability to assess situations, evaluate information, and solve both routine and complex problems using sound judgment.

Physical and Sensory Abilities

  • Frequently required to perform desk-based work, including computer use and data entry.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in meetings and collaborative settings, with or without reasonable accommodation.

WORKING CONDITIONS


Work Environment

Remote


Driving Requirements

If the employee is required to travel in performing the duties and responsibilities of the position, the use of one’s personal vehicle (or LU vehicles) may be required for travel. Proof of a valid driver’s license, an acceptable DMV record, LU Driving Approval, and liability insurance is required when driving in the performance of the employee’s position.


Time Type

Full time

Location

Remote Location

Pay Range

Compensation is determined based on factors such as qualifications, experience, education, skills, and certifications, along with University needs and external market conditions. Market benchmarks may be used, as appropriate, in combination with internal equity to ensure pay is fair and aligned with the broader compensation structure.


The position may also be eligible for comprehensive benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans, and tuition assistance.

raw.description:
About Us:

How many companies can say they’ve been in business for over 180 years?!

Here at ZEISS, we certainly can! As the pioneers of science, ZEISS handles ever-changing environments in a fast-paced world, meeting it with cutting edge of technologies and continuous advancements. ZEISS believes that innovation and technology are the key to a sustainable future and solutions for global change. We have a diverse range of portfolios throughout the ZEISS family in segments like Industrial Quality & Research, Medical Technology, Consumer Markets and Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology. We are a global company with over 46,000 employees and have over 4,000 in the US and Canada alone! Make a difference, come join the team!

Location/Region: Candidate’s must reside in either Michigan or North Carolina.

What’s the role?
The Product Sales Development Manager (PSDM) plays a critical role in driving the commercial success of the 3D Optical Product Center by building technical confidence and demonstrating customer value throughout the buyer's journey. Serving as the portfolio advocate and technical resource for your assigned product center, the PSDM combines deep product expertise with market insight and sales enablement to accelerate product adoption, grow market share, and support revenue growth.

In collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Global Product Management, Production, Customer Segments, and Regional Sales teams, you will develop and execute growth strategies that expand market penetration and achieve booking and revenue objectives. You will oversee portfolio-level funnel development, product launch readiness, and commercial excellence across assigned product lines.

You will work closely with local teams and global product leaders to understand customer and market needs, influence global product management roadmap, improve market messaging, and support long-term business growth. Additionally, you will ensure organizational alignment across product lines, drive cross-functional initiatives, and champion continuous improvement opportunities. In some cases, this role also supports a Customer Segment as Solution Manager, championing segment strategy, application development, and key initiatives.

Success in this role is measured through product revenue growth, market share expansion, product adoption, sales funnel development, demonstration effectiveness, competitive positioning, and overall contribution to business growth.

Sound Interesting?

Here’s what you’ll do:

Product Sales Development Manager for a Product Center

  • Works with Sales Leadership on the commercial strategy, performance, and growth of the assigned Product Center.
  • Establishes and tracks multi-year Product Center growth plans and priorities.
  • Coordinates portfolio strategy, investment priorities, and go-to-market activities across product lines.
  • Ensures alignment between Product Sales Managers, Regional Sales, and Marketing teams.
  • Provides monthly, quarterly, or as-needed sales forecasts.
  • Enables sales and channel partners to effectively sell the product line.
  • Supports product quoting by defining preferred configurations, pricing, and descriptions.
  • Conducts ongoing sales and product training, developing and delivering training materials.
  • Supports marketing with product messaging and content for launches and new opportunities.
  • Leads cross-functional efforts for organizational readiness and successful product launches.
  • Achieves monthly, quarterly, and annual sales performance targets.
  • Meets targeted sales margins and supports product management with sales calculations as needed.
  • Plans demo inventory and resources for assigned products.
  • Monitors and communicates competitor and market developments.
  • Regularly visits key customers, distributors, and the sales network.
  • Co-leads cross-functional initiatives for targeted customer segments, if assigned.

Do you qualify?

  • 4-year degree in technical discipline (engineering or physics preferred)
  • 5-8 years of Sales, Business Development, Application or Product Management experience in a B2B capital equipment sales environment (machinery, metrology, inspection, microscopy or related beneficial).
  • Demonstrated high level knowledge of 3D Optical Product portfolio

Working Conditions and Special Demands:

  • Ability to thrive in a high-pressure sales environment.
  • Goal-oriented with a structured approach.
  • Ability to manage employees of different performance levels.
  • Proficient in articulating technical information in a clear and concise manner.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Skilled in creating and delivering compelling presentations.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to draw meaningful conclusions and effectively visualize data.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.
  • Proactive mindset with a strong drive to succeed.
  • Must have valid US driver’s license
  • Willingness to manage a high level of travel, approximately 25%-50% of the time.

We have amazing benefits to support you as an employee at ZEISS!

  • Medical
  • Vision
  • Dental
  • 401k Matching
  • Employee Assistance Programs
  • Paid time off including vacation, personal, and sick days
  • The list goes on!

Supports the full employee lifecycle by providing administrative support to ensure a smooth and compliant hiring and onboarding process. This role assists with job postings, pre-employment activities, maintaining accurate records, and supporting HR systems and reporting in accordance with federal, state, and company policies. The position also responds to candidate and hiring manager inquiries and provides general administrative support to the People & Culture and Recruitment teams as needed.

Why You’ll Love Working Here


We believe great people deserve great support—at work and beyond. That’s why we offer a rewards experience designed to help you thrive personally, professionally, and financially:

  • Competitive pay that recognizes your experience, expertise, and impact
  • Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage; accrued paid time off; 401(k) with company match; disability and life insurance; and paid maternity and paternity leave
  • Company-paid holidays so you can rest, recharge, and focus on what matters most
  • Recognition programs, contests, and awards that celebrate your contributions
  • Continuous growth opportunities through learning, leadership development, and career advancement support
  • A collaborative culture where your ideas are valued and your work makes a difference

We’re also proud to be recognized for creating an exceptional employee experience:

  • Best Place to Work in BioPharma — 2022, 2023, 2025
  • Certified Great Place to Work® — 2021, 2023, 2025, 2026

Learn more:

What will you be doing?

  • Manage job postings, requisition tracking, and recruitment system administration, ensuring accurate documentation and timely progression of candidates through the hiring process.
  • Coordinate end-to-end pre-employment and onboarding processes, including background investigations, drug testing, offer letters, and new hire documentation.
  • Maintain candidate, contractor and employee records, ensuring compliance with federal/state regulations and company policies, including I-9 verification and employment authorization documentation.
  • HRIS (Workday) and recruitment systems- generate reports, manage tracking tools, and ensure data accuracy and confidentiality across all records and documentation.
  • Manage shared mailboxes and ServiceNow inquiries, preparing employment verifications and unemployment documentation, distributing surveys, and contributing to process improvements
  • Serving as a point of contact for candidates and hiring managers.
  • Support ongoing People & Culture and Recruitment initiatives.
  • All other ad hoc requests from management as and when required.

What do you need for this position?

  • Bachelor’s degree or related work experience desirable.
  • 2 years plus varied administrative experience.
  • Must be proficient in Microsoft Office, in particular Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience working with HRIS and Applicant Tracking Systems preferred
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and time management skills
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage confidential information
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

The base pay range for this position is $16.10/hr – $29.90/hr. The final compensation offered to a successful candidate will be determined by factors such as experience, skills, internal equity, and business needs.

About Inizio Engage

Inizio Engage is a strategic, commercial, and creative engagement partner that specializes in healthcare. Our passionate, global workforce augments local expertise and diverse mix of skills with data, science, and technology to deliver bespoke engagement solutions that help clients reimagine how they engage with their patients, payers, people, and providers to improve treatment outcomes. Our mission is to partner with our clients, improving lives by helping healthcare professionals and patients get the medicines, knowledge and support they need.

We believe in our values: We empower everyone/We rise to the challenge/We work as one/We ask what if/We do the right thing, and we will ask you how your personal values align to them.

To learn more about Inizio Engage, visit us at:

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion

Inizio Engage is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related conditions), mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Inizio Engage is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable law.

Inizio Engage complies with applicable fair chance hiring laws and will consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal history. Where permitted by applicable law, employment offers may be contingent upon the successful completion of a background check. Any information obtained from a background check will be considered in relation to the requirements of the relevant position, consistent with applicable law.

raw.description:
Fully remote | Working directly with the CEO | Monthly compensation in USD

About Us

We are a startup where priorities can change quickly, processes are still developing and several important initiatives often run in parallel. We are looking for someone who enjoys this environment and can bring structure, calm and reliable execution to a busy working day. Our work spans HR, finance, IT and marketing, with AI playing a practical role in how we organise information, coordinate work and improve processes.

Job Description

As Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will be a trusted right hand who turns priorities into clear actions and follows them through to completion. You will anticipate needs, organise competing demands, coordinate people and maintain a reliable overview of what requires attention across the business.

Inbox and calendar management form part of the role, alongside broader responsibility for organising projects, improving workflows, preparing decisions and keeping commitments on track.

You should bring practical experience using AI to accomplish meaningful work. This includes creating and using reusable AI skills: structured instructions, relevant context and tools that help an AI assistant perform recurring tasks consistently. You should be comfortable adapting these workflows, checking their outputs and recognising when human judgement or specialist input is needed.

You should be comfortable with the pace, uncertainty and pressure that can come with building a startup. This means adapting when plans change, handling competing requests and maintaining sound judgement under time pressure. You will help the CEO and team set realistic priorities, make trade-offs and identify when workload or deadlines need to be adjusted.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate the CEO's priorities into actionable plans with clear owners, deadlines and follow-up.
  • Maintain an overview of ongoing initiatives, identify dependencies and flag delays or decisions early.
  • Coordinate work across the startup team, external partners and service providers.
  • Prepare concise research, meeting briefs, comparisons and recommendations that support decisions.
  • Organise meetings, correspondence and schedules, capturing decisions and ensuring agreed actions are completed.
  • Support HR operations through recruitment coordination, onboarding, documentation and follow-up.
  • Support finance operations by organising invoices, expenses, payment schedules and information needed by accounting specialists.
  • Support marketing initiatives by organising briefs, assets, deadlines and collaboration with internal and external contributors.
  • Coordinate IT requests, access requirements, software subscriptions and communication with technical colleagues.
  • Organise and improve how the CEO and startup team use Microsoft 365, keeping communication, documents, tasks and shared information structured and accessible.
  • Connect Microsoft tools with suitable AI skills and workflows, respecting permissions and confidentiality.
  • Create, adapt and maintain AI skills and repeatable workflows for research, reporting, documentation and operational coordination.
  • Check AI-generated work for accuracy, relevance and completeness before it is used.
  • Keep business information organised and handle confidential matters with discretion.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in executive assistance, business operations, project coordination or a comparable role involving substantial ownership.
  • A working understanding of HR, finance, IT and marketing, sufficient to coordinate tasks, ask informed questions and recognise when specialist expertise is required.
  • Strong practical experience with Microsoft 365, particularly Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to organise collaboration across these tools, including shared documents, structured information, task tracking and access coordination.
  • Confidence using Excel to maintain operational overviews, reconcile information and prepare clear reports.
  • Practical experience creating or configuring reusable AI skills and applying them to real work.
  • Ability to explain a workflow you personally implemented, including how you checked its results and handled its limitations.
  • Strong prioritisation and follow-through, including the ability to manage several workstreams without constant reminders.
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English.
  • Confidence working with spreadsheets, documents, shared knowledge systems and task management tools.
  • Sound judgement about confidentiality, access permissions and the information shared with AI tools.
  • Willingness to take responsibility, resolve routine issues independently and escalate significant risks promptly.
  • Resilience and adaptability in a startup environment, including changing priorities, incomplete information and periods of high workload.
  • Ability to remain calm, communicate clearly and maintain quality under pressure.
  • A practical approach to solving problems and taking ownership when established processes or clear instructions are not yet available.
  • Confidence raising capacity constraints early, proposing realistic alternatives and clarifying which tasks take priority.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Working directly with a founder or supporting a small startup team.
  • Improving processes that span several business functions.
  • Using AI agents, tool integrations or automation platforms to reduce repetitive work.
  • Hands-on experience with Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio to build useful automations and AI assistants.
  • Building reusable procedures and shared knowledge that other team members can use.
  • Coordinating recruitment, financial administration, suppliers or marketing delivery.

What We Offer

  • Close collaboration with the CEO and visibility across the startup.
  • Meaningful ownership of operational work and process improvements.
  • A broad role combining executive support, team coordination and practical AI use.
  • A fully remote working arrangement.
  • Monthly compensation in USD.

Remote Working Arrangement

You will work remotely and maintain clear visibility of priorities, progress and blockers. Reliable communication, organised documentation and consistent follow-through are essential. Working hours and required availability will be agreed during the hiring process.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and describe relevant examples of work you have personally delivered. Include an AI skill or workflow you created or substantially adapted, the business task it supported, and how you ensured the result was useful and reliable. An example of coordinating work across different business functions would also be helpful.

Remote | Australia | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation: $15–$35 USD/hour, based on specialty, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Healthcare

What if the medical knowledge and clinical skills you're developing could help improve how artificial intelligence understands complex healthcare information, evaluates medical scenarios, and delivers more accurate, reliable responses?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting medical students, residents, and advanced healthcare trainees with opportunities to contribute to the evaluation and improvement of advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) models.

We're seeking individuals currently pursuing medical education or completing supervised clinical training in General Practice, Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Nurse Practitioner, or Physician Assistant pathways.

This opportunity is designed for candidates who can apply their academic knowledge, clinical training, and evidence-based reasoning to evaluate AI-generated medical information.

This is not a traditional clinical position. You will not provide direct patient care, diagnose actual patients, or make treatment decisions for real patients. Instead, you'll assess medical scenarios, evaluate clinical reasoning, identify inaccuracies, and provide structured feedback to help improve AI model performance.

Previous AI experience is not required. We're looking for candidates with a strong foundation in medical knowledge, analytical thinking, and an interest in applying their education to emerging healthcare technology.

Areas of Medical Education & Clinical Training

We're seeking qualified students and trainees in the following five areas:

1. General Practice:

Medical students in their third or fourth year, medical interns, or residents pursuing a broad foundation in general medical practice.

Ideal candidates have education or clinical exposure in:

  • General patient assessment and clinical evaluation.
  • Recognition and management principles for common medical conditions.
  • Preventive medicine and general healthcare practices.
  • Medical history review and interpretation of clinical findings.
  • Fundamental diagnostic reasoning and evidence-based medical decision-making.

2. Family Medicine

Third- or fourth-year medical students, medical interns, or residents with clinical training, rotations, or demonstrated interest in family medicine.

Relevant experience may include:

  • Primary care across different age groups and patient populations.
  • Evaluation of acute and chronic medical conditions.
  • Preventive care, wellness, and health screenings.
  • Differential diagnosis and general treatment planning principles.
  • Interpretation of medical histories, clinical findings, and evidence-based guidelines.

3. Internal Medicine

Third- or fourth-year medical students, medical interns, or residents with clinical training, rotations, or an interest in internal medicine.

Relevant knowledge and experience may include:

  • Adult medicine and management principles for common or complex conditions.
  • Interpretation of laboratory results and diagnostic findings.
  • Recognition of multisystem diseases and related complications.
  • Development and evaluation of differential diagnoses.
  • Evidence-based approaches to clinical assessment and medical management.

4. Nurse Practitioner (NP)

Students currently enrolled in a recognized Nurse Practitioner educational program, particularly those completing advanced coursework or supervised clinical training.

Ideal candidates have education or experience in:

  • Advanced health assessment and patient evaluation.
  • Pathophysiology, pharmacology, and clinical management principles.
  • Diagnostic reasoning and interpretation of medical findings.
  • Evidence-based treatment planning and healthcare practices.
  • Patient education, preventive care, and healthcare quality standards.

Candidates pursuing Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP) or Adult-Gerontology Primary Care Nurse Practitioner (AGPCNP) pathways are especially encouraged to apply.

5. Physician Assistant (PA) / Physician Associate

Students currently enrolled in a recognized Physician Assistant or Physician Associate program, preferably in the clinical phase of training.

Relevant educational and clinical experience may include:

  • Patient assessment, medical history review, and physical examination.
  • Clinical rotations in primary care, internal medicine, or family medicine.
  • Differential diagnosis and interpretation of diagnostic findings.
  • Evidence-based treatment and patient management principles.
  • Medical documentation and evaluation of clinical scenarios.

What You'll Do

As a Medical AI Evaluator, you'll apply your medical education and clinical training to assess how accurately AI systems interpret healthcare information and reason through medical scenarios.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate AI-Generated Medical Content: Review AI-generated healthcare information for factual accuracy, completeness, clinical relevance, and consistency with established medical knowledge and guidelines.
  • Assess Clinical Reasoning: Evaluate AI-generated assessments, differential diagnoses, and treatment-related explanations to determine whether conclusions are medically sound and supported by appropriate evidence.
  • Identify Medical Inaccuracies: Recognize factual errors, unsupported assumptions, missing clinical considerations, and potential patient safety concerns in AI-generated responses.
  • Conduct Medical Research and Verification: Validate information using credible sources, including peer-reviewed medical literature, clinical practice guidelines, and established healthcare resources.
  • Review Clinical Scenarios: Analyze hypothetical patient cases, symptoms, medical histories, laboratory findings, and diagnostic information to evaluate AI-generated interpretations.
  • Provide Evidence-Based Feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify inaccuracies, and recommend appropriate corrections supported by medical evidence and clinical standards.
  • Apply Evaluation Standards: Consistently follow project-specific scoring rubrics, annotation instructions, and quality assurance guidelines.
  • Complete Assigned Evaluations: Perform independent evaluation tasks using designated online platforms, including DataCompute, while meeting established deadlines and quality expectations.
  • Maintain Confidentiality and Professional Standards: Protect sensitive project information and comply with applicable privacy, ethical, and data security requirements.

Compensation & Project Structure

Volga Partners offers project-based hourly compensation based on educational background, clinical training, relevant experience, geographic location, and assignment complexity.

This opportunity is ideal for individuals seeking to earn supplemental income while applying your professional skills and expertise to meaningful projects.

Specialty & Experience Level

General Practitioner

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$25/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$35/hr

Family Medicine

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$25/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$35/hr

Internal Medicine

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$25/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$35/hr

Nurse Practitioner

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$20/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$28/hr

Physician Assistant

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$23/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$30/hr

Eligibility Requirements

  • Second-year medical students must be enrolled at a top medical school
  • Third-year students and above: open to all qualifying programs
  • Relevant specialty or study track required (see list above)

Final compensation is subject to client approval, project requirements, and geographic eligibility.

This is a freelance, task-based opportunity intended for individuals interested in applying their medical knowledge to AI evaluation projects while continuing their education or clinical training.

Assignments are distributed based on project needs and availability. Workloads may be irregular or intermittent, and specific hours or future assignments are not guaranteed.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Medical Education in a New Way

Use the medical knowledge and clinical reasoning skills gained through your coursework, clinical rotations, or supervised training to contribute to advanced AI evaluation projects.

Help Improve Healthcare AI Accuracy

Your evaluations will help identify weaknesses in AI-generated medical information and support the development of more reliable and medically informed AI systems.

Explore Emerging Healthcare Technology

Gain exposure to AI evaluation, medical content assessment, and evidence-based research while expanding your experience beyond traditional clinical settings.

Work Remotely

Participate in specialized project assignments from an eligible location, with schedules and workloads based on project availability.

No AI Background Required

We're looking for candidates who can think critically, recognize accurate medical reasoning, identify errors, and explain their conclusions using credible medical evidence.

Project Details

  • Engagement Type: Project-Based Independent Contractor
  • Work Arrangement: Remote
  • Primary Location: United States
  • Additional Markets Under Consideration: United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, India, and the Philippines, subject to client approval
  • Schedule: Variable, including potential weekday and weekend assignments
  • Evaluation Platform: DataCompute
  • Project Duration: Based on client requirements and project availability
  • Selection Process: Qualified applicants may be required to complete a medical knowledge or clinical reasoning assessment before selection.

Specific assignments, schedules, and workloads will be communicated as they become available.

Bring Your Medical Knowledge to the Future of AI

Whether you're completing medical school, advancing through residency, or pursuing Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant training, this is an opportunity to apply your developing clinical expertise to emerging healthcare technology.

At Volga Partners, we value candidates who demonstrate strong medical knowledge, thoughtful clinical reasoning, attention to detail, and the ability to evaluate complex information using evidence-based principles.

Join us in helping shape the next generation of healthcare AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming project opportunities.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

Candidates should possess the following qualifications:

  • Medical or Advanced Healthcare Education: Current enrollment in the third or fourth year of a recognized medical degree program, an eligible medical internship or residency, or an advanced NP or PA educational program with relevant clinical training.
  • Relevant Clinical Focus: Academic coursework, clinical rotations, or supervised training related to General Practice, Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Nurse Practitioner practice, or Physician Assistant practice.
  • Foundational Medical Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical terminology, anatomy, physiology, pathology, pharmacology, and clinical concepts relevant to their area of training.
  • Clinical Reasoning and Evaluation: Ability to assess medical scenarios, interpret clinical information, and distinguish evidence-based reasoning from inaccurate or unsupported conclusions.
  • Research and Evidence Verification: Ability to research medical literature, interpret clinical guidelines, and validate findings using authoritative healthcare resources.
  • Analytical and Critical Thinking: Strong analytical reasoning, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.
  • Written Communication: Excellent written English skills, with the ability to clearly explain clinical findings, document evaluations, and support conclusions with credible evidence.
  • Technical Proficiency: Comfort working with computers, web-based platforms, digital documentation, and online research tools.
  • Independent Work and Accountability: Ability to follow detailed instructions, complete assignments independently, and consistently meet established quality requirements.
  • Project-Based Availability: Willingness to participate in a remote, freelance engagement where assignments and schedules are determined by project needs.

Independent medical licensure and previous employment as a licensed physician, Nurse Practitioner, or Physician Assistant are not required for eligible student-level evaluation assignments.

Preferred Qualifications

The following experience or qualifications may strengthen a candidate's application:

  • Clinical rotations, clerkships, internships, or supervised training in general practice, family medicine, internal medicine, or primary care.
  • Enrollment in the clinical phase of an accredited or recognized medical, NP, or PA educational program.
  • Experience reviewing medical records, clinical case studies, laboratory results, or diagnostic documentation.
  • Familiarity with evidence-based medicine, differential diagnosis, and established clinical practice guidelines.
  • Participation in medical research, literature reviews, clinical case presentations, or healthcare-related academic projects.
  • Exposure to healthcare quality assurance, medical documentation review, or clinical evaluation.
  • Interest in artificial intelligence, healthcare technology, or medical informatics.

Previous AI evaluation experience is beneficial but not required.

raw.excerpt: About Nebius:Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy.
raw.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

We're looking for a Lead Technical Project Manager for Network Infrastructure. This is not a "make slides, chase tickets, and ask engineers for status" job. It is a role for someone with an engineering skeleton: a person who has built, operated, broken and recovered things, and can earn trust in a room full of SREs, SWEs, network engineers, security and platform teams. We are at the early stage of our APAC expansion, so you will work with a high degree of independence, set up the project management practices for the region from scratch, and stay close to the technical details yourself.

The "T" matters. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every area, but you should be technical enough to understand real trade-offs: why rollback is not optional, why "just automate it" can create a bigger blast radius, why a provisioning flow must survive real-world constraints, why SLOs without ownership are decoration, and why network device CI/CD is very different from deploying a stateless service. You can read a design doc, challenge missing assumptions, notice unclear failure modes, ask sharp questions, and turn a vague but important problem into an executable plan.

The "P" is project delivery with a product mindset, even if the product is internal infrastructure. Your product may be a site bootstrap kit, secrets and robot-user management, an SLO framework, a firmware rollout process, a network observability platform, CI/CD for network devices, or automation that makes day-0 and day-N operations safe. The job is not done when the technical pieces exist. It is done when engineers trust the tool, the NOC actually uses the workflow, alerts are actionable, runbooks are real, and the new way becomes the default way. That means adoption, communication, documentation, feedback loops, and sometimes a bit of internal "marketing": the ability to convince smart technical people that the thing is worth using.

The "M" is management of execution, not people management. You will not be responsible for engineers' careers, performance reviews or promotions. You will be responsible for making important cross-team initiatives land: defining scope, aligning owners, exposing risks, driving decisions, tracking dependencies, creating clarity where things are unclear, and making sure we ship useful outcomes instead of collecting half-finished initiatives.

This is a high-leverage role in a early-stage and fast-scaling network infrastructure organisation. Many important systems are being built now: automation, observability, reliability standards, provisioning flows, operational safety, and cross-site consistency. You won't be maintaining a mature machine from the sidelines. You'll help shape how the machine works.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own end-to-end delivery of cross-team network infrastructure initiatives in APAC, from a vague problem statement to an executable plan to adoption
  • Define scope and success criteria, align owners across SRE, SWE, network, security, platform and data center teams, and drive decisions to closure
  • Review designs and technical proposals, challenge missing assumptions, and surface failure modes, dependencies and risks early
  • Track dependencies and risks across teams and time zones, and keep stakeholders, including the European teams, informed with clear, honest status
  • Drive adoption: make sure tools and workflows become the default way of working, with real documentation, runbooks and feedback loops
  • Establish and run lightweight, effective project management practices for the region: planning, prioritization, reviews, and post-launch follow-up
  • Work with regional teams and external partners (vendors, carriers) on the rollout of new network capabilities
  • Turn operational pain and engineering input into a clear, prioritized backlog

We expect you to have:

  • 7+ years of experience in technical project management, engineering management or a hands-on engineering role (SRE, SWE, network or infrastructure), with a track record of delivering complex cross-team infrastructure projects
  • A real engineering background: you have built and operated production systems and can earn the trust of deeply technical teams
  • Ability to read design docs and technical proposals, understand trade-offs, and ask sharp questions about reliability, rollback, blast radius and failure modes
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure fundamentals (Linux, networking, automation, CI/CD) at the level needed to hold your own in technical discussions
  • Proven ability to drive decisions and create clarity in ambiguous, fast-changing environments without formal authority
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including documenting plans and decisions and influencing smart technical people

raw.title: Fraud Specialist, Supplier Operations & Governance
raw.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
raw.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Fraud Specialist, Supplier Operations & Governance (P4).

About the job

We are actively recruiting for this role to fill an existing vacancy. This position will be responsible for working constructively with our customers and partners to resolve billing issues and fraudulent misuse of services.

We are seeking a sharp, highly data-oriented, and tenacious Fraud Specialist to join our team. Unlike a traditional billing or collections role focused on routine outreach or simple invoice review, this position is a hybrid of financial investigation, root cause analysis, and strategic dispute negotiation. In this role, you will look for billing discrepancies, investigate Artificially Inflated Traffic (AIT) or IRSF (International Revenue Share Fraud), dig deep into messaging and call data, project manage high-value customer and vendor disputes, and build data-backed cases to resolve discrepancies. You will build dashboards to communicate key metrics and drive action. If you love solving complex data puzzles, negotiating with external parties, and finding win-win outcomes, this is the role for you.

You will be part of a company that is the category leader in Communications Platform as a Service (CPaaS), an organization working with the largest customers and partners, and a team of operators and former consultants that have delivered exceptional impact. If you have an extreme owner / founder mindset and a desire to solve big challenges, you’ll find yourself at home.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Advise account managers, accounting, and management on best practices to handle billing disputes
  • Negotiate with customers and carriers with an understanding of resolution levers available as per contractual terms and industry norms
  • Identify, analyze, and handle fraudulent misuse (such as Artificially Inflated Traffic) and billing errors (such as rate differences) with both vendors and customers
  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer and vendor disputes from intake of disputes to initiating disputes, tracking progress, and ensuring timely, documented resolution
  • Uncover and resolve discrepancies, overcharges, and unpaid balances with carriers and customers due to quantities, rates, currency, and other root causes
  • Dig into call and messaging data to identify why bills don’t match or find evidence of fraud
  • Build dashboards that communicate key metrics related to the lifecycle of disputes
  • Read contracts and interpret what should be the invoice versus what it is
  • Act as the primary point of contact to negotiate dispute resolutions, settlements, and payment terms in accordance with company practices
  • Partner closely with data analytics, engineering, and accounting to reconcile accounts

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in telecom operations, fraud operations, customer success, vendor management, procurement, collections, or consulting.
  • Sharp written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience negotiating disputes constructively with customers or vendors.
  • Experience in collections, dispute resolution, or billing analysis.
  • Experience in project management.
  • Experience wrangling data with Excel / Google Sheets, Looker or SQL.

Desired:

  • Understanding of the A2P SMS ecosystem, international traffic routing, international revenue share fraud (IRSF), artificially inflated traffic (AIT) and the ecosystem profit chains.
  • Understanding of industry standards with respect to AIT and fraud handling such as frameworks from i3forum, GSMA, MEF or ITW Global Leaders’ Forum.
  • Understanding of Call Detail Records (CDRs) and ability to build strong dispute case files.
  • Experience working with workflow platforms like Airtable or building dashboards.
  • Experience in telecom, technology, or consulting industries.
  • Experience with advanced data analysis like Python or scripting
  • Experience with AI and automation tools to accelerate productivity.

Location

This role will be remote and based in Ontario, British Columbia or Alberta, Canada.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Based on role, employees may also be eligible for additional compensation and benefits, including but not limited to incentive programs, commissions, equity grants, health and wellness benefits, retirement contributions, and paid time off.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • 90,800.00 - CAD 113,500.00
  • Target Bonus Percentage 15%

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

Our European activities are growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a full-time, home-based Regulatory Submissions Coordinator & Contract Specialist (Dual role) to join our Clinical Operations team, in Serbia.

As a Regulatory Submissions Coordinator & Contract Specialist (Dual role) you will have the opportunity to work within Regulatory Submissions and contract negotiations, supporting our many projects. You will be a productive member of the team and will be mentored and supported as you develop your skills. Working directly with Regulatory Submissions Coordinators and Contract Specialists, you will gain valuable hands-on experience to enable you to develop a career in clinical research.


Responsibilities

  • Prepare, review, and file initial clinical trial applications to regulatory authorities and Ethics committees in Serbia and Croatia;
  • Prepare and submit responses to queries and amendments to clinical trial applications;
  • Ensure submissions comply with applicable regulations and guidance documents;
  • Advise team members on changing regulations and compliance requirements;
  • Maintain the Clinical Trial Management System and ensure timely filing of documents;
  • Collection of essential documents and preparation essential documents packages for drug release;
  • Drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and finalizing agreements, termination letters or other legal documents required for a clinical study;
  • Identify and assesses legal, financial, and operational risks and escalate to appropriate Contract Lead or Contract Manager;
  • Provide recommendations and alternative resolutions throughout negotiations using established escalation channels;
  • Coordinate with internal functional departments to ensure various site startup activities are aligned with contractual process and mutually agreed up timelines.

Qualifications

  • A minimum of a Bachelor's degree is required (preferably in a Life Sciences field or Law);
  • Experience preparing, reviewing, and submitting regulatory documentation to Ethics Committees and Regulatory Agencies; including formulating responses to queries;
  • Relevant working experience at a CRO, Pharmaceutical Company, or an investigative site;
  • Knowledge of local regulatory guidelines and legislation;
  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills;
  • Use to work independently with a proactive approach;
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office;
  • Fluency in Serbian/ Croatian and English; and
  • Great attention to detail and excellent oral and written communication skills.

We kindly ask to submit applications in English.



Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.


Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Purpose-Driven Work

    • Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

Collaborative Culture

    • Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
    • Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

Continuous Growth & Development

    • Office based environment with on-site mentors
    • Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
    • Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
    • Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
    • An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

    • Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
    • Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
    • Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
    • Company-sponsored social events

Please note benefits may vary based on country.

What to Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.
