raw.description:
Position: VP of Campaigns

Department: Advocacy, Strategic Programs

Reports to: Executive Chief of Staff

Supervises: Director of Organizing

FLSA Status: Exempt, Full-Time

Union Status: Not eligible for the bargaining unit

Location: Remote, near a major airport; See below for more

Salary: $146,000 - $163,000

About Us

Advocates for Trans Equality fights for the legal and political rights of transgender people in America. Leveraging decades of experience on the frontlines of power, we shift government and society towards a future where we are no less than equal. Founded in 2024, Advocates for Trans Equality was formed through an alliance by two national trans advocacy organizations and is of, for, and by the trans community. Advocates for Trans Equality (501c4) and Advocates for Trans Equality Education Fund (501c3) focuses its efforts on political and legal advocacy, public education, and community engagement. The Advocates for Trans Equality team catalyzes progress from the inside out and will settle for nothing less than equality for trans people in America. Advocates for Trans Equality and Advocates for Trans Equality Education Fund are incorporated in Washington, DC with offices in DC and New York and employ approximately 40 dedicated staff who share office space and work across the country.

Position Summary

The Vice President of Campaigns is responsible for developing, managing and executing state and federal ballot measure, public education, and advocacy campaigns in partnership with departments of Policy, Legal, Organizing, and Public Education.

The Vice President of Campaigns creates campaign engagement criteria, conducts campaign assessments, and makes recommendations about A4TE’s priorities and investments. They also coordinate A4TE’s cross-team engagement in campaigns, monitor and keep the full team regularly appraised on developments, and serve as the lead on priority campaigns as needed.

Duties and Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop a thoughtful, strategic, coordinated campaign and ballot strategy on behalf of A4TE to address urgent, emerging ballot measures at the state level that have the potential to significantly impact transgender people in the 2026-2028 electoral cycles and beyond.
  • Work with A4TE leadership to execute A4TE’s ballot strategy in a manner to ensure such efforts are compliant with all applicable federal, state, and local laws and to protect the charitable statuses of A4TE and A4TEEF.
  • Serve as A4TE’s primary external contact and thought partner to LGBTQ+ movement partner organizations for coordination around advocacy strategy tactics influencing ballot issue work and electoral engagement, among other areas of advocacy.
  • Manage, cultivate, and inspire the leadership of the Organizing Director, who oversees A4TE’s organizing team. Support the transition of such organizing from predominantly mobilization techniques to deeper field organizing work in service of state needs, particularly around ballot issues. Support GOTV educational work as part of overall campaign strategy.
  • Support coordination of A4TE’s work on ballot measures impacting trans people, including how that work intersects with the work of other national partners. Serve as the primary A4TE representative working to support efforts in defeating anti-trans ballot measures in 2026 and beyond.
  • Oversee federal and state public education and advocacy campaigns, including creating and maintaining assessment criteria to determine priority campaigns and engagement in rapid response contexts, making recommendations about A4TE’s priorities and investments, developing and implementing successful strategies, advising and supporting organizational partners, and coordinating A4TE’s cross-team engagement in campaigns.
  • Keep A4TE team regularly apprised of developments on campaign-specific public education and advocacy efforts.
  • Work with consultants, lobbyists, organizational partners, and state and local leaders to help defeat discriminatory anti-trans ballot measures and advance pro-trans ballot measures. Determine and recommend prioritization of such campaigns and what role A4TE should serve in such campaigns, if any.
  • Manage, support, and ensure accountability of campaign consultants, including both existing teams and the cultivation of new consultant teams in states where work is not currently underway.
  • Contribute to fundraising efforts necessary to raise capital for campaign activities.
  • Work with the Organizing, Policy, Strategic Communications, and Public Education departments to drive public education and advocacy victories.
  • Travel to campaign sites as needed.
  • Work cross departmentally to ensure the effective delivery of latest messaging and research to legislative leaders, organizational partners, key constituencies, and allies.

Required Qualifications

A4TE Education Fund acknowledges that applicants from communities that have been historically marginalized are less likely to apply for positions unless they feel that they completely meet all qualifications listed in a job description. We understand that an ideal candidate might not completely meet the criteria listed above or be equally proficient in each area; we especially encourage applicants who are impacted by A4TE’s work to submit their application anyway.

  • Leadership Experience: A minimum of 6 years of experience in a leadership role. Demonstrated management experience, including the ability to coach team members using tested management techniques, emotional intelligence, and good judgement.
  • Ballot Experience: A strong working knowledge of and demonstrated success in advancing ballot campaigns. Deep understanding of how policy, legal, organizing, communications, fundraising, messaging, compliance, and other interests intersect within a given ballot campaign, and demonstrated ability to strategically coordinate these elements.
  • Compliance Experience: A working knowledge of 501(c)(3), 501(c)(4), PAC, and ballot legal compliance. Demonstrated ability to pull in experts, partners and/or legal counsel when necessary to support organizational compliance efforts. Ability to exhibit good judgement for advancing complex and legally compliant strategies to successfully engage in ballot campaign work.
  • Political Experience: A strong working knowledge of the role politics plays within an overarching advocacy framework, including familiarity with campaign cycles, partisanship, and the role of politics in moving the Overton Window on a given issue.
  • Organizational Experience: Direct experience with diverse social justice, government, organizing, and/or movement building organizations. Demonstrated ability to bring partners with diverse missions together around a common goal.
  • Understanding of Transgender Justice: A deep and nuanced understanding of issues affecting transgender people as well as an understanding of how racism, classism, sexism, and other systems of inter-connected oppressions affect trans people. Strong belief in A4TE’s mission and the people who are driving the work forward. A strong commitment and desire to moving the Overton Window on trans issues over the next 5-10 years.
  • Communication Skills: Effective verbal and written skills to communicate complex policies and procedures to ensure staff have the information needed for their position responsibilities and overall organizational workflow; ability to listen to staff concerns and feedback to assist in working together for solutions that comply with organizational policies. Ability to understand organizational needs to communicate with those outside of the organization.
  • Technological Knowledge: Experience in all areas of MS Office 365 and collaborative tools, such as Slack, Asana, and Zoom. Experience with policy software, such as PolicyNote, BillTracker50, or similar product. Experience with organizing and campaign tools, such as NGP VAN, EveryAction, or similar products.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • Leadership Experience: 6-8 years’ experience in a management role, such as a Field Director, Campaign Director or Political Director
  • Campaign Experience: 8-10 years’ experience in traditional field organizing, preferably in ballot measures, advocacy campaigns, or political campaigns.
  • Geographic Location: Remote but located near a major airport. Based in the Midwest, South, Southwest, or Central United States, which are areas most impacted and forecasted to be impacted by anti-trans state policies and ballot campaigns. Ability and willingness to travel to states where field and campaign organizing support is necessary.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluency or proficiency in a language other than English, especially Spanish.
  • Technological Knowledge: Experience in using FileVine, FiscalNote, or other legal and policy database tools.

Traits of Successful Candidates

  • Trustworthy & Collaborative: Excellent relationship and trust building capabilities and a demonstrated track record building, leading, and managing teams; serving as a coach and mentor to staff across a range of areas. An earned reputation for being trustworthy, with excellent judgment and discretion. Kindness and strengths-based leadership: someone who sees value in every person and communicates respect and encouragement to people at all levels; a passionate investment in the well-being and success of staff. A willingness to accept input and feedback from colleagues at all levels of the organization.
  • Responsive Problem-Solving Skills: Agile project management skills, ability to develop and implement new strategies and procedures, and meet multiple competing deadlines.
  • Self-Direction: Initiative and ambition to ensure that all projects are moving forward. Ability to adapt as needed, self-manage, and prioritize between and manage multiple demands.
  • Optimism: A positive and productive attitude to problem-solving within the context of intense social justice work. Optimistic and resourceful, with strong self-awareness, cultural competence, emotional intelligence, and humility; grounded and flexible with a high degree of integrity and transparency.
  • Strength and Persistence: The ability to be exposed to transphobia and other kinds of discrimination or stress on a daily basis and keep fighting hard for transgender equality.

Salary & Benefits

Salary for this role is between $146,000 - $163,000.

Advocates for Trans Equality offers a robust benefits package that includes 100% employer-paid medical, vision, dental, and life insurance; 75% employer contributions to spousal and dependent healthcare; employer contributions to retirement plan; monthly remote work stipends; access to gender-affirming healthcare pool; name and identity document change support; generous time off, including paid holidays, 20 paid vacation days annually, sick time, and office-wide closures; medical and parental leaves; weekly wellness hours; volunteer hours; 3-month paid sabbatical after 5 years; healthcare flex spending account; and professional development stipend.

Salary: $146,000 – $163,000 / year

raw.description:
We are seeking experienced Offshore Structural Designers with proven hands-on experience in offshore oil & gas EPC projects, particularly offshore platforms, to support structural design, 3D modelling, and detailing activities. Candidates should have strong proficiency in S3D (Smart 3D) and relevant experience with offshore topsides and jacket structures.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Prepare structural arrangement, general arrangement (GA), detailed, and fabrication drawings for offshore oil & gas projects.
  • Develop and maintain 3D structural models using S3D (Smart 3D), TEKLA, E3D, PDMS, or equivalent software.
  • Perform structural modelling and design detailing for offshore platforms, including topsides, jackets, decks, and associated structures.
  • Prepare and update structural drawings, incorporating engineering markups, design changes, and project requirements.
  • Coordinate with structural engineers and other disciplines to ensure model accuracy and resolve design-related issues.
  • Participate in 3D model reviews, clash detection, and interdisciplinary design coordination.
  • Prepare material take-offs (MTOs), bills of materials (BOMs), and other structural design deliverables as required.
  • Ensure structural drawings and models comply with project specifications, applicable standards, and quality requirements.
  • Support the preparation of engineering deliverables for FEED, detailed engineering, and EPC projects, as applicable.
  • Maintain accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery of assigned structural design outputs.

KEY QUALIFICATIONS

  • Diploma or bachelor's degree in Engineering, Drafting, or an equivalent qualification, as required by the JD.
  • Minimum years of relevant experience as specified in the JD, with substantial hands-on experience in offshore structural design and drafting.
  • Proven experience in offshore oil & gas EPC projects, particularly offshore platforms.
  • Strong proficiency in S3D (Smart 3D) for structural 3D modelling and design detailing.
  • Additional knowledge of TEKLA, E3D, SACS, PDMS, or equivalent tools, as required by the JD.
  • Good understanding of offshore structural components, including jackets, topsides, decks, modules, and associated steel structures.
  • Experience in structural drawings, fabrication detailing, material take-offs, and interdisciplinary coordination.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, design markups, and project standards.
  • Strong coordination, communication, and teamwork skills.

VERTICAL

ENGINEERING

This is a remote position.

Summary

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer - Maritime Optimization

Level: Senior; 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

Clearance: Ability to obtain a clearance

Work Location Type: Remote, United States

Work Type: Full-time, benefits

Agency name: US Navy


BizFirst is assisting our client with recruiting a Senior Software Engineer - Maritime Optimization. This hands-on software engineering role will develop maritime route optimization, vessel performance modeling, and voyage analysis capabilities for U.S. Government and defense customers. You will refine optimization algorithms, translate vessel performance and fuel-consumption models into software, and build simulation and evaluation tools that make route recommendations clear and explainable.

Our client is an ocean technology company that designs, builds, and deploys marine sensors and combines oceanographic and underwater acoustic sensing with data and software. Its capabilities help commercial customers increase efficiency and reduce emissions, while helping government and defense stakeholders understand ocean conditions, maritime activity, and remote environments. The company has more than a decade of Navy research partnerships and is expanding its established capabilities into funded federal programs.

What will you do

You will work on maritime route optimization, vessel performance modeling, and voyage analysis capabilities for U.S. Government and defense customers. This is a hands-on software engineering role working directly on software that models vessel performance and evaluates candidate maritime routes. Depending on the problem, you may refine optimization algorithms, translate vessel performance and fuel-consumption models into software, build simulation and evaluation tooling, or improve how route recommendations are scored and explained.

Responsibilities

Develop maritime voyage optimization and route evaluation capabilities.

Model vessel performance and fuel consumption across varying operating and environmental conditions.

Account for voyage constraints, transit time, fuel efficiency, and operational considerations in route recommendations.

Improve optimization algorithms and the software that supports them.

Build simulation and evaluation capabilities to understand optimizer behavior and route quality.

Produce clear, explainable results that allow users to understand and evaluate optimization recommendations.

Collaborate with engineers, product experts, and maritime domain specialists to translate real-world problems into practical software solutions.

Work across high- and low-level languages, including Rust and Python, contributing to algorithms, models, services, APIs, testing, and related software components.

Contribute to existing technology and new software developed for government maritime applications as these capabilities evolve.

Requirements

5+ years of professional software engineering experience.

Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience contributing to production software.

Experience with Python and/or a compiled language such as Rust, C++, C, or similar.

Comfort working with algorithms, data structures, and computational problems.

Ability to translate domain or mathematical concepts into maintainable, testable software.

Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset when working across engineering and domain disciplines.

Comfort working on software supporting U.S. Government and Department of Defense customers. Previous defense experience is not required.

Maritime route optimization experience is not required. Relevant experience may come from robotics, logistics, aerospace, autonomy, transportation, scientific computing, operations research, simulation, or other domains involving optimization of physical systems.

Preferred Qualifications

A degree in physics or a related technical field.

Experience developing optimization, modeling, or simulation software for real-world systems.

Maritime or naval domain experience.

Previous experience supporting U.S. Government or Department of Defense customers.

A personal connection to or passion for the oceans.

Work Authorization and Clearance

U.S. citizenship required.

Must be able to successfully pass a background check.

Ability to obtain a security clearance; specific level TBD.

An Equal Opportunity Employer

Our Client Benefits

Competitive base pay plus equity.

Medical, dental and vision coverage.

Continued learning and development stipend.

One-time home office stipend for remote team members.

Relocation bonus for team members moving to the Bay Area.

Flexible PTO, in addition to 10 company-wide office closure days; the last week of December off for everyone.

12 weeks of parental leave, plus 4 additional weeks for birthing parents.

Military leave and job protection for reservists and guard members under USERRA.

Annual company onsite week and team events throughout the year.

raw.excerpt: About Nebius:Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy.
raw.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

We're looking for a Lead Technical Project Manager for Network Infrastructure. This is not a "make slides, chase tickets, and ask engineers for status" job. It is a role for someone with an engineering skeleton: a person who has built, operated, broken and recovered things, and can earn trust in a room full of SREs, SWEs, network engineers, security and platform teams. We are at the early stage of our APAC expansion, so you will work with a high degree of independence, set up the project management practices for the region from scratch, and stay close to the technical details yourself.

The "T" matters. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every area, but you should be technical enough to understand real trade-offs: why rollback is not optional, why "just automate it" can create a bigger blast radius, why a provisioning flow must survive real-world constraints, why SLOs without ownership are decoration, and why network device CI/CD is very different from deploying a stateless service. You can read a design doc, challenge missing assumptions, notice unclear failure modes, ask sharp questions, and turn a vague but important problem into an executable plan.

The "P" is project delivery with a product mindset, even if the product is internal infrastructure. Your product may be a site bootstrap kit, secrets and robot-user management, an SLO framework, a firmware rollout process, a network observability platform, CI/CD for network devices, or automation that makes day-0 and day-N operations safe. The job is not done when the technical pieces exist. It is done when engineers trust the tool, the NOC actually uses the workflow, alerts are actionable, runbooks are real, and the new way becomes the default way. That means adoption, communication, documentation, feedback loops, and sometimes a bit of internal "marketing": the ability to convince smart technical people that the thing is worth using.

The "M" is management of execution, not people management. You will not be responsible for engineers' careers, performance reviews or promotions. You will be responsible for making important cross-team initiatives land: defining scope, aligning owners, exposing risks, driving decisions, tracking dependencies, creating clarity where things are unclear, and making sure we ship useful outcomes instead of collecting half-finished initiatives.

This is a high-leverage role in a early-stage and fast-scaling network infrastructure organisation. Many important systems are being built now: automation, observability, reliability standards, provisioning flows, operational safety, and cross-site consistency. You won't be maintaining a mature machine from the sidelines. You'll help shape how the machine works.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own end-to-end delivery of cross-team network infrastructure initiatives in APAC, from a vague problem statement to an executable plan to adoption
  • Define scope and success criteria, align owners across SRE, SWE, network, security, platform and data center teams, and drive decisions to closure
  • Review designs and technical proposals, challenge missing assumptions, and surface failure modes, dependencies and risks early
  • Track dependencies and risks across teams and time zones, and keep stakeholders, including the European teams, informed with clear, honest status
  • Drive adoption: make sure tools and workflows become the default way of working, with real documentation, runbooks and feedback loops
  • Establish and run lightweight, effective project management practices for the region: planning, prioritization, reviews, and post-launch follow-up
  • Work with regional teams and external partners (vendors, carriers) on the rollout of new network capabilities
  • Turn operational pain and engineering input into a clear, prioritized backlog

We expect you to have:

  • 7+ years of experience in technical project management, engineering management or a hands-on engineering role (SRE, SWE, network or infrastructure), with a track record of delivering complex cross-team infrastructure projects
  • A real engineering background: you have built and operated production systems and can earn the trust of deeply technical teams
  • Ability to read design docs and technical proposals, understand trade-offs, and ask sharp questions about reliability, rollback, blast radius and failure modes
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure fundamentals (Linux, networking, automation, CI/CD) at the level needed to hold your own in technical discussions
  • Proven ability to drive decisions and create clarity in ambiguous, fast-changing environments without formal authority
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including documenting plans and decisions and influencing smart technical people
  • Ability to work independently in an early-stage environment and to build processes from scratch
  • Professional working proficiency in English (spoken and written) and comfort working across time zones

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience with network infrastructure: network automation, observability, or network device lifecycle management
  • Experience with SLO/SLI frameworks, incident management, or production readiness processes
  • Experience with CI/CD or change management for network or other high-blast-radius infrastructure
  • Experience delivering projects with distributed teams across APAC time zones
  • Experience with secrets and access management, firmware rollout or fleet-wide operational initiatives
  • Hands-on engineering contributions (scripts, tooling, automation) alongside project work

Examples of initiatives you may own:

  • A user and secrets management system for network infrastructure, including robot-user lifecycle, safe key/password rotation, revocation, break-glass access, mixed agent/push-based device support, and integration with existing secrets backends
  • An SLO framework for network services and components, including SLIs, SLOs, dashboards, alerts, ownership, tiering, and a clear link between reliability targets and engineering investment
  • CI/CD for network devices, where configuration changes, validation, staged rollout, rollback, and blast-radius control become disciplined and repeatable instead of manual and risky
  • Fleet-wide operational initiatives such as firmware consistency, device lifecycle hygiene, observability coverage, monitoring quality, alert ownership, or production readiness for new network capabilities

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

raw.title: Fraud Specialist, Supplier Operations & Governance
raw.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
raw.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Fraud Specialist, Supplier Operations & Governance (P4).

About the job

We are actively recruiting for this role to fill an existing vacancy. This position will be responsible for working constructively with our customers and partners to resolve billing issues and fraudulent misuse of services.

We are seeking a sharp, highly data-oriented, and tenacious Fraud Specialist to join our team. Unlike a traditional billing or collections role focused on routine outreach or simple invoice review, this position is a hybrid of financial investigation, root cause analysis, and strategic dispute negotiation. In this role, you will look for billing discrepancies, investigate Artificially Inflated Traffic (AIT) or IRSF (International Revenue Share Fraud), dig deep into messaging and call data, project manage high-value customer and vendor disputes, and build data-backed cases to resolve discrepancies. You will build dashboards to communicate key metrics and drive action. If you love solving complex data puzzles, negotiating with external parties, and finding win-win outcomes, this is the role for you.

You will be part of a company that is the category leader in Communications Platform as a Service (CPaaS), an organization working with the largest customers and partners, and a team of operators and former consultants that have delivered exceptional impact. If you have an extreme owner / founder mindset and a desire to solve big challenges, you’ll find yourself at home.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Advise account managers, accounting, and management on best practices to handle billing disputes
  • Negotiate with customers and carriers with an understanding of resolution levers available as per contractual terms and industry norms
  • Identify, analyze, and handle fraudulent misuse (such as Artificially Inflated Traffic) and billing errors (such as rate differences) with both vendors and customers
  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer and vendor disputes from intake of disputes to initiating disputes, tracking progress, and ensuring timely, documented resolution
  • Uncover and resolve discrepancies, overcharges, and unpaid balances with carriers and customers due to quantities, rates, currency, and other root causes
  • Dig into call and messaging data to identify why bills don’t match or find evidence of fraud
  • Build dashboards that communicate key metrics related to the lifecycle of disputes
  • Read contracts and interpret what should be the invoice versus what it is
  • Act as the primary point of contact to negotiate dispute resolutions, settlements, and payment terms in accordance with company practices
  • Partner closely with data analytics, engineering, and accounting to reconcile accounts

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in telecom operations, fraud operations, customer success, vendor management, procurement, collections, or consulting.
  • Sharp written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience negotiating disputes constructively with customers or vendors.
  • Experience in collections, dispute resolution, or billing analysis.
  • Experience in project management.
  • Experience wrangling data with Excel / Google Sheets, Looker or SQL.

Desired:

  • Understanding of the A2P SMS ecosystem, international traffic routing, international revenue share fraud (IRSF), artificially inflated traffic (AIT) and the ecosystem profit chains.
  • Understanding of industry standards with respect to AIT and fraud handling such as frameworks from i3forum, GSMA, MEF or ITW Global Leaders’ Forum.
  • Understanding of Call Detail Records (CDRs) and ability to build strong dispute case files.
  • Experience working with workflow platforms like Airtable or building dashboards.
  • Experience in telecom, technology, or consulting industries.
  • Experience with advanced data analysis like Python or scripting
  • Experience with AI and automation tools to accelerate productivity.

Location

This role will be remote and based in Ontario, British Columbia or Alberta, Canada.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Based on role, employees may also be eligible for additional compensation and benefits, including but not limited to incentive programs, commissions, equity grants, health and wellness benefits, retirement contributions, and paid time off.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • 90,800.00 - CAD 113,500.00
  • Target Bonus Percentage 15%

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

Our European activities are growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a full-time, home-based Regulatory Submissions Coordinator & Contract Specialist (Dual role) to join our Clinical Operations team, in Serbia.

As a Regulatory Submissions Coordinator & Contract Specialist (Dual role) you will have the opportunity to work within Regulatory Submissions and contract negotiations, supporting our many projects. You will be a productive member of the team and will be mentored and supported as you develop your skills. Working directly with Regulatory Submissions Coordinators and Contract Specialists, you will gain valuable hands-on experience to enable you to develop a career in clinical research.


Responsibilities

  • Prepare, review, and file initial clinical trial applications to regulatory authorities and Ethics committees in Serbia and Croatia;
  • Prepare and submit responses to queries and amendments to clinical trial applications;
  • Ensure submissions comply with applicable regulations and guidance documents;
  • Advise team members on changing regulations and compliance requirements;
  • Maintain the Clinical Trial Management System and ensure timely filing of documents;
  • Collection of essential documents and preparation essential documents packages for drug release;
  • Drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and finalizing agreements, termination letters or other legal documents required for a clinical study;
  • Identify and assesses legal, financial, and operational risks and escalate to appropriate Contract Lead or Contract Manager;
  • Provide recommendations and alternative resolutions throughout negotiations using established escalation channels;
  • Coordinate with internal functional departments to ensure various site startup activities are aligned with contractual process and mutually agreed up timelines.

Qualifications

  • A minimum of a Bachelor's degree is required (preferably in a Life Sciences field or Law);
  • Experience preparing, reviewing, and submitting regulatory documentation to Ethics Committees and Regulatory Agencies; including formulating responses to queries;
  • Relevant working experience at a CRO, Pharmaceutical Company, or an investigative site;
  • Knowledge of local regulatory guidelines and legislation;
  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills;
  • Use to work independently with a proactive approach;
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office;
  • Fluency in Serbian/ Croatian and English; and
  • Great attention to detail and excellent oral and written communication skills.

We kindly ask to submit applications in English.



Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.


Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Purpose-Driven Work

    • Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

Collaborative Culture

    • Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
    • Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

Continuous Growth & Development

    • Office based environment with on-site mentors
    • Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
    • Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
    • Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
    • An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

    • Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
    • Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
    • Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
    • Company-sponsored social events

Please note benefits may vary based on country.

What to Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

What we’re looking for...

Using your sound judgment, you quickly grasp the details of a situation and know just the right next step. Inspiring and developing a team to achieve great results is personally rewarding for you. Even better if you have one or more of the following:

Position: VP of Campaigns

Department: Advocacy, Strategic Programs

Reports to: Executive Chief of Staff

Supervises: Director of Organizing

FLSA Status: Exempt, Full-Time

Union Status: Not eligible for the bargaining unit

Location: Remote, near a major airport; See below for more

Salary: $146,000 - $163,000

About Us

Advocates for Trans Equality fights for the legal and political rights of transgender people in America. Leveraging decades of experience on the frontlines of power, we shift government and society towards a future where we are no less than equal. Founded in 2024, Advocates for Trans Equality was formed through an alliance by two national trans advocacy organizations and is of, for, and by the trans community. Advocates for Trans Equality (501c4) and Advocates for Trans Equality Education Fund (501c3) focuses its efforts on political and legal advocacy, public education, and community engagement. The Advocates for Trans Equality team catalyzes progress from the inside out and will settle for nothing less than equality for trans people in America. Advocates for Trans Equality and Advocates for Trans Equality Education Fund are incorporated in Washington, DC with offices in DC and New York and employ approximately 40 dedicated staff who share office space and work across the country.

Position Summary

The Vice President of Campaigns is responsible for developing, managing and executing state and federal ballot measure, public education, and advocacy campaigns in partnership with departments of Policy, Legal, Organizing, and Public Education.

The Vice President of Campaigns creates campaign engagement criteria, conducts campaign assessments, and makes recommendations about A4TE’s priorities and investments. They also coordinate A4TE’s cross-team engagement in campaigns, monitor and keep the full team regularly appraised on developments, and serve as the lead on priority campaigns as needed.

Duties and Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop a thoughtful, strategic, coordinated campaign and ballot strategy on behalf of A4TE to address urgent, emerging ballot measures at the state level that have the potential to significantly impact transgender people in the 2026-2028 electoral cycles and beyond.
  • Work with A4TE leadership to execute A4TE’s ballot strategy in a manner to ensure such efforts are compliant with all applicable federal, state, and local laws and to protect the charitable statuses of A4TE and A4TEEF.
  • Serve as A4TE’s primary external contact and thought partner to LGBTQ+ movement partner organizations for coordination around advocacy strategy tactics influencing ballot issue work and electoral engagement, among other areas of advocacy.
  • Manage, cultivate, and inspire the leadership of the Organizing Director, who oversees A4TE’s organizing team. Support the transition of such organizing from predominantly mobilization techniques to deeper field organizing work in service of state needs, particularly around ballot issues. Support GOTV educational work as part of overall campaign strategy.
  • Support coordination of A4TE’s work on ballot measures impacting trans people, including how that work intersects with the work of other national partners. Serve as the primary A4TE representative working to support efforts in defeating anti-trans ballot measures in 2026 and beyond.
  • Oversee federal and state public education and advocacy campaigns, including creating and maintaining assessment criteria to determine priority campaigns and engagement in rapid response contexts, making recommendations about A4TE’s priorities and investments, developing and implementing successful strategies, advising and supporting organizational partners, and coordinating A4TE’s cross-team engagement in campaigns.
  • Keep A4TE team regularly apprised of developments on campaign-specific public education and advocacy efforts.
  • Work with consultants, lobbyists, organizational partners, and state and local leaders to help defeat discriminatory anti-trans ballot measures and advance pro-trans ballot measures. Determine and recommend prioritization of such campaigns and what role A4TE should serve in such campaigns, if any.
  • Manage, support, and ensure accountability of campaign consultants, including both existing teams and the cultivation of new consultant teams in states where work is not currently underway.
  • Contribute to fundraising efforts necessary to raise capital for campaign activities.
  • Work with the Organizing, Policy, Strategic Communications, and Public Education departments to drive public education and advocacy victories.
  • Travel to campaign sites as needed.
  • Work cross departmentally to ensure the effective delivery of latest messaging and research to legislative leaders, organizational partners, key constituencies, and allies.

Required Qualifications

A4TE Education Fund acknowledges that applicants from communities that have been historically marginalized are less likely to apply for positions unless they feel that they completely meet all qualifications listed in a job description. We understand that an ideal candidate might not completely meet the criteria listed above or be equally proficient in each area; we especially encourage applicants who are impacted by A4TE’s work to submit their application anyway.

  • Leadership Experience: A minimum of 6 years of experience in a leadership role. Demonstrated management experience, including the ability to coach team members using tested management techniques, emotional intelligence, and good judgement.
  • Ballot Experience: A strong working knowledge of and demonstrated success in advancing ballot campaigns. Deep understanding of how policy, legal, organizing, communications, fundraising, messaging, compliance, and other interests intersect within a given ballot campaign, and demonstrated ability to strategically coordinate these elements.
  • Compliance Experience: A working knowledge of 501(c)(3), 501(c)(4), PAC, and ballot legal compliance. Demonstrated ability to pull in experts, partners and/or legal counsel when necessary to support organizational compliance efforts. Ability to exhibit good judgement for advancing complex and legally compliant strategies to successfully engage in ballot campaign work.
  • Political Experience: A strong working knowledge of the role politics plays within an overarching advocacy framework, including familiarity with campaign cycles, partisanship, and the role of politics in moving the Overton Window on a given issue.
  • Organizational Experience: Direct experience with diverse social justice, government, organizing, and/or movement building organizations. Demonstrated ability to bring partners with diverse missions together around a common goal.
  • Understanding of Transgender Justice: A deep and nuanced understanding of issues affecting transgender people as well as an understanding of how racism, classism, sexism, and other systems of inter-connected oppressions affect trans people. Strong belief in A4TE’s mission and the people who are driving the work forward. A strong commitment and desire to moving the Overton Window on trans issues over the next 5-10 years.
  • Communication Skills: Effective verbal and written skills to communicate complex policies and procedures to ensure staff have the information needed for their position responsibilities and overall organizational workflow; ability to listen to staff concerns and feedback to assist in working together for solutions that comply with organizational policies. Ability to understand organizational needs to communicate with those outside of the organization.
  • Technological Knowledge: Experience in all areas of MS Office 365 and collaborative tools, such as Slack, Asana, and Zoom. Experience with policy software, such as PolicyNote, BillTracker50, or similar product. Experience with organizing and campaign tools, such as NGP VAN, EveryAction, or similar products.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • Leadership Experience: 6-8 years’ experience in a management role, such as a Field Director, Campaign Director or Political Director
  • Campaign Experience: 8-10 years’ experience in traditional field organizing, preferably in ballot measures, advocacy campaigns, or political campaigns.
  • Geographic Location: Remote but located near a major airport. Based in the Midwest, South, Southwest, or Central United States, which are areas most impacted and forecasted to be impacted by anti-trans state policies and ballot campaigns. Ability and willingness to travel to states where field and campaign organizing support is necessary.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluency or proficiency in a language other than English, especially Spanish.
  • Technological Knowledge: Experience in using FileVine, FiscalNote, or other legal and policy database tools.

Traits of Successful Candidates

  • Trustworthy & Collaborative: Excellent relationship and trust building capabilities and a demonstrated track record building, leading, and managing teams; serving as a coach and mentor to staff across a range of areas. An earned reputation for being trustworthy, with excellent judgment and discretion. Kindness and strengths-based leadership: someone who sees value in every person and communicates respect and encouragement to people at all levels; a passionate investment in the well-being and success of staff. A willingness to accept input and feedback from colleagues at all levels of the organization.
  • Responsive Problem-Solving Skills: Agile project management skills, ability to develop and implement new strategies and procedures, and meet multiple competing deadlines.
  • Self-Direction: Initiative and ambition to ensure that all projects are moving forward. Ability to adapt as needed, self-manage, and prioritize between and manage multiple demands.
  • Optimism: A positive and productive attitude to problem-solving within the context of intense social justice work. Optimistic and resourceful, with strong self-awareness, cultural competence, emotional intelligence, and humility; grounded and flexible with a high degree of integrity and transparency.
  • Strength and Persistence: The ability to be exposed to transphobia and other kinds of discrimination or stress on a daily basis and keep fighting hard for transgender equality.

Salary & Benefits

Salary for this role is between $146,000 - $163,000.

Advocates for Trans Equality offers a robust benefits package that includes 100% employer-paid medical, vision, dental, and life insurance; 75% employer contributions to spousal and dependent healthcare; employer contributions to retirement plan; monthly remote work stipends; access to gender-affirming healthcare pool; name and identity document change support; generous time off, including paid holidays, 20 paid vacation days annually, sick time, and office-wide closures; medical and parental leaves; weekly wellness hours; volunteer hours; 3-month paid sabbatical after 5 years; healthcare flex spending account; and professional development stipend.

Salary: $146,000 – $163,000 / year

Summary

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer - Maritime Optimization

Level: Senior; 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

Clearance: Ability to obtain a clearance

Work Location Type: Remote, United States

Work Type: Full-time, benefits

Agency name: US Navy


BizFirst is assisting our client with recruiting a Senior Software Engineer - Maritime Optimization. This hands-on software engineering role will develop maritime route optimization, vessel performance modeling, and voyage analysis capabilities for U.S. Government and defense customers. You will refine optimization algorithms, translate vessel performance and fuel-consumption models into software, and build simulation and evaluation tools that make route recommendations clear and explainable.

Our client is an ocean technology company that designs, builds, and deploys marine sensors and combines oceanographic and underwater acoustic sensing with data and software. Its capabilities help commercial customers increase efficiency and reduce emissions, while helping government and defense stakeholders understand ocean conditions, maritime activity, and remote environments. The company has more than a decade of Navy research partnerships and is expanding its established capabilities into funded federal programs.

What will you do

You will work on maritime route optimization, vessel performance modeling, and voyage analysis capabilities for U.S. Government and defense customers. This is a hands-on software engineering role working directly on software that models vessel performance and evaluates candidate maritime routes. Depending on the problem, you may refine optimization algorithms, translate vessel performance and fuel-consumption models into software, build simulation and evaluation tooling, or improve how route recommendations are scored and explained.

Responsibilities

Develop maritime voyage optimization and route evaluation capabilities.

Model vessel performance and fuel consumption across varying operating and environmental conditions.

Account for voyage constraints, transit time, fuel efficiency, and operational considerations in route recommendations.

Improve optimization algorithms and the software that supports them.

Build simulation and evaluation capabilities to understand optimizer behavior and route quality.

Produce clear, explainable results that allow users to understand and evaluate optimization recommendations.

Collaborate with engineers, product experts, and maritime domain specialists to translate real-world problems into practical software solutions.

Work across high- and low-level languages, including Rust and Python, contributing to algorithms, models, services, APIs, testing, and related software components.

Contribute to existing technology and new software developed for government maritime applications as these capabilities evolve.

Requirements

5+ years of professional software engineering experience.

Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience contributing to production software.

Experience with Python and/or a compiled language such as Rust, C++, C, or similar.

Comfort working with algorithms, data structures, and computational problems.

Ability to translate domain or mathematical concepts into maintainable, testable software.

Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset when working across engineering and domain disciplines.

Comfort working on software supporting U.S. Government and Department of Defense customers. Previous defense experience is not required.

Maritime route optimization experience is not required. Relevant experience may come from robotics, logistics, aerospace, autonomy, transportation, scientific computing, operations research, simulation, or other domains involving optimization of physical systems.

Preferred Qualifications

A degree in physics or a related technical field.

Experience developing optimization, modeling, or simulation software for real-world systems.

Maritime or naval domain experience.

Previous experience supporting U.S. Government or Department of Defense customers.

A personal connection to or passion for the oceans.

Work Authorization and Clearance

U.S. citizenship required.

Must be able to successfully pass a background check.

Ability to obtain a security clearance; specific level TBD.

An Equal Opportunity Employer

Our Client Benefits

Competitive base pay plus equity.

Medical, dental and vision coverage.

Continued learning and development stipend.

One-time home office stipend for remote team members.

Relocation bonus for team members moving to the Bay Area.

Flexible PTO, in addition to 10 company-wide office closure days; the last week of December off for everyone.

12 weeks of parental leave, plus 4 additional weeks for birthing parents.

Military leave and job protection for reservists and guard members under USERRA.

Annual company onsite week and team events throughout the year.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR


The Staff Attorney will support the Chief Legal Officer, Associate General Counsel, Senior Managing Director of Legal Affairs, and overall Legal Affairs team with the Academy’s day-to-day transactional needs. Utilizing your excellent judgment, team collaboration skills, and commitment to the highest level of honesty, fidelity and integrity, you will provide legal advice to the Academy and its affiliates on a range of contracts.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Draft, review and negotiate commercial contracts covering a range of Academy and affiliate activities, including vendor and services agreements, programming, events, licensing, technology and new initiatives under development.
  • Advise business teams on contract interpretation and obligations, explaining legal issues to non-lawyers in a digestible manner.
  • Issue spot and quickly assess when to escalate matters to more senior members of the Legal Affairs department.
  • Work with the team to streamline contract processes from commencement to conclusion, including maintaining contract playbooks and using technology to standardize processes.
  • Maintain organized records of executed contracts and related documents.
  • Collaborate intra- and inter-departmentally to maintain appropriate contract templates for business team use.
  • Assist with implementing and updating Academy and affiliate policies and procedures to ensure compliance and efficient administration of resources.
  • Stay informed about legal developments relevant to the Academy’s and its affiliates’ business operations.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school.
  • License to practice law (or ability to become licensed) in state of residence.
  • 2-3 years’ experience practicing transactional law at an established law firm and/or in-house in a corporate legal or business affairs department.
  • Experience advising on music and entertainment business matters strongly preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including an established track record of superior legal draftsmanship and negotiation, and the demonstrated ability to conclude matters efficiently and beneficially for the client.
  • Must be a forward-thinking individual with sound, practical, and business-minded judgment including the ability to “think outside of the box,” come up with intelligent solutions to problems, master new technologies utilized to streamline contract systems, and assess and explain the business and legal impact of alternative options.
  • Ability to work well both independently and as part of a greater team, moving projects forward diligently and proactively.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS FOR CERTAIN ROLES

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit for long periods of time, and work at a computer for long periods of time.

SALARY AND BENEFITS

The starting salary for this position is $95,600 to $106,500 per year, benchmarked against industry standards. Salaries for positions required to be in specific geographic locations reflect the corresponding labor market.

The actual offer extended will depend on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and the role's requirements. Positions working 20+ hours per week also receive our comprehensive benefits package (with medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401k match, generous paid time off, and more). Click here for an overview of our company benefits.

Explore our career opportunities to join a team that values creativity, innovation, and diversity.

ABOUT THE RECORDING ACADEMY AND ITS AFFILIATES

RECORDING ACADEMY

The Recording Academy represents the voices of performers, songwriters, producers, engineers, and all music professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the recording arts remain a thriving part of our shared cultural heritage, the Academy honors music's history while investing in its future through the Grammy Museum, advocates on behalf of music creators, supports music people in times of need through MusiCares, and celebrates artistic excellence through the Grammy Awards—music's only peer-recognized accolade and highest achievement. As the world's leading society of music professionals, we work year-round to foster a more inspiring world for creators.

LATIN RECORDING ACADEMY

The Latin Recording Academy is an international, membership-based organization comprised of Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking recording artists, musicians, songwriters, producers and other creative and technical recording professionals. The organization is dedicated to improving the quality of life and cultural condition for Latin music and its makers. In addition to producing the Latin Grammy Awards to honor excellence in the recorded arts and sciences, The Latin Recording Academy provides educational and outreach programs for the Latin music community either directly or through its Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation.

LATIN GRAMMY CULTURAL FOUNDATION

The Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation is a charitable organization established by the Latin Recording Academy in 2014. The organization is dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of Latin music creators through scholarships, educational programs, grants, and access to creators and industry executives.

MUSICARES

A friend and ally of the music community, MusiCares was established by the Recording Academy to safeguard the health and well-being of all music people. A four-star charity and safety net in times of need, MusiCares offers confidential preventative, recovery, and emergency programs to address financial, medical, and personal health issues. Through the generosity of our donors and volunteer professionals, our dedicated team works across the country to ensure the music community has the resources and support it needs.

GRAMMY MUSEUM

The Grammy Museum is a nonprofit organization dedicated to celebrating and exploring music from yesterday and today to inspire the music of tomorrow through music preservation, education, exhibitions, and public programming and aims to create a world in which shared love of music sparks curiosity, creativity, and community. Programs include Grammy in the Schools education programs that are offered year-round for students, teachers, and schools throughout the United States.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

The Recording Academy, its affiliates, and the music industry have a strong culture of inclusion and respect for everyone. The Recording Academy makes intentional, courageous, and principled decisions for stronger business outcomes and ensures that all creators and professionals live and work in a fair and safe environment. It is the Recording Academy's policy to provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees. The Recording Academy does not discriminate on the basis of race (nor traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, religion (including religious dress and grooming), creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), national origin, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law. The Recording Academy will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship to the Recording Academy. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including selection, job assignment, compensation, promotion, discipline, termination, access to benefits and training, recruitment, hiring, transfer, and social and recreational programs.

About airSlate

airSlate is a global SaaS technology company that develops no-code workflow automation, electronic signature, and document management solutions. Our award-winning products - SignNow, pdfFiller, DocHub, altaFlow, Instapage, and US Legal Forms - serve over hundreds of millions of users and more than one million customers worldwide, helping organizations of every size digitize processes, improve efficiency, and transform how they work.
We’re in an exciting phase of growth and transformation, with teammates in more than 20 countries across three continents and main hubs in the United States, Poland, Ukraine and Philippines.
At airSlate, we’re building value for customers and a culture where growth and innovation go hand in hand. We’re looking for people eager to shape products, scale a company, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.

About the SignNow team

We are a passionate and ambitious team of 100+ people on a mission to succeed with our award-winning signature solution. SignNow empowers over 28 million people worldwide to move fast with everything they need to send and e-sign documents.
Now, we're looking to reimagine digital agreement workflows and build the next generation of SignNow through AI-native experiences.

About the role

As a Principal AI Product Manager, you will play a founding role in shaping SignNow 2.0, rethinking how customers prepare, execute, and manage digital agreements through intelligent, agentic experiences.
This isn't about simply adding AI features to an existing product. It's about identifying meaningful customer problems, challenging existing workflows, and creating fundamentally better experiences while maintaining the trust, transparency, and control customers expect from signNow.
This is a hands-on, entrepreneurial builder role with end-to-end product ownership, high autonomy, and the opportunity to shape the next generation of our product, backed by the scale, resources, and customer base of an established global company.
You'll work closely with engineering, design, data, and GTM teams to turn ambitious ideas into real customer value, validate solutions early, iterate quickly, and deliver measurable business impact.

What you will be working on:

  • Product vision & strategy: Define and execute the product vision and roadmap for AI-native agreement experiences, balancing near-term customer value with long-term strategic opportunities.

  • End-to-end product development: Own the full product lifecycle, from problem discovery and opportunity validation to prototyping, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

  • AI-native experiences: Reimagine existing workflows and build intelligent, agentic experiences that solve meaningful customer problems, with a focus on reliability, transparency, and user control.

  • AI product & technical leadership: Define clear product requirements, working closely with engineering to evaluate technical trade-offs, ensure quality, and enable scalable execution.

  • Customer & market discovery: Proactively engage customers, uncover and simplify complex problems, identify market opportunities, and validate hypotheses through research, experimentation, and hands-on prototyping.

  • Business impact: Prioritize initiatives based on customer value, adoption, revenue potential, and ROI. Define success metrics and use evidence to drive product decisions.

  • Strategic influence & alignment: Turn complex ideas into clear, compelling product narratives, build alignment across stakeholders, and drive decisions that connect immediate opportunities with long-term direction.

  • Entrepreneurial execution: Take ownership, challenge assumptions, proactively remove blockers, and move quickly from ideas to measurable outcomes.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of end-to-end product management experience in high-growth or large-scale B2B/B2C SaaS companies.

  • Proven product ownership: Experience independently identifying new product opportunities and leading products or major initiatives from concept to launch and measurable business impact.

  • AI product expertise: Hands-on experience shipping AI-powered products, with strong product judgment around LLM capabilities, agentic workflows, quality evaluation, reliability, cost, and performance trade-offs.

  • Strong product discovery and problem-solving skills: Proven ability to proactively engage customers, uncover and simplify complex problems, validate opportunities, and translate insights into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.

  • Strategic product thinking: Ability to identify market opportunities, develop a differentiated product point of view, make clear prioritization decisions, and connect short-term execution with long-term strategy.

  • Exceptional strategic communication and influence: Ability to turn complex ideas into clear, compelling product narratives, build alignment, and drive decisions across technical and business stakeholders.

  • Strong technical fluency: Ability to work effectively with engineering, understand architectural implications, evaluate trade-offs, and define technically feasible product requirements. Strong analytical understanding of product metrics, experimentation, and instrumentation.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset and high ownership: Comfortable with ambiguity, challenging existing approaches, taking initiative, and moving independently from ideas to execution.

  • Hands-on and experimental approach: Willingness to personally explore emerging technologies, prototype ideas, test assumptions, and continuously learn.

Nice to Have

  • Experience founding a startup, building independent products, or leading entrepreneurial initiatives, including ventures that didn't succeed.

  • Experience developing AI-native products or agentic workflows.

  • Experience with B2B workflow automation, document processing, or agreement management.

  • Experience with hands-on prototyping using AI development tools.

Sounds like a match? Apply and let’s explore how we can build impactful AI-powered products together.

What we offer

Flexible working environment - Our teams operate across the globe. We value in‑person collaboration in our hubs, but we also embrace remote and hybrid working. You can work from one of our offices in the United States, Poland, Romania or Ukraine, or remotely from many countries.
Competitive compensation and stock options - We offer salaries that reflect local market conditions and experience, plus a performance-based bonus system and stock options so you share in the company’s growth.
Professional growth and learning - We invest in your development through courses, conferences, and access to learning resources. We encourage career growth and internal mobility, supporting teammates who want to explore new opportunities within airSlate.
Health and well‑being - We provide comprehensive benefits tailored to each country, including health coverage, wellness programmes and access to fitness options. We also dedicate quarterly company-wide Mental Health Days, when everyone takes time off to rest and recharge.
Family‑friendly culture - Family life is part of who we are, and we embrace it in many forms. From flexibility for parents to our airSlate Junior Club for kids, to company-wide family days and our pet-friendly approach, we’re committed to making work and life easier to balance.
Giving back - We support charitable initiatives around the world through the airSlate Care programme. Our current focus includes humanitarian aid in Ukraine and other regions, matching employee donations and supporting causes chosen by our teams.
Open communication - We encourage transparent dialogue at all levels. From team discussions to company-wide Q&A sessions with our CEO, we make sure everyone has the chance to be heard and to influence how we grow.

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

About Grafana Labs:

There are more than 700,000 active installations of Grafana around the globe, monitoring everything from beehives to climate change in the Alps. The instantly recognizable dashboards have been spotted everywhere from a SpaceX launch and Minecraft HQ to Wimbledon and the Tour de France. Grafana Labs also helps companies including Bloomberg, JPMorgan Chase, and eBay manage their observability strategies with full-stack offerings that can be run fully managed with Grafana Cloud, or self-managed with Grafana Enterprise Stack. The Grafana stack has grown to include more open-source projects, including Grafana Loki (for logs) and Grafana Tempo (for traces) and Grafana Mimir (for metrics).

Description of Duties

We’re looking for a Staff Technical Writer to create documentation and learning content that helps people adopt and master Grafana’s observability products. You’ll work with engineers, product managers, and the Grafana writing team to produce content for a range of products and audiences, from first-time users to experienced practitioners. Because our products and priorities evolve, we’re looking for someone who learns new technical domains quickly.

AI is part of how this team works. We use AI-assisted workflows and tools throughout the content lifecycle, from research and drafting to review, validation, and maintenance. You’ll use these tools every day and help the team get better at using them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, research, write, and maintain documentation and learning content (concepts, tasks, tutorials, references, and in-product learning) that supports adoption and long-term product mastery.
  • Use AI tools and workflows to work faster and at a higher quality: drafting, structuring, technical validation, consistency checks, and keeping content current. You apply human judgment to everything AI produces and take responsibility for its accuracy.
  • Contribute to the team’s shared AI workflows and skills, and look for ways to improve and automate how we create and maintain content as tools and models evolve.
  • Partner with engineers, PMs, and other stakeholders to understand product requirements, interview subject matter experts, and turn complex technical detail into clear, accurate content.
  • Test what you document. Run the software, follow your own procedures, and flag product and UX gaps you find along the way.
  • Let data guide your priorities. We have strong docs and learning analytics. You’ll use them, along with user feedback, to find content gaps, prioritize your work, and show the impact of what you ship.
  • Work with the documentation manager and other writers to improve information architecture, voice, and consistency across our docs, and to make information easy to find for both people and AI-driven search and assistants.
  • Manage several projects at once, using judgment to prioritize and communicate clearly when the plan changes.
  • Mentor teammates and share practices that raise the quality of the team’s work.

Requirements

What experience would make someone be successful in this role?

  • Experience writing or documenting enterprise or developer-facing software, with a portfolio or writing samples that show technical depth.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools and models in your writing workflow (such as LLM assistants, agentic coding tools, or custom prompts and skills), and the ability to explain how you evaluate and verify their output.
  • Experience working with docs-as-code: command-line Git, GitHub (pull requests and reviews), Markdown, and common IDEs.
  • Comfort working in technical environments. You can set up, run, and troubleshoot software yourself to verify what you write (for example, command line, containers, or Kubernetes, or a willingness to learn quickly).
  • Experience collaborating with engineers and product managers to get accurate technical information.
  • Experience working remotely and asynchronously on a distributed team.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Curiosity about AI as a craft. You treat AI workflows as a professional skill. You experiment, share what works, and know where AI helps and where it doesn’t.
  • Technical credibility. You care about accuracy, you learn new technical domains quickly, and you ask questions until you understand them.
  • Strong judgment and editing skills. You can tell good content from plausible-sounding content, and you hold the line on quality.
  • Ownership. You manage multiple projects and work well both independently and collaboratively.
  • Clarity. You write concisely and plainly for readers of all experience levels.
  • Bonus: Experience with observability, monitoring, or cloud-native tooling, or contributing to open source documentation.

Equal Opportunity EmployerAt Grafana Labs we’re building a company where a diverse mix of talented people want to come, stay, and do their best work. We know that our company runs on the hard work and the dedication of our passionate and creative employees.
