Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

Why This Role Matters

The solutions you design will directly impact our ability to win business and deliver value to customers who depend on reliable, sustainable energy. You'll work on meaningful projects that improve energy reliability, reduce costs, and support the transition to cleaner power.

This role offers significant growth potential within a dynamic organization. You'll develop both technical depth and business acumen, with mentorship from experienced leaders and exposure to strategic projects. As our business grows, high-performing Solutions Architects can advance to senior technical roles or move into leadership positions.

Our Environment

You'll work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where technical excellence and customer focus are paramount. We value innovation, continuous improvement, and bold thinking. You'll have access to cutting-edge technologies, challenging projects, and a team committed to pushing the boundaries of what's possible in clean energy solutions.

We support your professional development with training, mentorship, and opportunities to work on increasingly complex and strategic projects. Your expertise and contributions will be recognized, and you'll have a clear path to grow your impact and career.

  • 5+ years of experience in technical design, pre-sales engineering, or applications engineering within energy, industrial systems, or complex technical environments

  • Experience creating technical proposals and customer-facing documentation
  • Excellent communication skills—able to present complex technical information clearly to diverse audiences
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and systems-thinking approach
  • Business acumen with understanding of project economics and value drivers
  • Willingness to travel regularly (approximately 30-40%) for customer meetings and site visits

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of distributed power generation, energy storage, or critical power systems
  • Engineering degree (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, or related field)
  • Experience with financial modeling and project budgeting
  • Familiarity with relevant industry codes and standards (NEC, NFPA, IBC, etc.)
  • Track record of winning complex technical sales
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment

Technical Competencies

  • System-level design and integration thinking
  • Technical modeling and performance analysis
  • CAD and 3D visualization proficiency
  • Engineering documentation and technical writing
  • Risk assessment and mitigation planning
  • Customer-focused problem solving

Professional Competencies

  • Strong customer orientation and relationship building
  • Collaborative mindset and cross-functional partnership
  • Attention to detail with ability to manage multiple complex projects
  • Self-motivated with strong organizational skills
  • Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning orientation
  • Comfort with ambiguity and changing priorities
  • Professional presence and credibility with customers and internal stakeholders

Because of this, we don’t accept unsolicited resumes from agencies at this time. If we ever need an extra hand, we’ll be sure to reach out to the community. Thanks for understanding!

DVM is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with disabilities and to act in accordance with regulations and guidance issued by the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC).

Mission Critical Group designs, manufactures and provides value-added services for customers requiring critical power solutions. Powering a new electric world for a brighter, more secure future.

Mission Critical Group is an end-to-end power solutions and services provider that accelerates time-to-power and delivers scalable, resilient infrastructure for mission critical environments. raw.description:
Team: Sales / Solution Engineering

Mindset:Own the technical win.

About Nametag

Nametag is a category leader in identity verification, security, and account protection. We sell into security-conscious enterprises with complex environments, and high technical standards. Our Solutions Engineers are trusted technical partners to both customers and Account Executives—and are accountable for proving value, not just explaining it.

We value intellectual curiosity, collaboration, and a strong sense of responsibility in protecting enterprise security.

About the Role

We’re hiring an Enterprise Solutions Engineer to own the technical motion in complex enterprise deal cycles. This role partners directly with Account Executives to drive new business and expansion, assisting with discovery, shaping technical strategy, and running proofs-of-concept that align to the buyer’s security, identity, and implementation criteria.

This is not a demo jockey role. You are responsible for the technical win—from first technical conversation through POC success and into a clean, confident handoff to post-sales. You’ll stay engaged through implementation to ensure what was sold is what gets delivered, on time and against the buyer’s stated objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with Account Executives to drive the technical validation for enterprise new business and expansion opportunities.
  • Lead deep technical discovery to understand customer identity architecture, security posture, and success criteria.
  • Own and execute enterprise-grade demos andproof-of-concept, clearly tied to documented success criteria reflecting customer requirements around relevant use cases,, risk factors, and decision criteria.
  • Articulate Nametag’s value in the context of IAM, authentication flows, and account protection—not just product features.
  • Serve as the primary technical adviser during the sales cycle, building trust with security, IT, and identity stakeholders.
  • Define clear technical success criteria and acceptance standards for each deal.
  • Own thehandover to post-sales, ensuring Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Technical Customer Engineering teams have full context.
  • Provide continuity and technical oversight during implementation to ensure onboarding stays aligned with what was sold and agreed.
  • Surface product gaps, competitive insights, and recurring objections to Product and Leadership.
  • Support renewals and expansions as necessary by re-engaging on architecture changes, new use cases, integration opportunities, and evolving security requirements.

Tech You’ll Work With

  • Identity and access management platforms: Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Auth0, Ping, Duo
  • Authentication and federation standards: SAML, OIDC, OAuth, SSO, MFA
  • Enterprise IT and workflow systems: ServiceNow, custom internal platforms
  • REST APIs, webhooks, and modern SaaS architectures
  • Cloud environments and enterprise security tooling
  • Customer demo, POC, and evaluation environments

Qualifications

Work Authorization (Required): Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future need for visa sponsorship. This is a firm requirement. The technical qualifications below are guidelines.

  • 5+ years experience in Pre-sales Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Technical Consulting in B2B SaaS.
  • Strong background in IAM, cybersecurity, or enterprise infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with SAML SSO, identity federation, and enterprise authentication flows.
  • Proven track record running successful enterprise POCs and technical evaluations.
  • Comfortable engaging with senior technical buyers (Security, IAM, IT Architecture).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills—able to explain complex systems clearly and credibly.
  • Bonus: Experience supporting post-sale implementations or working closely with Customer Success teams.

Who Will Succeed in This Role If

  • You take personal ownership of the technical win.
  • You think demos should prove outcomes, not just show features.
  • You’re comfortable pushing back when a POC is poorly scoped or misaligned.
  • You care deeply about clean handoffs and long-term customer success.
  • You enjoy complex environments where trust, clarity, and execution matter.

Why Join

You’ll work on high-impact enterprise deals where technical credibility is decisive. You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, and Customer Success leadership, influence how we sell and onboard at scale, and help define Nametag’s technical reputation in the market.

Culture & Perks

At Nametag, we believe trust starts with how we treat each other. We're a remote-first team that values autonomy, inclusivity, and collaboration, with regular in-person time to stay connected and innovate together.

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in the US. Our team spans Seattle, San Francisco, Ann Arbor, Denver, New York City, and beyond.
  • Off-sites: We bring the team together once per quarter for in-person collaboration, often off-site in new places.
  • Flexible schedules: Work in your own time zone; we align key meetings across a shared window.

We Offer

  • Competitive salary at $225,000 OTE with a 77/23 split
  • Meaningful equity ownership
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Quarterly team off-sites and travel support
  • New computer hardware and equipment
  • An inclusive environment where your voice has impact and your work drives change

About the team

US Tax Operations resolves tax notices that clients receive from the IRS and state agencies, and runs the filings and payments work that prevents those notices in the first place. The team includes a notice-resolution organization of roughly 50 specialists across 7 managers and 2 pillar leads, and a filings, payments, and amendments organization of 4 teams under a third pillar lead.

About the role

US Tax Operations has historically handled quality assurance and training as side responsibilities held by internally promoted managers, people who are excellent at the underlying casework but have never built or run a quality program end to end. We're hiring a Quality & Enablement Lead to own this as a full-time discipline: building the team's training curriculum, running quality assurance and CSAT-driven improvement loops, and making sure skills keep pace with the team's workload. This is an external hire rather than an internal promotion, because the role calls for program-building experience the team doesn't currently have in-house.

What you'll do

  • Own and build the team's end-to-end training framework: structured courses and refresher trainings across each functional area, including a way for team members to test into a different function if they want to move.
  • Run the quality assurance program: auditing case quality, tracking trends, and turning findings into targeted refresher training rather than one-off fixes.
  • Monitor CSAT and case-quality trends to catch emerging skill gaps early, for example by building and rolling out a refresher course when a pattern of errors shows up in a given week's cases.
  • Maintain a clear, current record of who has and hasn't completed required training or certification, and partner with managers to close gaps.
  • Build and improve the quality programs that reduce the kinds of issues that lead to client tax notices or escalations in the first place.

What we're looking for

  • A track record of building and running a quality or enablement program end-to-end, not just facilitating training sessions designed by someone else.
  • Experience with QA processes and CSAT or customer-experience programs in an operations or customer support environment.
  • 3-6 years of relevant experience, ideally spanning both content design and full program execution.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to operate independently in a fast-moving environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a payroll, tax, HR tech, or other compliance-driven operations environment.
  • Experience designing certification or internal-mobility testing programs.
